政策法规国土安全部 (DHS)重要#亲属移民与绿卡#入境与签证签发

DHS发布最终规则 废止2022年公共负担不可入境规定

发布日期 2026年7月20日生效日期 2026年9月18日

美国国土安全部(DHS)发布最终规则,废止2022年关于公共负担(Public Charge)不可入境事由的规定,该规则将于2026年9月18日生效。新规取消了2022年规定中详细的定义和最低考量因素框架,恢复DHS官员在判断申请人是否可能成为公共负担时的更大裁量权。规则同时修订了有关公共负担担保金违约及撤销的条款。

要点

  • 最终规则废止了2022年公共负担不可入境事由规定。
  • DHS官员将重新获得更大裁量权,可考量与案件相关的任何因素,而不仅限于法定最低因素。
  • 新规适用于2026年9月18日及以后提出的入境申请,以及自该日起以邮寄或电子方式提交的身份调整申请。
  • 2026年9月18日之前领取经济状况审查类公共福利的记录,仍将按2022年规定的标准进行评估。
  • 规则同时修订了公共负担担保金的违约及撤销相关规定。
  • 该文件为已公布的最终规则,并非提案,生效日为2026年9月18日。

影响对象

申请入境美国的人士、申请身份调整的人士,以及提交经济担保书或公共负担担保金的担保人。

建议行动

在2026年9月18日生效日前后有申请计划的申请人和担保人,应确认其案件适用哪一套公共负担标准,如有疑问建议咨询律师。

摘要：
SUMMARY:
国土安全部（DHS）正在废除2022年公共负担不可入境性规定（“2022年最终规则”）。2022年最终规则并非对该法规的最佳实施方式。该规则与国会意图不符，过度限制，且妨碍了国土安全部准确、精确、可靠地判定某些外国人是否可能在任何时候成为公共负担的能力。废除该规则可恢复国土安全部官员在评估所有相关事实时的更广泛自由裁量权，并与长期以来的政策保持一致，即在美国的外国人应自力更生，政府福利不应成为移民的激励因素。本规则还修订了有关公共负担保证金违约与解除的规定。
DHS is rescinding the 2022 public charge ground of inadmissibility regulations (“2022 Final Rule”). The 2022 Final Rule was not the best implementation of the statute. It was inconsistent with congressional intent, unduly restrictive, and hampered DHS's ability to make accurate, precise, and reliable determinations of whether certain aliens are likely at any time to become a public charge. Rescission restores broader discretion for DHS officers to evaluate all pertinent facts and aligns with long-standing policy that aliens in the United States should be self-reliant and government benefits should not incentivize immigration. This rule also revises the breach and cancellation of public charge bonds regulations.
日期：
DATES:
最终规则自2026年9月18日起生效。本规则适用于2026年9月18日或之后提出的入境申请，或于2026年9月18日或之后邮寄或以电子方式提交的身份调整申请。在2026年9月18日之前领取按经济状况测定的公共福利，将依照2022年最终规则的规定予以考量。
The final rule is effective on September 18, 2026. This rule applies to applications for admission made on or after September 18, 2026 or applications for adjustment of status postmarked or electronically submitted on or after September 18, 2026. Receipt of means-tested public benefits before September 18, 2026 will be considered consistently with the 2022 Final Rule.

I. Executive Summary
A. 监管行动的目的
A. Purpose of the Regulatory Action
本规则的目的是从《联邦法规汇编》中删除由《公共负担不可准入性最终规则》(2022年最终规则)[1]所颁布的公共负担不可准入性规定,因为这些规定束缚了美国国土安全部(DHS)官员作出与国会在1996年《个人责任与工作机会协调法案》(PRWORA)中所制定的关于福利与移民的明确国家政策相一致的公共负担不可准入性认定的能力。参见《公法》104-193,第400条,110 Stat. 2105,2260(编入8 U.S.C. 1601)。2022年最终规则对法定用语施加了狭义定义,并规定了最低因素,同时限制了DHS在作出公共负担不可准入性认定时可以考虑的公共福利范围。实际上,2022年最终规则创建了一个框架,要求官员考虑七个因素(其中五个为法定要求的因素),而不是明确授权官员考虑在综合考量外国人各种情况后,与判断该外国人在任何时候是否有可能成为公共负担相关的其他任何因素或信息。[2]
The purpose of this rule is to remove from the Code of Federal Regulations the public charge inadmissibility provisions promulgated by the Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility final rule (2022 Final Rule),[1] as these provisions straitjacket DHS officers' ability to make public charge inadmissibility determinations that are consistent with Congress's express national policy on welfare and immigration enacted in the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 (PRWORA). SeePublic Law 104-193, section 400, 110 Stat. 2105, 2260 (codified at 8 U.S.C. 1601). The 2022 Final Rule imposed narrow definitions of statutory terms and minimum factors as well as limited the public benefits that DHS could consider in a public charge inadmissibility determination. Indeed, the 2022 Final Rule created a framework under which officers were directed to consider seven factors (five of those required by statute) rather than being explicitly empowered to consider any other factors or information relevant to determining an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge in the totality of the alien's circumstances.[2]
DHS正在摒弃明确的主要依赖标准。通过删除2022年最终规则中的大部分[3]监管规定,DHS能够实施政策和解释工具,指导官员在综合考量外国人各种情况的基础上,依据成文法、国会意图及先例,作出个性化、基于具体事实的公共负担不可准入性认定。[4]这些工具将在指导公共负担不可准入性认定的同时,使官员能够考虑:(1)《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)(B)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)所规定的法定强制性因素;(2)外国人领取经济状况调查型公共福利的情况;(3)与该外国人案件相关的任何其他个性化、具体案情的因素和情况;以及(4)与外国人自给自足能力相关的任何经验数据。官员将运用良好的判断力和自由裁量权,按照国会的立法意图,在综合考量各种情况的基础上,更准确地评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性。
DHS is moving away from a bright line primary dependence standard. By removing most [3] of the regulatory provisions in the 2022 Final Rule, DHS can implement policy and interpretive tools guiding officers in making individualized, fact-specific public charge inadmissibility determinations, based on a totality of the alien's circumstances, consistent with the statute, congressional intent, and precedent.[4] These tools will guide public charge inadmissibility determinations while empowering officers to consider: (1) the mandatory statutory factors in section 212(a)(4)(B) of the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B); (2) the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits; (3) any other individualized case-specific factors and circumstances relevant to an alien's case; and (4) any empirical data relevant to an alien's self-sufficiency. Using good judgment and discretion, officers will more accurately assess an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge, in the totality of the circumstances, as Congress intended.
DHS审查并考虑了针对拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)所提交的反馈意见和建议。
DHS reviewed and considered the feedback and recommendations submitted in response to the notice of proposed rulemaking (NPRM).
B. 法律授权
B. Legal Authority
国土安全部部长(部长)就撤销和修订相关规定所享有的权力,源自《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(关于公共负担不可准入性认定);第235条,即8 U.S.C. 1225(关于入境申请人);以及第245条,即8 U.S.C. 1255(关于身份调整申请的资格标准)。此外,《移民与国籍法》第103(a)(3)条,即8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3),授权部长制定其认为为行使其在《移民与国籍法》项下的权力所必需的规章。
The authority of the Secretary of Homeland Security (Secretary) for the rescissions and regulatory amendments is found in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), (public charge inadmissibility determinations); section 235 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1225, (applicants for admission); and section 245 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1255, (eligibility criteria for applications for adjustment of status). In addition, section 103(a)(3) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3), authorizes the Secretary to establish such regulations as deemed necessary for carrying out the Secretary's authority under the INA.
C. 拟议规则摘要
C. Summary of the Proposed Rule
2025年11月19日,DHS发布了题为《公共负担不可准入性依据》的拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)。90 FR 52168(2025年11月19日)。在该NPRM中,DHS提议作出以下修改:
On November 19, 2025, DHS published an NPRM titled Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility. 90 FR 52168 (Nov. 19, 2025). In the NPRM, DHS proposed the following changes:
修订8 CFR 103.6(c),撤销与违约,明确规定领取任何经济状况调查型公共福利,或在其他方面不遵守公共负担保证金的任何条件,均构成对该保证金的违约,并删除“USCIS可以在认定外国人在任何时候均不太可能成为公共负担后随时撤销公共负担保证金”的表述。
Amend8 CFR 103.6(c), Cancellation and breach—Clarifying that receipt of any means-tested public benefit, or being otherwise noncompliant with any condition of the public charge bond, results in a breach of that bond and eliminating language stating that “USCIS may cancel a public charge bond at any time after determining that the alien is not likely at any time to become a public charge.”
删除8 CFR 212.20,公共负担不可准入性的适用范围,全部删除界定受公共负担不可准入性依据约束的外国人类别的表述(原文第45326页)。
Remove8 CFR 212.20, Applicability of public charge inadmissibility—Removal in its entirety of the language defining the categories ( printed page 45326) of aliens subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility.
删除8 CFR 212.21,定义,删除相关定义,包括“在任何时候均有可能成为公共负担”“(公共福利的)领取”“用于维持收入的公共现金援助”以及“由政府出资的长期机构照护”等定义。
Remove8 CFR 212.21, Definitions—Removal of the definitions, including the definitions of “likely at any time to become a public charge,” “receipt (of public benefits),” “public cash assistance for income maintenance,” and “long-term institutionalization at government expense.”
移除8 CFR 212.22,公共负担不可入境性认定,移除与外国人当前和/或过去领取经济状况调查公共福利相关的过度限制性语言、全面情况分析,以及豁免类别外国人领取公共福利的相关规定。
Remove8 CFR 212.22, Public charge inadmissibility determination—Removal of the overly restrictive language relating to an alien's current and/or past receipt of means-tested public benefits, the totality of the circumstances analysis, and receipt of public benefits by an alien in an exempt category.
移除8 CFR 212.23,公共负担不可入境理由的豁免和放弃,移除列明公共负担不可入境理由豁免和放弃情形的语言。
Remove8 CFR 212.23, Exemptions and waivers for public charge ground of inadmissibility—Removal of the language listing exemptions and waivers to the public charge ground of inadmissibility.
美国国土安全部(DHS)就该拟议规则收到8,846条[5]评论意见,其中大多数反对该规则。在仔细审议所收到的公众评论意见后,国土安全部按原拟议内容发布本最终规则。本最终规则的序言部分包含对评论意见中提出的重大问题的概述,并就政策变更作出相应说明。
DHS received 8,846 [5] comments on the proposed rule, the majority of which opposed the rule. Following careful consideration of public comments received, DHS is issuing this final rule as proposed. The preamble to this final rule includes summaries of significant issues raised by the comments and includes responsive explanations for policy changes.
D. 实施
D. Implementation
国土安全部将自本最终规则生效之日起开始实施本规则。本最终规则适用于在生效日期当日或之后邮戳寄出或以电子方式提交的调整身份申请,以及在生效日期当日或之后提出的入境申请。在生效日期当日或之前,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将发布次级监管指南,为USCIS官员根据本最终规则在全面情况分析框架下作出公共负担不可入境性认定提供参考,但不规定具体结果。此外,对于本最终规则生效日期之前的情形,国土安全部仅考虑领取用于维持收入的公共现金援助以及由政府出资进行长期机构照护的情况;对于生效日期当日或之后的情形,国土安全部将考虑领取任何经济状况调查公共福利的情况。
DHS will begin implementing this final rule on its effective date. This final rule will apply to applications for adjustment of status that are postmarked or electronically submitted on or after the effective date and applications for admission made on or after the effective date. On or before the effective date, USCIS will issue subregulatory guidance to inform, but not prescribe, the outcome of USCIS officers' public charge inadmissibility determinations made under this final rule in the totality of the circumstances. In addition, DHS will only consider the receipt of public cash assistance for income maintenance and long-term institutionalization at government expense before the effective date of this final rule and will consider the receipt of any means tested public benefits on or after that date.
E. 成本与效益
E. Costs and Benefits
国土安全部正在移除2022年最终规则中的大部分条款,以便更好地实施公共负担不可入境理由的相关规定。预计本最终规则将产生新的效益和转移支付。为评估本规则的影响,国土安全部将本规则的潜在影响与不采取行动的基准情形进行比较,该基准情形反映了在不采取本监管行动情况下的现状。
DHS is removing most of the 2022 Final Rule provisions to allow DHS to better implement the public charge ground of inadmissibility. The final rule is expected to impose new benefits and transfers. To assess the impacts of the rule, DHS considers the potential impacts of the rule relative to a no-action baseline, which reflects the current state of the world absent this regulatory action.
本规则未量化效益的主要来源在于,移除了2022年最终规则中颁布的过度限制性条款,这些条款妨碍了官员作出公共负担不可入境性认定。通过取消僵化的监管定义和标准,本规则确保官员能够基于每位外国人个人情况的全面情况,作出高度个性化、基于具体事实、逐案审查的公共负担不可入境性决定。这一方法将防止适用过度限制性标准,避免这些标准束缚国土安全部官员作出公共负担不可入境性认定的能力。
The primary source of unquantified benefits of this rule is the removal of overly restrictive provisions promulgated in the 2022 Final Rule that hinder officers in making public charge inadmissibility determinations. By removing rigid regulatory definitions and standards, this rule ensures that officers can make highly individualized, fact-specific, case-by-case public charge inadmissibility decisions based on the totality of each alien's individual circumstances. This approach will prevent the application of overly restrictive criteria that straitjackets DHS officers' ability to make public charge inadmissibility determinations.
该规则还将导致联邦政府和州政府对可能选择退出公共福利计划或放弃参加公共福利计划的个人的转移支付减少。可能选择退出公共福利计划或在未来放弃参加公共福利计划的个人,既包括外国人,也包括属于混合身份家庭成员的美国公民。美国国土安全部(DHS)估计,由于包括可能正在领取公共福利的外国人在内的家庭成员退出或放弃参加公共福利计划,联邦政府和州政府转移支付的总减少额每年可能约为130.5亿美元。美国国土安全部估计,按3%的贴现率计算,本规则在10年期内对联邦政府和州政府转移支付造成的折现减少额可能约为1112.8亿美元,按7%的贴现率计算约为916.2亿美元。该总额包括美国国土安全部估计的联邦转移支付减少额,按3%的贴现率计算约为657.6亿美元,按7%的贴现率计算约为541.4亿美元。利用平均联邦医疗补助比例(FMAP),美国国土安全部进一步估计,州转移支付按3%的贴现率计算可能减少约455.2亿美元,按7%的贴现率计算约为374.8亿美元。美国国土安全部指出,可能还存在我们无法量化的其他转移支付减少情况。美国国土安全部还认识到,转移支付减少的估计值为近似值,可能受到与本规则无关的外部因素的影响。例如,H.R. 1法案中包含的对医疗补助计划(Medicaid)和补充营养援助计划(SNAP)的最新变化预计将影响参保率,从而增加量化工作的复杂性。[6] 美国国土安全部预计,退出或放弃参保率可能会独立于本规则而波动,从而可能影响本文所列的转移支付估计值。然而,这些外部因素与本规则是相互独立、互不相关的。
The rule will also result in a reduction in transfer payments from Federal and State governments to individuals who may choose to disenroll from or forgo enrollment in a public benefits program. Individuals who might choose to disenroll from or forgo future enrollment in a public benefits program include aliens as well as U.S. citizens who are members of mixed-status households. DHS estimates that the total reduction in transfer payments from the Federal and State governments could be approximately $13.05 billion annually due to disenrollment or forgone enrollment in public benefits programs by members of households that include aliens who may be receiving public benefits. DHS estimates that the 10-year discounted Federal and State transfer payments reduction of this rule could be approximately $111.28 billion at a 3-percent discount rate and about $91.62 billion at a 7-percent discount rate. This total includes DHS's estimate that Federal transfer payments could decrease by approximately $65.76 billion at a 3-percent discount rate and about $54.14 billion at a 7-percent discount rate. Using the average Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (FMAP), DHS further estimates that State transfer payments could decrease by approximately $45.52 billion at a 3-percent discount rate and approximately $37.48 billion at a 7-percent discount rate. DHS notes there may be additional reductions in transfer payments that we are unable to quantify. DHS also recognizes that the estimated reductions in transfer payments are approximations and could be influenced by external factors unrelated to this rule. For example, the recent changes to Medicaid and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) included in H.R. 1 are expected to impact enrollment rates, adding complexity to quantification efforts.[6] DHS anticipates that disenrollment or forgone enrollment rates may fluctuate independently of this rule, potentially affecting the transfer payment estimates presented. However, those external factors are separate and independent of this rule.
最后,美国国土安全部认识到,联邦福利计划下联邦和州转移支付的减少可能对州和地方经济、大小企业以及个人产生下游和上游影响。例如,该规则可能导致参与医疗补助计划的医疗服务提供者(如医院和非营利机构)、生产医疗用品或药品的公司、参与补充营养援助计划的食品零售商,以及种植可用补充营养援助计划福利购买的食品的农业生产者的收入减少。参与联邦资助住房计划的房东也可能面临财务压力,例如租户流动率上升和管理成本增加等问题。
Finally, DHS recognizes that reductions in Federal and State transfers under Federal benefits programs may have downstream and upstream impacts on State and local economies, large and small businesses, and individuals. For example, the rule might result in reduced revenues for healthcare providers, such as hospitals and nonprofits, participating in Medicaid, companies that manufacture medical supplies or pharmaceuticals, grocery retailers participating in SNAP, agricultural producers who grow foods that are eligible for purchase using SNAP benefits. Landlords participating in federally funded housing programs may also experience financial strain, such as increased tenant turnover and higher administrative costs.

二、背景
II. Background
A. 法律授权
A. Legal Authority
部长发布本规则的授权见于《移民与国籍法》(INA,8 U.S.C. 1101 et seq.)的多个条款以及《2002年国土安全法》(HSA)。[8] 《国土安全法》第102条(6 U.S.C. 112)和《移民与国籍法》第103条(8 U.S.C. 1103)授权部长负责执行和实施美国的移民法律。《国土安全法》第101条(6 U.S.C. 111)规定,美国国土安全部的部分核心使命是确保旨在保障国土安全的各项努力、活动和计划不会削弱美国的整体经济安全或个人的公民权利和公民自由。
The Secretary's authority for issuing this rule is found in various sections of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1101 et seq., and the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (HSA).[8] Section 102 of the HSA, 6 U.S.C. 112, and section 103 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103, charge the Secretary with the administration and enforcement of the immigration laws of the United States. Section 101 of the HSA, 6 U.S.C. 111, establishes that part of DHS's primary mission is to ensure that efforts, activities, and programs aimed at securing the homeland do not diminish either the overall economic security of the United States or the civil rights and civil liberties of persons.
除确立部长执行和实施移民法律的一般授权外,《移民与国籍法》第103条(8 U.S.C. 1103)还列举了各项相关授权,包括部长为行使该授权而认为必要时可制定相应法规、规定保证金形式、发布指示以及采取其他行动的权力。
In addition to establishing the Secretary's general authority for the administration and enforcement of immigration laws, section 103 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103, enumerates various related authorities, including the Secretary's authority to establish such regulations, prescribe such forms of bond, issue such instructions, and perform such other acts as the Secretary deems necessary for carrying out such authority.
《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4),规定任何申请签证、入境或身份调整的外国人,如果在任何时候可能成为公共负担,均属不可入境。一般而言,根据《移民与国籍法》第213条,即8 U.S.C. 1183,部长对于仅因公共负担理由被认定为不可入境的外国人,在提交部长批准的适当且恰当的保证金或担保后,可自由裁量准许其进入美国。
Section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), provides that any alien who applies for a visa, admission, or adjustment of status is inadmissible if he or she is likely at any time to become a public charge. In general, under section 213 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1183, the Secretary has the discretion to admit into the United States an alien who is determined to be inadmissible based only on the public charge ground upon the giving of a suitable and proper bond or undertaking approved by the Secretary.
根据《移民与国籍法》第213A条,即8 U.S.C. 1183a,某些外国人须提交由担保人签署的充分的《移民与国籍法》第213A条下的经济担保宣誓书(I-864表),担保人同意在该宣誓书具有可执行力期间,向受担保外国人提供维持其年收入不低于联邦贫困线125%的支持[9]。I-864表旨在确保拟入境移民拥有充分的经济支持手段,不太可能依赖美国政府提供的经济支持。
Under section 213A of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1183a, certain aliens are required to submit a sufficient Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA (Form I-864) executed by a sponsor who agrees to provide support to maintain the sponsored alien at an annual income that is not less than 125 percent of the Federal poverty line [9] during the period in which the affidavit is enforceable. The Form I-864 is intended to ensure that an intending immigrant has adequate means of financial support and is not likely to rely on the U.S. Government for financial support.
《移民与国籍法》第235条,即8 U.S.C. 1225,涉及对入境申请人的检查,包括对此类外国人不可入境的认定。
Section 235 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1225, addresses the inspection of applicants for admission, including inadmissibility determinations of such aliens.
《移民与国籍法》第245条,即8 U.S.C. 1255,一般规定了调整为合法永久居民(LPR)身份的资格条件。
Section 245 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1255, generally establishes eligibility criteria for adjustment of status to that of a lawful permanent resident (LPR).
B. 不可入境的一般事由
B. Grounds of Inadmissibility Generally
美国长期以来一直允许外国人入境美国,无论是永久性还是临时性入境。与此同时,国会将对国家安全或整体福祉构成威胁、或意图违反移民法的外国人排除在外。[10]
The United States has a long history of permitting aliens to enter the United States, whether permanently or on a temporary basis. At the same time, Congress has excluded aliens who pose a threat to the safety or general welfare of the country or who seek to violate immigration laws.[10]
国会在一定程度上通过在《移民与国籍法》中确立入境[11]和不可入境[12]的概念来行使这一权力。外国人可能因一系列行为、状况和举止而被认定为不可入境。[13] 如果某外国人属于不可入境,则该外国人无资格被准许进入美国,也无资格获得签证,除非其申请并获得不可入境豁免或其他形式的救济。国会将不可入境事由的适用范围扩大到入境申请和签证申请之外,将可入境性作为获得某些移民福利的资格条件之一,包括调整为合法永久居民身份。[14] 如果某外国人属于不可入境,则该外国人同样无资格获得这些福利,除非该外国人有资格申请并获得不可入境豁免或其他可获得且适当的救济形式。[15]
Congress has exercised this authority in part by establishing the concepts of admission [11] and inadmissibility in the INA.[12] Aliens are inadmissible due to a range of acts, conditions, and conduct.[13] If an alien is inadmissible that alien is ineligible to be admitted to the United States and ineligible to receive a visa, unless he or she applies for and receives a waiver of inadmissibility or other form of relief. Congress extended the applicability of the inadmissibility grounds beyond the context of applications for admission and visas by making admissibility an eligibility requirement for certain immigration benefits, including adjustment of status to that of an LPR.[14] If an alien is inadmissible, that alien is also ineligible for those benefits unless the alien is eligible to apply for and received waiver of inadmissibility or other form of relief, where available and appropriate.[15]
(印刷页第45330页)
( printed page 45330)
C. 公共负担不可入境事由
C. Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility
《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4),规定任何申请签证、入境或身份调整的外国人,如果领事官员或移民官员(视情况而定)认为该外国人在任何时候可能成为公共负担,则属不可入境。因此,公共负担不可入境事由适用于申请临时或永久赴美签证的外国人、在入境口岸或口岸之间申请入境的外国人,[16]以及申请调整为合法永久居民身份的外国人。[17] 根据该法规,某些类别的外国人可免除公共负担不可入境事由的适用,而其他类别的外国人,若被认定因公共负担事由不可入境,则可申请公共负担不可入境豁免,或可能被邀请提交公共负担保证金。[18]
Section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), states any alien who applies for a visa, admission, or adjustment of status is inadmissible if in the opinion of the consular officer or immigration officer, as applicable, the alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. The public charge ground of inadmissibility, therefore, applies to aliens applying for a visa to come to the United States temporarily or permanently, for admission at or between ports of entry,[16] and for adjustment of status to that of an LPR.[17] Under the statute, some categories of aliens are exempt from the public charge ground of inadmissibility, while others, if found inadmissible under the public charge ground, may apply for a waiver of the public charge ground of inadmissibility or may be invited to submit a public charge bond.[18]
《移民与国籍法》（INA）并未对“公共负担”或“在任何时候都有可能成为公共负担”等术语作出定义。但该法确实规定，领事官员和移民官员在判断外国人在任何时候是否有可能成为公共负担时，至少必须考虑该外国人的年龄；健康状况；家庭状况；资产、资源和财务状况；以及教育和技能。参见INA第212(a)(4)(B)(i)条，8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(i)（强调后加）。INA第212(a)(4)(B)(ii)条，8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(ii)，允许领事官员或移民官员在判断该外国人在任何时候是否有可能成为公共负担时，考虑为该外国人提交的任何I-864表格。[19] 事实上，除极少数例外情形外，大多数申请family-based移民签证及身份调整的外国人，以及某些申请employment-based移民签证或身份调整的外国人，都必须提交一份充分的I-864表格，以避免因“在任何时候都有可能成为公共负担”而被认定为不可入境。参见INA第212(a)(4)(C)和(D)条，8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(C)和(D)。
The INA does not define the terms “public charge” or “likely at any time to become a public charge.” However, it does specify that when determining whether an alien is likely at any time to become a public charge, consular officers and immigration officers must, at a minimum, consider the alien's age; health; family status; assets, resources, and financial status; and education and skills. See INA sec. 212(a)(4)(B)(i), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(i) (emphasis added). Section 212(a)(4)(B)(ii) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(ii), permits consular officers or immigration officers to consider any Form I-864 submitted on the alien's behalf, when determining whether the alien is likely at any time to become a public charge.[19] In fact, with very limited exceptions, most aliens seeking family-based immigrant visas and adjustment of status, and certain aliens seeking employment-based immigrant visas or adjustment of status, must submit a sufficient Form I-864 in order to avoid being found inadmissible as likely at any time to become a public charge. See INA sec. 212(a)(4)(C) and (D), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(C) and (D).
一般而言，根据INA第213条，8 U.S.C. 1183，对于仅因公共负担理由被认定为不可入境的外国人，在提供经部长批准的适当且合规的保证书或承诺后，部长有自由裁量权准许其入境美国。参见INA第213条，8 U.S.C. 1183。
In general, under section 213 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1183, the Secretary has the discretion to admit into the United States an alien who is determined to be inadmissible only on the public charge ground upon the giving of a suitable and proper bond or undertaking approved by the Secretary. See INA sec. 213, 8 U.S.C. 1183.
D. 本次规则制定
D. Current Rulemaking
2025年11月19日，国土安全部（DHS）发布了《公共负担不可入境理由》拟议规则制定通知（NPRM），载于90 FR 52168（2025年11月19日）。该NPRM的公众意见征询期于2025年12月19日结束，相关信息收集的公众意见征询期于2026年1月20日结束。[20] 在认真审议所收到的公众意见后，国土安全部按原拟议内容发布本最终规则。序言的以下部分包含对所收到公众意见的详细总结与分析。所收到的意见可在联邦档案管理系统（FDMS）https://www.regulations.gov 查阅，案卷编号为USCIS-2025-0304。
On November 19, 2025, DHS published the NPRM, Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility, 90 FR 52168 (Nov. 19, 2025). The public comment period on the NPRM closed on December 19, 2025, and the public comment period on the associated information collection closed on January 20, 2026.[20] Following careful consideration of public comments received, DHS is issuing this final rule as proposed. The following section of the preamble includes a detailed summary and analysis of public comments received. Comments received may be reviewed at the Federal Docket Management System (FDMS) at https://www.regulations.gov, docket number USCIS-2025-0304.
有关公共负担不可入境理由的历史、《个人责任与工作机会协调法》（PRWORA）项下公共福利的历史，以及此前公共负担规则制定的详细说明，请参阅该NPRM。
For a detailed description of the history of the public charge ground of inadmissibility, public benefits under PRWORA, and prior public charge rulemakings, please refer to the NPRM.
E. 可分割性
E. Severability
国土安全部意图使对8 CFR 103.6(c)的修改与8 CFR第212部分中有关条款的全面废止相分离，具有可分割性。若法院认定本最终规则废止8 CFR 212.20至212.23中公共负担不可入境相关法规的部分无效或不可执行，国土安全部意图使对8 CFR 103.6(c)的某些修改仍应被解释为继续在法律允许的最大范围内发挥效力，除非该等条款也被认定为完全无效或不可执行。具体而言，国土安全部意图继续使以下内容生效：删除8 CFR 103.6(c)(1)中关于国土安全部可在任何时候基于认定“该外国人在任何时候都不太可能成为公共负担”而撤销公共负担保证书的撤销事由，因为如NPRM中所述，拟议删除该撤销事由的理由基于该条款在实践中难以适用，而非基于废止8 CFR 212.20至212.23的更广泛理由。90 FR 52168, 52185（2025年11月19日）。同样，若未被单独认定为无效或不可执行，国土安全部意图保留对8 CFR 103.6(c)(1)的修订性重组，即为清晰起见将撤销条款和违约条款分别列入第(c)(1)(i)项和第(c)(1)(ii)项。
DHS intends the changes to 8 CFR 103.6(c) to be severable from the full rescission of regulatory provisions in 8 CFR part 212. To the extent a court finds this final rule rescinding the public charge inadmissibility regulations in 8 CFR 212.20 through 212.23 is invalid or unenforceable, DHS intends that certain changes to 8 CFR 103.6(c) nevertheless be construed so as to continue to give the maximum effect to those provision(s) permitted by law, unless they are also held to be wholly invalid and unenforceable. Specifically, DHS intends to continue to give effect to the removal of the ground for cancellation 8 CFR 103.6(c)(1) stating that DHS can cancel a public charge bond at any time if it determines “that the alien is not likely at any time to become a public charge” because, as discussed in the NPRM, the rationale for the proposed removal of that ground of cancellation is based on the practical infeasibility of applying it rather than the broader justification for rescinding 8 CFR 212.20 through 212.23. 90 FR 52168, 52185 (Nov. 19, 2025). Similarly, if not separately invalidated or deemed unenforceable, DHS intends to keep the revised restructuring of 8 CFR 103.6(c)(1), separating the cancelation and breach provisions into paragraphs (c)(1)(i) and (c)(1)(ii) for clarity.
三、对拟议规则的公众意见回应
III. Response to Public Comments on the Proposed Rule
A. 公众意见摘要
A. Summary of Public Comments
2025年11月19日，国土安全部发布了题为《公共负担不可入境理由》的NPRM。90 FR 52168（2025年11月19日）。国土安全部就该拟议规则收到8,846条意见，其中大多数反对该规则。大多数意见提交来自个人或匿名评论者，包括律师和学术研究人员。其他评论者包括医疗保健提供者、法律服务提供者、研究机构和宗教组织、倡导团体、社会和社区组织、专业协会、州和地方政府机构及民选官员、贸易和商业组织、工会、学校和大学，以及一个外国政府实体。
On November 19, 2025, DHS published an NPRM titled Public Charge Ground of Inadmissibility. 90 FR 52168 (Nov. 19, 2025). DHS received 8,846 comments on the proposed rule, the majority of which opposed the rule. Most of the comment submissions were from individual or anonymous commenters, including attorneys and academic researchers. Other commenters included healthcare providers, legal service providers, research and religious organizations, advocacy groups, social and community organizations, professional associations, State and local government agencies and elected officials, trade and business organizations, unions, schools and universities, and a foreign government entity.
B. 对拟议规则表示总体支持的意见
B. Comments Expressing General Support for the Proposed Rule
评论意见:若干评论者总体支持拟议规则。部分支持该提案的评论者表示,公共福利项目旨在为美国人提供,政府应将美国置于首位。
Comment: Several commenters were generally in favor of the proposed rule. Some of the commenters who supported the proposal stated that public benefit programs are intended for Americans and that the government should put America first.
许多支持该规则的评论者对移民使用福利给现有资源带来的负担表示关切,称政府不应允许移民给为美国人设立的福利体系造成负担。若干评论者表示,美国(印刷页第45331页)应当消除外国人因公共福利而受到激励移民的可能性,部分评论者提及外国人对公共福利项目的欺诈和滥用、利用美国、耗费资源,或以纳税人的代价不成比例地受益于援助。一名评论者表示,应限制提供给新移民的资源,另一名评论者则表示,当美国公民在美国的境况改善后,方可帮助移民。一名评论者表达了其看法,认为补充性项目本应是临时性援助,但现行规定不足以防止此类援助演变为一种生活方式。其他评论者对该规则表示支持,指出移民在获准入境时应展现较高的教育水平、个人储蓄以及为美国提供的价值。
Many commenters who supported the rule expressed concern about the burden of benefit use by immigrants on available resources, stating the government should not allow immigrants to burden the benefit systems for Americans. Several commenters stated that the United ( printed page 45331) States should eliminate the potential for aliens to be incentivized to immigrate for public benefits, with some commenters referencing aliens' fraud and abuse of public benefit programs, taking advantage of the United States, draining resources, or disproportionately benefiting from assistance at taxpayer expense. One commenter stated that resources for new immigrants should be limited, with another stating that when conditions for U.S. citizens in America improve immigrants can be helped. One commenter expressed their belief that supplemental programs are meant to be a temporary aid but that there are insufficient regulations to prevent such aid from becoming a lifestyle. Other commenters expressed support for the rule, remarking that immigrants should demonstrate advanced education, personal savings, and value provided to the United States upon admission.
回应意见:国土安全部(DHS)同意,申请入境许可和身份调整且受公共负担不可入境性条款约束的外国人应当自给自足,不应依赖政府满足其需求。国土安全部(DHS)也同意,公共福利的可获得性不应成为移民来美的激励因素,正如国会在《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中所表明的那样。[21] 本规则制定旨在使公共负担不可入境性认定与这些理念保持一致。国土安全部(DHS)坚信,这正是国会在制定《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)时的本意。
Response: DHS agrees that aliens applying for admission and adjustment of status who are subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility should be self-sufficient and should not depend on the government to meet their needs. DHS also agrees that the availability of public benefits should not constitute an incentive for immigration to the United States, as Congress indicated in PRWORA.[21] This rulemaking seeks to align public charge inadmissibility determinations with those concepts. DHS firmly believes that this was Congress's intent in enacting section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4).
本规则制定将赋予官员权力,使其不仅考虑法定强制性因素以及外国人领取经济状况审查类公共福利的情况,还考虑记录中与该外国人相关的所有相关证据和信息,以此判断该外国人今后是否有可能成为公共负担。这将恢复依赖国土安全部(DHS)官员良好判断力和合理裁量权的公共负担不可入境性认定方式,正如国会所设想的那样。
This rulemaking will empower officers to consider not only the mandatory statutory factors and an alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits, but also all relevant evidence and information in the record specific to the alien as the officers determine whether the alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. This will restore a public charge inadmissibility determination that relies on DHS officers' good judgment and sound discretion as envisioned by Congress.
国土安全部(DHS)强调,无论是公共负担不可入境性条款还是本最终规则,均不涉及经济状况审查类公共福利的资格认定问题,而是涉及哪些外国人属于不可入境,因而没有资格获准入境及调整身份。本最终规则不涉及政府照顾外国人的责任问题,也不涉及哪些外国人目前或应当有资格领取经济状况审查类公共福利。
DHS emphasizes neither the public charge ground of inadmissibility nor this final rule govern eligibility for means-tested public benefits; rather they govern which aliens are inadmissible and, therefore, ineligible for admission and adjustment of status. This final rule does not address the government's responsibility to care for aliens or which aliens are, or should be, eligible to receive means-tested public benefits.
C. 对拟议规则表示总体反对意见的评论
C. Comments Expressing General Opposition to the Proposed Rule
评论意见:许多评论者对该规则表示总体反对。部分评论者表示该规则不公平、残酷无情或野蛮,称此前的贫困不应成为如今惩罚一个人的理由,每个人都应得到照顾和尊重对待。部分评论者不认同该规则的依据,评论称该规则不适合这个国家。一名评论者称该规则毫无意义,另一名评论者则表示该规则并无必要,且将对儿童产生负面影响。
Comment: Many commenters expressed general opposition to the rule. Some stated that the rule is unfair, cruel and inhumane or barbaric, that previous poverty is not a reason to penalize a person today, and that every human deserves to be cared for and treated respectfully. Some disagreed with the basis of the rule, commenting that the rule is not right for the country. One commenter called the rule pointless, with another stating the rule is unnecessary and would negatively impact children.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)强烈不同意该规则毫无意义、没有必要或不公平的说法。本规则的目的是废除2022年最终规则(87 FR 55472,2022年9月9日)所制定的公共负担不可入境条款,因为这些条款束缚了国土安全部官员作出与国会在《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中明确制定的福利与移民国家政策相一致的公共负担不可入境认定的能力。[22]2022年最终规则对成文法用语施加了狭隘的定义和最低限度因素,并限制了国土安全部在作出公共负担不可入境认定时可以考虑的公共福利范围,从而阻止官员按照国会的本意考虑与外国人在任何时候成为公共负担之可能性相关的所有因素和信息。参见90 FR 52168, 52185(2025年11月19日)。废止2022年最终规则使官员能够运用良好判断力和自由裁量权,更准确地评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性,考虑《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)(B)条、8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)所规定的强制性法定因素,外国人领取经济状况调查类公共福利的情况,与外国人案件相关的所有个案具体因素和情形,以及与外国人自给自足能力相关的任何经验数据。
Response: DHS strongly disagrees that the rule is pointless, unnecessary, or unfair. The purpose of this rule is to remove the public charge inadmissibility provisions promulgated by the 2022 Final Rule, 87 FR 55472 (Sept. 9, 2022), as these provisions straitjacketed DHS officers' ability to make public charge inadmissibility determinations that are consistent with Congress's express national policy on welfare and immigration enacted in the PRWORA.[22] The 2022 Final Rule imposed narrow definitions of statutory terms and minimum factors as well as limited the public benefits that DHS could consider in a public charge inadmissibility determination, preventing officers from considering all factors and information relevant to an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge, as Congress intended. See 90 FR 52168, 52185 (Nov. 19, 2025). Rescission of the 2022 Final Rule allows officers to more accurately assess an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge using good judgment and discretion, consider the mandatory statutory factors in section 212(a)(4)(B) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B), the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits, all individualized case-specific factors and circumstances relevant to an alien's case, and any empirical data relevant to an alien's self-sufficiency.
评论:一位评论者写道,拟议规则并不实际,而是出于恢复一种曾被公共卫生专家、州和地方政府以及倡导者广泛反对的惩罚性做法的愿望而推动的。
Comment: A commenter wrote that the proposed rule is not practical and instead driven by a desire to resurrect a punitive approach that was widely rejected by public health experts, State and local governments, and advocates.
回应:国土安全部拒绝接受其正在恢复2019年最终规则(84 FR 41292,2019年8月14日)中所采用的公共负担不可入境事由认定方式这一说法。正如其在《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中明确指出的那样,此前关于公共负担不可入境事由的法规过于严格。[23]通过废除(而非替换或修订)僵化的定义和因素,本最终规则将使官员能够在综合考量所有情形的基础上,考虑与公共负担不可入境认定相关的所有个案具体因素和情形。这反过来使官员能够更准确地评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性。国土安全部并未在本最终规则中实施2019年最终规则的条款。
Response: DHS rejects the suggestion that it is resurrecting the public charge ground of inadmissibility approach found in the 2019 Final Rule, 84 FR 41292 (Aug. 14, 2019). As it made clear in the NPRM, previous regulations relating to the public charge ground of inadmissibility were overly restrictive.[23] By removing (not replacing or amending) the rigid definitions and factors, this final rule will allow officers to consider all case-specific factors and circumstances relevant to the public charge inadmissibility determination, in the totality of the circumstances. This in turn enables officers to more accurately assess an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge. DHS is not implementing the provisions of the 2019 Final Rule in this final rule.
D. 关于法律权限和成文法条款的评论
D. Comments Regarding Legal Authority and Statutory Provisions
1. 成文法权限
1. Statutory Authority
评论:一位评论者指出,本规则旨在减少前往美国的移民人数,而这只能由国会通过立法来实现。
Comment: One commenter stated that this rule is intended to reduce immigration to the United States, which only Congress can do via statute.
回应:虽然本规则有可能减少被准许进入美国或在美国获准调整身份的外国人数量,正如本最终规则其他部分所解释的那样,由于成文法所要求的个案个别认定的性质,国土安全部无法量化这些影响。国土安全部强烈不同意其正在寻求超越其成文法权限来减少移民这一说法。虽然国会为某些移民和非移民签证类别设定了年度数量限制,但鉴于具体的资格标准和国会施加的其他限制(例如具体的不可入境事由),国会并未要求,也不切实际要求,必须充分用尽这些限额。参见例如INA第202、203、212和214条,8 U.S.C. 1152、1153、1182和1184。事实上,国会在某些情况下规定了移民签证的结转或重新分配。参见例如INA第201、203和206条,8 U.S.C. 1151、1153和1156。
Response: While it is possible this rule may decrease the number of aliens who will be admitted into or granted adjustment of status in the United States, as explained elsewhere in this final rule, DHS is unable to quantify those impacts due to the nature of the individualized case-by-case determination required by statute. DHS strongly disagrees that it is aiming to reduce immigration in excess of its statutory authority. While Congress established annual numerical limitations for certain immigrant and nonimmigrant visa classifications, Congress has not mandated, nor would it be practical to mandate, that these limits be fully utilized given specific eligibility criteria and other congressionally imposed restrictions, such as specific grounds of inadmissibility. See e.g., INA secs. 202, 203, 212 and 214; 8 U.S.C. 1152, 1153, 1182, and 1184. In fact, Congress provided for the rollover or reallocation of immigrant visas in certain circumstances. See e.g., INA sec. 201, 203, and 206, 8 U.S.C. 1151, 1153, and 1156.
公共负担不可入境事由的根本目的在于防止那些被官员认定为在任何时候都可能成为公共负担的外国人获得入境许可和身份调整。事实上,自1882年以来,国会一直明确决定限制此类外国人的入境。[24]就评论者不满该不可入境事由阻止某些外国人获得入境许可和身份调整而言,此类不满应向国会提出,而非美国国土安全部(DHS)。70多年前,国会即已认识到,由于构成公共负担的各项要素千差万别,确定外国人是否在任何时候都可能成为公共负担的具体标准最好交由行政部门和法院通过判断和解释加以确定。(第45332页)[25]倘若国会意图对“在任何时候都可能成为公共负担”作出最终定义,其本可在1882年[26]、1891年[27]、1903年[28]、1907年[29]、1917年[30]、1952年[31]、1990年[32]或1996年[33]制定移民成文法时予以规定。然而,纵观公共负担不可入境事由的整个历史,国会除在1996年提供了一份非穷尽性的必须考虑因素清单外,从未对行政部门作出公共负担不可入境认定的方式加以限制。
The very purpose of the public charge ground of inadmissibility is to prevent the admission and adjustment of status of aliens who are determined by an officer to be likely at any time to become a public charge. Indeed, since 1882, Congress has clearly decided to limit the admission of such aliens.[24] To the extent the commenter does not like that this ground of inadmissibility prevents the admission and adjustment of status of certain aliens, the complaint is for Congress, not DHS. More than 70 years ago Congress recognized that setting the parameters for determining whether an ( printed page 45332) alien is likely at any time to become a public charge is best left to the judgment and interpretation of the executive branch and the courts because the elements constituting public charge are so varied.[25] If Congress wanted to conclusively define what it means to be “likely at any time to become a public charge” it would have done so when enacting immigration statutes in 1882,[26] 1891,[27] 1903,[28] 1907,[29] 1917,[30] 1952,[31] 1990,[32] or 1996.[33] However, Congress, at no point during the history of the public charge inadmissibility ground, limited the manner in which the executive branch made public charge inadmissibility determinations save providing a non-exhaustive list of factors that must be considered, in 1996.
正如《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)及本最终规则所述,随着2022年最终规则的废止,美国国土安全部(DHS)正在取消一套僵化的监管框架,恢复官员更广泛的自由裁量权,从而确保那些被美国国土安全部认定为在任何时候都可能成为公共负担的外国人不会获得入境许可或身份调整,这正符合国会的本意。
As referenced in the NPRM and this final rule, with the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule DHS is eliminating a rigid regulatory framework and restoring broader officer discretion, which ensures that aliens whom DHS has determined are likely at any time to become a public charge are not admitted or granted adjustment of status, as Congress intended.
评论:多位评论者表示,本规则制定行为超出了国会在成文法中所授予的权力范围。另有评论者表示,废止2022年最终规则属于违法行为。
Comment: Several commenters said this rulemaking overreached the powers granted in the statute by Congress. Another said removal of the 2022 Final Rule is unlawful.
答复:美国国土安全部坚决不同意废止2022年最终规则属于违法行为或超出国会授予美国国土安全部的权力范围这一观点。部长发布本规则的权力来源于《移民与国籍法》(INA,8 U.S.C. 1101及其后条款)以及《国土安全法》(HSA)的多个条款。《国土安全法》第102条(6 U.S.C. 112)以及《移民与国籍法》第103条(8 U.S.C. 1103)均赋予部长负责管理和执行美国移民法律的职责。事实上,本次规则制定行为属于美国国土安全部依据《移民与国籍法》第103(a)(1)条(8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(1))所明确授予的执行和管理美国移民法律的职权范围之内,其中包括《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))所规定的公共负担不可入境事由。基于上述理由以及前文所述理由,废止2022年最终规则并未超出部长的职权范围。
Response: DHS strongly disagrees that the removal of the 2022 Final Rule is unlawful or goes beyond the powers granted to DHS by Congress. The Secretary's authority for issuing this rule is found in various sections of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1101 et seq., and the HSA. Section 102 of the HSA, 6 U.S.C. 112, and section 103 of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103, charge the Secretary with the administration and enforcement of the immigration laws of the United States. Indeed, this rulemaking is within DHS's express authority to enforce and administer the immigration laws of the United States, section 103(a)(1) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(1), including the public charge ground of inadmissibility, section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4). For these reasons as well as those discussed previously, the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule does not exceed the Secretary's authority.
以更广泛的逐案自由裁量方式取代2022年最终规则,是对国会制定的公共负担不可入境成文法的一种允许的实施方式。参见《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)。美国国土安全部认为,《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条和第212(a)(4)(B)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A)和(B))的明确文字表述、长期以来关于移民与福利的国家政策,以及数十年来指导公共负担不可入境认定的判例裁决,已为美国国土安全部官员作出公共负担不可入境认定提供了充分指引。
The removal of the 2022 Final Rule in favor of a broader exercise of discretion on a case-by-case basis is a permissible implementation of the public charge inadmissibility statute enacted by Congress. See INA sec. 212(a)(4), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4). DHS believes that the express language of sections 212(a)(4)(A) and (B) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A) and (B), the longstanding national policy on immigration and welfare, and the precedent decisions that have guided public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades provide sufficient guidance for DHS officers to make public charge inadmissibility determinations.
评论:部分评论者表示,《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))并未授权美国国土安全部考虑过去或现在领取非现金公共福利的情况,并补充指出,此类考虑将构成对成文法标准的不当扩大,并有损第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))的立法意图。另一位评论者同样表示,将公共负担的定义扩大至包括非现金福利,在《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))或判例裁决中均缺乏明确依据。
Comment: Some commenters stated that section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), does not authorize DHS to consider the past or present receipt of non-cash public benefits, and added that such consideration would constitute an impermissible expansion of the statutory criteria and undermine the intent of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4). Another commenter similarly stated that the expansion of the public charge definition to include non-cash benefits lacks a clear basis in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), or precedent decisions.
答复:国土安全部(DHS)未通过本次规则制定对“公共负担”或“公共福利”等术语进行定义。正如《通知与征求意见稿》(NPRM)中所提议的那样,国土安全部认为,在受益接受情况与评估外国人成为公共负担的可能性相关时,仍保留忽略某些经济状况调查类公共福利接受情况的法规规定,并非对该法规的最佳解读。因此,国土安全部正在废除2022年最终规则中的僵化规定,包括对公共负担不可入境性认定中可考虑的公共福利范围的限制,这些限制使移民官无法依照国会在《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中明确阐述的自给自足目标作出公共负担不可入境性认定。在公共负担不可入境性认定中考虑非现金公共福利,既未被《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条所禁止,也不与既往判例决定相抵触。[34]
Response: DHS is neither promulgating definitions for the terms “public charge” or “public benefits” through this rulemaking. As proposed in the NPRM, DHS believes that retaining regulations that disregard receipt of certain means-tested public benefits, when such receipt is relevant to assessing an alien's likelihood of becoming a public charge, is not the best reading of the statute. DHS is therefore removing the rigid provisions in the 2022 Final Rule, including limitations on what public benefits may be considered in a public charge inadmissibility determination, which prevented officers from making public charge inadmissibility determinations consistent with the clear self-sufficiency goals articulated by Congress in PRWORA. Consideration of non-cash public benefits in a public charge inadmissibility determination is neither precluded by section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), nor inconsistent with precedent decisions.[34]
事实上,国会在通过《1996年非法移民改革和移民责任法》(IIRIRA)时,增列了一份在公共负担不可入境性认定中应考虑的最低限度(但非排他性)因素清单,但并未排除对其他任何因素的考虑,包括外国人接受非现金公共福利的情况。《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(B)条,《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)(B)条。此外,国土安全部不认同国会在制定《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条时意图排除对非现金福利的考虑。国会在第212(a)(4)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条中根本未提及公共福利,而是将如何在公共负担不可入境性认定中考虑公共福利的问题留给负责执行公共负担不可入境事由的各机构自行规定。[35]然而,国会确实在《美国法典》第8编第1641(c)条中规定,对于某些受虐待的外国人,禁止考虑任何形式的公共福利,且并未区分现金与非现金福利,这有力地表明,国会理解并接受国土安全部在所有其他情形下对以往接受任何公共福利(无论现金或非现金)情况的考量。《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条,《美国法典》第8编第1182(s)条。国土安全部进一步不认同既往判例决定排除了对非现金福利的考虑这一观点。恰恰相反,正如数十年来指导公共负担不可入境性认定的既往判例决定所得出的结论,接受任何形式的公共支持均是公共负担不可入境性认定中应予考虑的适当因素。[36]
In fact, when passing the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996 (IIRIRA), Congress added a list of minimum, but not exclusive, factors to consider in public charge inadmissibility determinations but did not preclude consideration of any other factors including the alien's receipt of non-cash public benefits. INA sec. 212(a)(4)(B), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B). Moreover, DHS disagrees that Congress intended to exclude consideration of non-cash benefits when it enacted section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4). Congress does not mention public benefits at all in section 212(a)(4), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), leaving it to the agencies administering the public charge ground of inadmissibility [35] to specify how public benefits should be considered in a public charge inadmissibility determination. However, Congress did prohibit consideration of any public benefits under 8 U.S.C. 1641(c) for certain battered aliens, without reference to cash versus non-cash benefits, which strongly suggests Congress understood and accepted DHS's consideration of past receipt of any public benefits—cash and non-cash alike—in all other circumstances. INA sec. 212(s), 8 U.S.C. 1182(s). DHS further disagrees that precedent decisions preclude consideration of non-cash benefits. On the contrary, as concluded in past precedent decisions that have informed public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades, receipt of public support of any kind is an appropriate consideration in a public charge inadmissibility determination.[36]
意见:一位评论者指出,废除2022年最终规则违反了国土安全部公平、公正且不带歧视地执行移民法律的法定义务。
Comment: A commenter stated removal of 2022 Final Rule contradicts DHS's statutory obligation to administer immigration laws fairly, equitably, and without discrimination.
答复:国土安全部不认同此观点。如前所述,国土安全部有权执行(printed page 45333)并管理美国的移民法律,包括公共负担不可入境事由,并有权为履行该职权而制定必要的法规。《移民与国籍法》第103(a)(1)条,《美国法典》第8编第1103(a)(1)条,《移民与国籍法》第103(a)(3)条,《美国法典》第8编第1103(a)(3)条。通过废除部长认定为僵化、过度限制且未能最佳实施该法规的规定,国土安全部正将公共负担不可入境事由的执行恢复为依个案情况行使更广泛裁量权的方式,这既符合国会在移民与福利方面明确表达的国家政策,也契合《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条的精神。通过本次规则制定,国土安全部恢复了一项标准,即允许国土安全部官员在综合考量所有情形的基础上,考虑与评估每位外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性相关的任何及所有因素。[37]正如在其他意见答复中所讨论的,国土安全部不认同本最终规则中的任何变化会有招致歧视性决策的风险这一观点。
Response: DHS disagrees. As noted above, DHS has the authority to enforce ( printed page 45333) and administer the immigration laws of the United States, including the public charge ground of inadmissibility and to prescribe regulations necessary to carry out that authority. INA sec. 103(a)(1), 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(1), INA sec. 103(a)(3), 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3). By removing regulations that the Secretary determined are rigid, overly-restrictive, and not the best implementation of the statute, DHS is returning the administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility to a broader exercise of discretion on a case-by-case basis, consistent with Congress's express national policy on immigration and welfare and in line with the spirit of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4). With this rulemaking, DHS returns to a standard which permits DHS officers to consider any and all factors, in the totality of the circumstances, relevant to each individual alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge.[37] As discussed in other comment responses, DHS disagrees any changes in this final rule risk inviting discriminatory decision-making.
评论:一位评论者引用Loper Bright诉Raimondo案,[38]指出,即便是国会明确授权行政机构实施的制定法,如《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条、8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4),对其进行“法律解释”也是一项司法职能,应依据“传统的制定法解释工具”进行,而非依据行政部门的“政策偏好”,并补充说该制定法具有固定的、唯一的最佳含义,必须由法院(而非仅由最高法院)解释,并由行政机构加以实施。该评论者表示,国土安全部(DHS)错误地将制定法含义仅仅视为一种监管选择,并将“主要依赖政府维持生计”错误地描述为一项“明确界限的......标准”,而非承认这是该制定法的唯一最佳含义。另一位评论者指出,本规则存在与导致法院在更为宽松的Chevron框架[39]下禁止实施2019年最终规则相同的缺陷,并补充说Loper Bright案要求行政机构采用对制定法的最佳解读,并主张现行监管框架即便不是最佳解读,也反映了一种更好的解读。另一位评论者引用Loper Bright案,指出如果行政当局以违背制定法明文含义、历史及传统的方式解释制定法,则不应获得任何尊让。另一位评论者表示,国土安全部在界定“公共负担”一词时,并不拥有违背国会意图的不受约束的权力、职权或灵活性。
Comment: One commenter, citing Loper Bright v. Raimondo ,[38] stated that “legal interpretation” of statutes—even statutes Congress expressly authorized agencies to implement, like section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)—is a judicial function driven by “traditional tools of statutory interpretation,” not the “policy preferences” of the Executive, adding the statute has a fixed, single best meaning which courts (and not the Supreme Court alone) must interpret and agencies must implement. The commenter said DHS mistakenly treats statutory meaning merely as a regulatory choice and mischaracterizes “primary dependence on the government for subsistence” as a “bright-line . . . standard” rather than acknowledging it is the statute's single best meaning. Another commenter indicated the rule suffers from the same defects which led courts to enjoin the 2019 Final Rule under the more deferential Chevron [39] framework, adding that Loper Bright requires agencies to adopt a statute's best reading and asserted the existing regulatory framework reflects a better, if not the best reading. Another cited to Loper Bright, stating the Administration is not entitled to any deference when interpreting a statute in a way that is contrary to its plain meaning, history, and tradition. Another commenter said DHS does not have unchecked power, authority, or flexibility in defining the term public charge contrary to congressional intent.
回应:最高法院在Loper Bright案中裁定,法院不再需要对行政机构对含糊制定法作出的“合理”解释给予尊让。国土安全部强烈不同意评论者关于废止2022年最终规则仅仅是一项政策决定的说法。恰恰相反,这是部长认定2022年最终规则并非对该制定法以及国会在移民与福利方面的意图的最佳解读的直接结果。如公告拟议规则制定(NPRM)中所述,国土安全部撤销2022年最终规则,旨在恢复国会在要求官员根据若干列举的、非穷尽性因素,至少依其本人意见作出公共负担不可入境性认定时,明确意图采用的长期以来逐案审查且固有裁量性质的做法。见90 FR 52168, 52189(2025年11月19日)。《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(B)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)。部长认定,为确保官员依照制定法及相关判例作出公共负担不可入境性认定,废止2022年最终规则是适当的。见90 FR 52168, 52186-87(2025年11月19日)。国土安全部认为,数十年来指导公共负担不可入境性认定的相关判例裁决,以及在适用情形下的近期巡回法院判例,将为官员依据每个外国人案件的具体事实和情况进行个案判断提供充分指引。国土安全部认为,这一做法属于国会授予部长的明确裁量权范围之内。[40]因此,国土安全部废止2022年最终规则,并随后依照制定法及适用判例管理公共负担不可入境性事由,完全属于部长职权范围之内。这也符合国会在《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中制定的关于福利与移民的明确国家政策。参见8 U.S.C. 1601。因此,本最终规则并不体现违背国会意图的不受约束的权力行使或未经授权的灵活性运用。
Response: The Supreme Court in Loper Bright held that courts are no longer required to defer to an agency's “reasonable” interpretations of ambiguous statutes. DHS strongly disagrees with the commenters' suggestion that rescission of the 2022 Final Rule is simply a policy decision. On the contrary, it is a direct result of the Secretary's determination that the 2022 Final Rule is not the best reading of the statute, as well as congressional intent on immigration and welfare. As noted in the NPRM, DHS is removing the 2022 Final Rule to restore the longstanding case-by-case and inherently discretionary nature of public charge inadmissibility determinations expressly intended by Congress when mandating officers make these determinations in their opinion considering certain enumerated non-exhaustive factors at a minimum. 90 FR 52168, 52189 (Nov. 19, 2025). INA sec. 212(a)(4)(B), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B). The Secretary determined rescission of the 2022 Final Rule is appropriate to ensure officers are making public charge inadmissibility determinations in line with the statute and relevant precedent. 90 FR 52168, 52186-87 (Nov. 19, 2025). DHS believes relevant precedent decisions that guided public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades and, where applicable, recent circuit case law will provide officers with sufficient guidance to conduct individualized determinations based on the specific facts and circumstances of each alien's case. DHS believes this approach falls within the explicit discretionary authority Congress delegated to the Secretary.[40] Therefore, DHS's rescission of the 2022 Final Rule, and subsequent administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility consistent with the statute and applicable precedent, is well within the Secretary's authority. It is also consistent with Congress's express national policy on welfare and immigration enacted in PRWORA. See8 U.S.C. 1601. Therefore, this final rule does not reflect an exercise of unchecked power or unauthorized flexibility contrary to congressional intent.
最后,国土安全部(DHS)不同意本最终规则正在对“公共负担”一词进行解释的说法,也不同意任何此类解释有悖于其字面含义、历史或传统的说法。如前文提议和讨论的那样,本最终规则并未对“公共负担”一词提出任何定义。如《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中所述,该术语并无单一确定的含义,法院对该术语所涵盖的范围,以及国土安全部在作出公共负担不可入境性认定时可以考虑哪些因素,一直存在不同立场。[41]国土安全部并不否认最高法院已责成各法院确定含糊法规的最佳含义,也不否认多家联邦法院对该术语给出了不同的含义。国土安全部在运作国家移民制度的过程中,并不被禁止取消那些未被明确或一致地认定为反映法定术语最佳含义的监管定义和僵化框架,尤其是在国会就移民事务及公共负担不可入境性事由(印刷页45334)向国土安全部授予广泛裁量权的情况下。国土安全部正在将公共负担不可入境性事由的管理恢复为数十年来的机构惯例,这符合制定法和具有约束力的判例。
Finally, DHS disagrees that it is interpreting the term “public charge” in this final rule, or that any such interpretation is contrary to its plain meaning, history, or tradition. As proposed and discussed previously, this final rule is putting forth no definition of the term “public charge.” As discussed in the NPRM, there is no single settled meaning of the term and courts have differed in their positions regarding what the term encompasses, as well as what DHS can consider when making public charge inadmissibility determinations.[41] DHS does not dispute that the Supreme Court has tasked courts with ascertaining the best meaning of ambiguous statutes or that a number of federal courts found different meanings for the term. DHS, in operating the national immigration system, is not precluded from eliminating regulatory definitions and rigid frameworks that have not been definitively or uniformly endorsed as reflecting the best meaning of statutory terms, particularly where Congress delegated broad discretion to DHS over immigration and the public charge ( printed page 45334) ground of inadmissibility. DHS is returning the administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility to decades of agency practice, consistent with statute and binding precedent.
评论意见:一位评论者表示,国土安全部在拟议规则中行使的权力“异乎寻常的广泛”,再加上该行动的经济重要性,也使拟议规则面临《西弗吉尼亚州诉美国环境保护署案》项下“重大问题原则”的担忧。[42]该评论者警告称,法院将对国会有意向国土安全部授予如此程度的政治和经济权力这一结论持怀疑态度,并写道:“依靠行政命令来制定脱离法定文本和机构裁量权的政策,已在本届政府执政期间引发了关于机构行为是预先设定的指控。”
Comment: A commenter stated that the “extraordinary breadth” of authority DHS exerts with the proposed rule, coupled with the economic significance of the action, also opens the proposed rule to major questions doctrine concerns under West Virginia v. EPA.[42] The commenter warned that courts would be skeptical to conclude Congress meant to confer this level of political and economic authority to DHS, writing that “reliance on Executive Orders to enact policy unmoored from statutory text and agency discretion has given rise to claims during this Administration that agency action is preordained.”
回应:国土安全部不同意本最终规则涉及《西弗吉尼亚州诉美国环境保护署案》所阐明的重大问题原则的说法。重大问题原则仅在机构声称拥有具有重大经济和政治意义的监管权力,且所主张的权力缺乏明确的国会授权时才会触发。[43]
Response: DHS disagrees that this final rule implicates the major questions doctrine as articulated in West Virgina v. EPA. The major questions doctrine is triggered when the agency claims regulatory authority of vast economic and political significance, and the asserted authority lacks clear congressional authorization.[43]
首先,国土安全部对本最终规则拥有明确的国会授权。如本序言通篇所述,《移民与国籍法》(INA)规定,如果“领事官员或司法部长(现为国土安全部部长)认为”外国人在任何时候都可能成为公共负担,则该外国人不可入境。《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A)。法定文本并未对“公共负担”或“任何时候都可能成为公共负担”作出定义,仅要求官员考虑一份非穷尽性的若干最低限度因素清单。最高法院长期以来一直承认,政治部门对外国人的入境拥有全权权力。[44]移民上诉委员会(BIA)也一再承认公共负担不可入境性认定具有内在的裁量性质。[45]这一法定结构体现了国会向部长作出的明确授权、明确的裁量性措辞(“认为”),以及强制性但非穷尽性的若干因素。与《西弗吉尼亚州诉美国环境保护署案》或《拜登诉内布拉斯加州案》[46]所涉及的法规不同,国会并未指派一项国土安全部已将其转变为大规模经济监管的狭窄技术性职能。相反,国会在移民不可入境性这一背景下赋予了国土安全部广泛的裁量权。与机构主张扩大权力或声称拥有变革性新监管权力的案件不同,在本最终规则中,国土安全部所做的恰恰相反:它正在废除2022年通过的僵化监管定义,恢复符合法规字面语言的个案化、裁量性裁决,并回归长期以来的情况整体考量分析方法。这种行政调整正处于国会授权的精确领域之内,即移民准入许可事务。
First, DHS has clear congressional authorization for this final rule. As discussed throughout this preamble, the INA provides that an alien is inadmissible if, “in the opinion of the consular officer or the Attorney General” (now the Secretary of Homeland Security), the alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. INA sec. 212(a)(4)(A), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A). The statutory text does not define public charge or likely at any time to become a public charge and only requires officers to consider a non-exhaustive list of specified minimum factors. The Supreme Court has long recognized that the political branches possess plenary authority over admission of aliens.[44] And the Board of Immigration Appeals (BIA) repeatedly recognized the inherently discretionary nature of the public charge inadmissibility determinations.[45] This statutory structure reflects an express delegation from Congress to the Secretary, explicit discretionary language (“in the opinion of”), and mandatory but non-exhaustive factors. Unlike the statutes at issue in West Virgina v. EPA, or Biden v. Nebraska ,[46] Congress did not assign a narrow, technical function that DHS has transformed into sweeping economic regulation. Congress instead gave DHS broad discretion in an immigration inadmissibility context. Unlike cases where agencies argued for an expansion of authority or claimed transformative new regulatory powers, in this final rule DHS is doing the opposite: it is rescinding rigid regulatory definitions adopted in 2022; restoring individualized, discretionary adjudications that track the plain language of the statute; and returning to long-standing totality of the circumstances analysis. This administrative calibration is within the precise domain Congress delegated: immigration admissibility.
此外,本最终规则的经济影响本身并不足以触发重大问题原则(major questions doctrine)。监管影响分析(RIA)估算了与公共福利退出相关的潜在转移效应,这是本最终规则的间接影响。但最高法院已明确表示,仅凭经济影响本身并不足以触发该原则。在西弗吉尼亚州诉美国环境保护署案(West Virginia v. EPA)中,最高法院强调,该原则适用于机构以与其法定设计不一致的方式,声称拥有作出具有“重大经济和政治意义”的决定的权力的情形。[47] 可入境性认定可能影响外国人退出公共福利项目的决定,而这正属于美国国土安全部(DHS)法定职权范围之内。重要的是,本最终规则并未试图规范公共福利资格;相反,公共福利资格仍受《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法案》(PRWORA)及其他法律管辖。任何经济影响均是国会明确授权DHS作出的可入境性认定所产生的附带影响。最后,鉴于最高法院一再强调政治部门在准许入境和排除方面拥有广泛权力,[48] 移民事务是行政权力高度集中的领域。本最终规则涉及入境资格和身份调整,但并未更广泛地规范外国人或公民的行为,也未重塑国内产业结构。
Furthermore, the economic impact of this final rule does not alone trigger the major questions doctrine. The Regulatory Impact Analysis (RIA) estimates potential transfer effects related to public benefits disenrollment, which is an indirect impact of the final rule. But the Supreme Court has made clear economic impact alone does not trigger the doctrine. In West Virginia v. EPA, the Court emphasized the doctrine applies when agencies claim the power to make decisions of “vast economic and political significance” in a manner inconsistent with their statutory design.[47] Admissibility determinations, which could impact aliens' decisions to disenroll from public benefits programs, are squarely within DHS's statutory domain. Importantly, this final rule does not purport to regulate public benefit eligibility; rather, public benefits eligibility remains governed by PRWORA and other statutes. Any economic effects are incidental to admissibility determinations Congress explicitly authorized DHS to make. Finally, immigration is an area of heightened executive authority given that the Supreme Court repeatedly emphasized the political branches' broad authority over admission and exclusion.[48] This final rule pertains to admission eligibility and adjustment of status, but it does not more broadly regulate aliens' or citizens' conduct or restructure domestic industries.
最后,本最终规则并未体现机构权力的变革性扩张,它仅涉及DHS正在调整的现有授权权力,以更贴近法规的字面含义、关于外国人自给自足的国家政策以及长期以来的机构惯例。
Finally, this final rule does not reflect a transformative expansion of agency power, it simply implicates existing delegated authority that DHS is tailoring to more closely reflect the plain language of the statute, national policy on self-sufficiency of aliens, and longstanding agency practice.
评论意见:一位评论者援引《移民与国籍法》(INA)第103(a)(3)条,即8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3),指出DHS在未颁布替代法规的情况下撤销公共负担法规的做法,与INA不一致,因为INA明确规定部长“应制定其认为对履行本章规定项下职权所必需的此类法规……”。
Comment: Citing section 103(a)(3) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3), a commenter remarked DHS's choice to rescind the public charge regulations without promulgating a replacement regulation is inconsistent with the INA, which explicitly provides that the Secretary “shall establish such regulations . . . as he deems necessary for carrying out his authority under the provisions of this chapter.”
回应意见:DHS不同意其有义务颁布法规以替代被撤销的2022年最终规则,并指出鉴于此前对该法规的解释并非最佳解释,本次制定规则是DHS对公共负担不可入境性认定方式作出的可允许的改变。90 FR 52168,52185页(2025年11月19日)。相反,尽管《行政程序法》(APA)规定了机构在颁布、修订和废止法规时必须遵循的程序,但并未要求机构在废止法规后必须予以替代。5 U.S.C. 551条及其后各条。事实上,只要机构提供合理的理由说明,[49] 即可变更或废止法规,但除非法律另有要求,否则机构并无义务替代被废止的法规。INA第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)的明文规定中,并无任何内容要求DHS以新规则替代被废止的2022年最终规则。此外,DHS指出,自1882年至2019年最终规则颁布之前,并无任何法规规范公共负担不可入境性认定。
Response: DHS disagrees that it is required to promulgate a regulation to replace the rescinded 2022 Final Rule and notes this rulemaking is a permissible change in the manner in which DHS makes public charge inadmissibility determinations given prior interpretations of the statute were not the best interpretation. 90 FR 52168, 52185 (Nov. 19, 2025). On the contrary, while the Administrative Procedure Act (APA) mandates the process agencies must follow when issuing, amending, and rescinding regulations, it does not require agencies to replace a rescinded regulation. 5 U.S.C. 551 et seq. Indeed, an agency may change or rescind regulations as long as it provides a reasoned justification,[49] but it is not required to replace a rescinded regulation unless required by law. There is nothing in the express language of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), requiring DHS to replace the rescinded 2022 Final Rule with a new rule. Further, DHS notes there were no regulations governing public charge inadmissibility determinations from 1882 until the 2019 Final Rule.
尽管这与自1999年以来确立的框架相比是一项变化,但DHS强调,其已在NPRM(拟议规则制定通知)以及本最终规则全文中,就撤销2022年最终规则提供了合理的理由说明,并解释了此前框架存在的不足之处。[50] 这一立场与评论者所援引的INA第103(a)(3)条,即8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3)的字面含义相符,该条款通过纳入“其认为对履行职权所必需”这一措辞,赋予部长在颁布法规方面既有权力又有裁量权。在本案中,部长已认定颁布替代法规对履行其职权而言并非必要。因此,DHS将不会颁布替代规则。
Although this is a change from the frameworks established since 1999, DHS emphasizes that it provided a reasoned justification for the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule in the NPRM and throughout this final rule, as well as an explanation as to why prior frameworks were lacking.[50] This position aligns with the plain language of section 103(a)(3) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3), which the commenter cites—which by incorporating the phrase “as he deems necessary for carrying out his authority” grants the Secretary both authority and discretion over issuing regulations. In this case, the Secretary has determined that issuing replacement regulations is not necessary for carrying out his authority. Therefore, DHS will not issue a replacement rule.
评论意见:一些评论者表示,DHS强调公共负担不可入境性认定具有主观性质的做法,与INA相矛盾,因为INA将裁量权授予司法部长(Attorney General),而非DHS(见第45335页)。具体而言,评论者认为,与公共负担不可入境性认定相关的只应是司法部长的意见,而非DHS个别官员的意见。
Comment: Some commenters said DHS's emphasis on the subjective nature of the public charge inadmissibility determination contradicts the INA, which vests ( printed page 45335) discretionary authority with the Attorney General, not DHS. Specifically, the commenter suggests that it is only the opinion of the Attorney General, not the opinion of an individual DHS officer, that is relevant to public charge inadmissibility determinations.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)不同意评论者对国土安全部制定法律授权的解读。2003年3月1日,移民归化局(INS)的职能由司法部(DOJ)移交至国土安全部(DHS)。[51]尽管本最终规则中讨论的《移民与国籍法》(INA)若干条款仅提及“总检察长”,但根据《国土安全法》(HSA)的规定,此类条款现应理解为指国土安全部部长。[52]国土安全部不认同这样一种观点,即在外国人申请入境或身份调整时,就公共负担不可入境性认定而言,只有总检察长(现为部长)的意见才具有相关性。国会深知总检察长和部长会将《移民与国籍法》中的各项权力下放给其所属官员。[53]国土安全部指出,《移民与国籍法》第212(a)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a))中规定的任何不可入境事由均未使用提及国土安全部或司法部官员的措辞;在该条款全文中,国会提及的是领事官员、总检察长或部长。国土安全部还指出,《移民与国籍法》第245(a)条(8 U.S.C. 1255(a))规定,外国人的身份“可由总检察长酌情”调整为合法永久居民身份。国会深知总检察长不可能每年亲自作出数百万份关于入境资格、身份调整、入境许可和驱逐出境的决定。
Response: DHS disagrees with the commenters' interpretations of DHS' statutory authority. On March 1, 2003, functions of the Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS) were transferred from the Department of Justice (DOJ) to DHS.[51] Although several provisions of the INA discussed in this final rule refer exclusively to the “Attorney General,” such provisions are now read as referring to the Secretary by operation of the HSA.[52] DHS rejects the suggestion that only the Attorney General's (now, the Secretary's) opinion is relevant in the context of a public charge inadmissibility determination when an alien applies for admission or adjustment of status. Congress understood that the Attorney General and Secretary delegate authorities throughout the INA to officials serving under them.[53] DHS notes that no ground of inadmissibility in section 212(a) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a), contains language referencing DHS or DOJ officers; throughout the section, Congress referred to consular officers, the Attorney General, or the Secretary. DHS also notes that section 245(a) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1255(a), states that the status of an alien “may be adjusted by the Attorney General, in his discretion” to that of an LPR. Congress knew that the Attorney General would not personally make millions of admissibility, adjustment of status, admission, and deportation decisions annually.
评论:一位评论者认为该规则缺乏正当理由,因为国土安全部未能指明1999年之后或2022年之后存在任何移民归化局、公民及移民服务局(USCIS)或国土安全部其他部门或前身机构尚未考虑过的相关法律、数据或经验,足以证明此项变更的合理性。该评论者要求国土安全部说明并列明其在制定新框架时所依据的法律授权及其他信息,且该等信息须有别于1999年临时现场指南和2022年最终规则所依据的信息。
Comment: One commenter suggested that the rule is unjustified because DHS does not identify relevant post-1999 or post-2022 laws, data, or experience not already considered by INS, USCIS, or any other component or predecessor of DHS that would justify this change. The commenter requested that DHS identify and describe the legal authorities and other information, apart from those that predated the 1999 Interim Field Guidance and the 2022 Final Rule, that DHS relied on in developing a new framework.
回应:国土安全部撤销2022年最终规则并恢复以个案为基础更广泛地行使自由裁量权,其所依据的制定法、授权及其他资源,与当初作为2022年最终规则依据和理由的制定法、授权及资源相同。国土安全部不认同该评论者关于国土安全部不能依据此前已考虑过的授权依据这一观点。
Response: DHS's rescission of the 2022 Final Rule and return to a broader exercise of case-by-case discretion is based on the same statutes, authorities, and other resources that served as the basis and justification for the 2022 Final Rule. DHS rejects this commenter's suggestion that DHS cannot rely on previously considered authorities.
相反,只要国土安全部能就得出不同结论作出合理说明,且国土安全部已作出此种说明,并且新方法与《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))的字面含义相符,国土安全部即可依据已撤销的2022年最终规则所依据的相同授权。[54]国土安全部已说明此项变更以及国土安全部为何认为这是对该法规更为妥当的解读。如本文其他评论回应中所述,国土安全部拥有明确的授权来执行和管理美国移民法律,包括公共负担不可入境事由,并从《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))的明文规定、《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中关于移民政策和福利的国家声明,以及《关于拟议规则制定的通知》(NPRM)中列明的各项资料来源中,为本规则找到支持依据。参见90 FR 52168, 52181-82(2025年11月19日)。
On the contrary, DHS may rely on the same authorities underlying the now rescinded 2022 Final Rule so long as DHS provides a reasoned explanation for coming to a different conclusion, which it has, and as long as the new approach is consistent with the plain language of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4).[54] DHS explained the change and why DHS believes it to be a better reading of the statute. As explained in other comment responses, DHS has the express authority to enforce and administer the immigration laws of the United States, including the public charge ground of inadmissibility, and finds support for this rule in the express language of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), the national statements of immigration policy and welfare in PRWORA, and the sources listed in the NPRM. See 90 FR 52168, 52181-82 (Nov. 19, 2025).
评论:评论者指出,国土安全部援引《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(s))来支持其主张,即国会意图在除某些受虐待外国人之外的所有情形下均考虑既往福利领取情况,这一论点存在缺陷。一位评论者表示,《反对妇女暴力法》(VAWA)相关条款虽广泛论及福利,但并不支持国土安全部所称国会意图令国土安全部考虑1999年临时现场指南所考虑范围之外的福利领取情况这一主张。另一位评论者表示,《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条(8 U.S.C. 1182(s))的措辞并非要求必须考虑所有基于经济状况审查的公共福利的明文规定,并称该提议“尤其值得怀疑”,因为国会已多次扩大了针对特定外国人的公共福利项目。
Comment: Commenters stated that DHS's reliance on section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s), to support its argument that Congress intended consideration of past benefit receipt in all contexts outside of certain battered aliens is flawed. One commenter said the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA) provisions speak broadly about benefits but do not support DHS's contention that Congress intended DHS to consider receipt of benefits beyond those considered in the 1999 Interim Field Guidance. Another commenter said the language in section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s), is not an express command to consider all means-tested public benefits, calling the proposal “particularly dubious” because Congress repeatedly expanded public benefit programs for certain aliens.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)不认同《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(s)条,即《美国法典》第8编第1182(s)条,不支持在根据本最终规则作出的公共负担不可入境性认定中考虑外国人领取任何基于经济状况调查的公共福利这一观点。《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条,即《美国法典》第8编第1182(s)条,[55]禁止在移民签证申请和身份调整申请中考虑某些暴力和贩运受害者领取福利的情况,制定该条款是为确保此类人员能够获得恢复及配合执法所需的全部支持服务,包括医疗保健、住房、食品援助以及其他非现金福利。[56]国会明确排除对该类人群领取福利情况的考虑这一事实有力地表明,若无此类例外规定,国会本意是要求国土安全部在其他外国人申请移民签证和身份调整时考虑其领取福利的情况。“凡国会在同一法案的一节中列入特定语言而在另一节中予以省略的,通常推定国会的此种差异性列入或省略系出于有意且有目的的行为。”[57]同样,当国会为一般规则设立特定例外时,可推定国会意图使该一般规则适用于所有其他情形。[58]因此,《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条,即《美国法典》第8编第1182(s)条,反映出国会理解到,除非有明确豁免,否则外国人领取任何基于经济状况调查的公共福利的情况将在其他所有移民签证和身份调整申请中予以考虑。
Response: DHS disagrees that section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s), does not support considering the alien's receipt of any means-tested public benefit in public charge inadmissibility determinations made under this final rule. Section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s),[55] prohibits considering the receipt of benefits by certain victims of violence and trafficking in applications for immigrant visas and adjustment of status and was codified to ensure they could access the full range of support services necessary for recovery and cooperation with law enforcement, including healthcare, housing, food assistance, and other non-cash benefits.[56] The fact that Congress expressly precluded the consideration of receipt of benefits by this population strongly suggests that, absent such an exception, Congress intended DHS to consider the receipt of benefits when other aliens applied for immigrant visas and adjustment of status. “`Where Congress includes particular language in one section of a statute but omits it in another section of the same Act, it is generally presumed that Congress acts intentionally and purposely in the disparate inclusion or exclusion.' ” [57] Similarly, when Congress creates a specific exception to a general rule, it is presumed that Congress intended the general rule to apply in all other circumstances.[58] Accordingly, section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s), reflects that Congress understood that unless expressly exempted, an alien's receipt of any means-tested public benefits would be considered in all other applications for immigrant visas and adjustment of status.
如《立法提案公告》(NPRM)中所述,《移民与国籍法》第212(s)条(即《美国法典》第8编第1182(s)条)中的“福利”一词应被正确解释为(印刷页第45336页)既包括基于经济状况调查的现金公共福利,也包括基于经济状况调查的非现金公共福利,因为国会并未如评论者所称那样将福利限定为用于维持收入的现金援助,而是使用了宽泛的“福利”一词。见《联邦公报》第90卷第52168页,第52187页(2025年11月19日)。此外,国会交叉引用了《美国法典》第8编第1641(c)条,该条将联邦公共福利定义为“由美国某一机构提供或以美国拨款资金提供的任何拨款、合同、贷款、专业执照或商业执照;以及……由美国某一机构或以美国拨款资金向个人、住户或家庭资格单位提供付款或援助的任何退休金、福利救济、医疗保健、残障、公共或资助性住房、高等教育、食品援助、失业福利,或任何其他类似福利”,显然同时包括现金和非现金福利。见《美国法典》第8编第1611条和第1641(c)条。此种不加限制性措辞的情形,结合国会意图为受害者提供全面支持的立法本意,表明该豁免适用于一切形式的公共援助,而不仅限于现金福利。鉴于国会对此类受害者禁止考虑福利的规定应被正确解释为同时涵盖基于经济状况调查的现金福利和非现金福利,国土安全部认为,在根据本最终规则进行的公共负担不可入境性认定中,对所有其他案件考虑领取基于经济状况调查的现金福利和非现金福利两者均属适当。
As noted in the NPRM, the term benefits in section 212(s) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(s), is properly interpreted as ( printed page 45336) including both cash means-tested public benefits and non-cash means-tested public benefits since Congress did not limit benefits to cash assistance for income maintenance as the commenters suggest; it used the broad term “benefits.” 90 FR 52168, 52187 (Nov. 19, 2025). Additionally, Congress cross-referenced 8 U.S.C. 1641(c), which defines Federal public benefits as “any grant, contract, loan, professional license, or commercial license provided by an agency of the United States or by appropriated funds of the United States; and . . . any retirement, welfare, health, disability, public or assisted housing, postsecondary education, food assistance, unemployment benefit, or any other similar benefit for which payments or assistance are provided to an individual, household, or family eligibility unit by an agency of the United States or by appropriated funds of the United States,” clearly including both cash and non-cash benefits. 8 U.S.C. 1611 and 1641(c). The absence of limiting language, combined with Congress's intent to provide comprehensive support to victims, demonstrates that the exemption applies to all forms of public assistance, not just cash benefits. As Congress's prohibition on consideration of benefits for these victims is properly interpreted to include both cash and non-cash means-tested public benefits, DHS believes that it is proper to consider the receipt of both cash and non-cash means-tested public benefits for all other cases as part of the public charge inadmissibility determination under this final rule.
评论意见:一位评论者表示担忧,国土安全部依赖源自1882年《移民法》的一系列陈旧移民法规来为更严格的政策进行辩护,并指出这代表着一种不合理的倒退,与国会在《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条(即《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条)中制定的量身定制框架相冲突。
Comment: A commenter expressed concern that DHS is relying on a series of decades-old immigration statutes originating from the 1882 Immigration Act to justify stricter policies, stating that this represents an unjustifiable regression that conflicts with Congress's tailored framework in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4).
回应:国土安全部(DHS)不同意其在为本最终规则辩护时不当依赖数十年前的移民法规这一说法。国土安全部指出,如同在《拟议规则制定通知》中详细阐述的那样,现行的公共负担不准入事由深深植根于最早的移民法律之中。见90 FR 52168, 52174-52180 (2025年11月19日)。国土安全部在本规则制定中对公共负担不准入事由的解释和适用,正确地以该条款一个多世纪以来的历史沿革、移民与国籍法(INA)第212(a)(4)条即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)的现行法律文本、相关判例法,以及国会就移民与福利问题所作的明确国家政策声明为依据。凡国会未对法律框架作出实质性修改之处,国土安全部的职责即为按照法律条文予以执行。依据公共负担不准入事由的历史和现行法律框架是具有法律正当性的。
Response: DHS disagrees that it is impermissibly relying on decades-old immigration statutes to justify this final rule. DHS notes that the public charge ground of inadmissibility as it exists today has deep roots in the earliest immigration laws, as explained in detail in the NPRM. 90 FR 52168, 52174-52180 (Nov. 19, 2025). DHS's interpretation and application of the public charge inadmissibility ground in this rulemaking is properly guided by the more than centuries-old history of this provision, the current statutory language at section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), relevant case law, and Congress's express statements of national policy with respect to immigration and welfare. Where Congress has not materially altered the statutory framework, DHS is tasked with implementing the statute as written. Reliance on the historical and current statutory framework for the public charge ground of inadmissibility is legally appropriate.
2. 国会意图与历史适用情况
2. Congressional Intent and Historical Application
评论:有评论者表示支持拟议规则,称该规则更好地体现了国会意图。特别是,一位评论者表示,2022年最终规则中的定义过于僵化,人为缩小了所考虑的公共福利类别,并违背了国会关于移民政策应阻止依赖公共资源的意图。另一位评论者表示,该规则使决策过程恢复为一种更为平衡、符合常理的方法,即可以考虑所有情况的整体,而不仅仅是一两个因素。
Comment: Commenters expressed support for the proposed rule, stating that the rule better reflects congressional intent. In particular, one commenter stated that the definitions in the 2022 Final Rule were too rigid, artificially narrowed categories of public benefits considered, and frustrated Congress's intent that immigration policy discourage dependence on public resources. Another commenter stated that the rule returns the decision-making process to a more balanced, common-sense approach where the totality of the circumstances, not just one or two factors, may be considered.
回应:国土安全部指出,2022年最终规则强调必须考虑的是七个因素,而非评论者所称的一两个因素。然而,国土安全部在其他方面同意这些评论者的意见;本最终规则更好地体现了国会意图。首先,该评论者所言不差:2022年最终规则不当地限制了国土安全部官员依照国会在《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中所制定的关于福利与移民的明确国家政策作出公共负担不准入认定的能力。见8 U.S.C. 1601。其次,国土安全部同意,2022年最终规则阻止了国土安全部官员按照国会的意图,考虑与外国人在任何时候可能成为公共负担的可能性相关的所有因素和信息。事实上,2022年最终规则建立了一个框架,在该框架下,官员仅限于考虑七个因素(其中五个为法定要求),而非被明确授权在外国人整体情况中考虑与判定外国人在任何时候成为公共负担之可能性相关的任何其他因素或信息。[59]因此,国土安全部同意,为遵循国会意图,取消这些限制性规定是至关重要的。[60]
Response: DHS notes that the 2022 Final Rule emphasized seven factors that must be considered, not one or two factors as the commenter indicated. However, DHS agrees otherwise with these commenters; this final rule better reflects congressional intent. First, the commenter is correct that the 2022 Final Rule unduly limited DHS officers' ability to make public charge inadmissibility determinations consistent with Congress's express national policy on welfare and immigration enacted in PRWORA. See8 U.S.C. 1601. Second, DHS agrees that the 2022 Final Rule prevented DHS officers from considering all factors and information relevant to an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge, as Congress intended. Indeed, the 2022 Final Rule created a framework under which officers were limited to considering seven factors (five required by statute) rather than being explicitly empowered to consider any other factors or information relevant to determining an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge in the totality of the alien's circumstances.[59] As a result, DHS agrees that it is essential to remove these limiting regulations in order to follow congressional intent.[60]
国土安全部还同意,尽管国会确定了官员必须考虑的五项最低因素,但国会的意图,以及法院所认可的做法是,在判定外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性时,应考虑外国人个人情况的整体,而非僵化数量的监管因素。尽管该法规并未明确包含整体情况考量测试,但该测试“已在多项移民归化局、移民上诉委员会及司法部长的决定中得以发展,并已被编入移民局实施1986年《移民改革与控制法》合法化条款的相关法规之中。”[61]联邦法院也认可这一“整体情况”测试。[62]因此,在2019年最终规则和2022年最终规则出台之前,官员在作出公共负担不准入认定时,一直考虑所有事实和情况的整体。根据本最终规则,国土安全部将依照过往的先例裁定继续这样做。[63]
DHS also agrees that while Congress identified five minimum factors officers must consider, Congress intended, and the courts have endorsed, that the totality of an individual alien's circumstances, not a rigid number of regulatory factors, should be taken into consideration when determining an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge. Although the statute does not expressly include a totality of the circumstances test, this test “has been developed in several Service, BIA, and Attorney General decisions and has been codified in the Service regulations implementing the legalization provisions of the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986.” [61] Federal courts have also endorsed this “totality of the circumstances” test.[62] As a result, officers had made public charge inadmissibility determinations considering all facts and circumstances in the totality prior to the 2019 Final Rule and 2022 Final Rule. DHS will continue to do so, consistent with past precedent decisions, under this final rule.[63]
(印刷页第45337页)
( printed page 45337)
评论:一位评论者表示,拟议规则无视了数十年的实践做法,且与国会意图相悖。另一位评论者写道,国会无意将公共负担不可入境事由用于惩罚使用临时性或补充性援助的人,而其他评论者则认为国会无意让官员考虑无穷无尽的因素。一位评论者断言,国会对于是否可以或应当考虑其他因素保持沉默,并不意味着允许考虑无限多的因素,且国会无意使该法规包含“兜底”条款。在其看来,法规中“至少”一词的表述并不暗示考虑未列明因素,因为必须考虑的因素仅辅以一项可酌情考虑的附加内容,即I-864表。
Comment: One commenter said that the proposed rule ignores decades of practice and contradicts congressional intent. Another wrote that Congress did not intend for the public charge ground of inadmissibility to punish people for using temporary or supplemental assistance while others opined that Congress did not intend for officers to consider an infinite set of factors. One asserts that Congress's silence as to whether additional factors can or should be considered was not intended to permit consideration of infinite factors and that Congress did not intend the statute to include a “catch-all” provision. In their view, the language “at a minimum” in the statute does not imply contemplation of factors not listed because the must-consider factors are complemented by one additional item that may be considered—the Form I-864.
