回应:美国国土安全部(DHS)不同意本规则无视或违背国会意图的说法。事实上,国会在《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中已明确表示,身处本国境内的外国人应当自给自足,不应依赖公共资源来满足其需求。根据《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4),除非适用法定例外情形,任何时候都有可能成为公共负担的外国人均不得入境美国。尽管DHS同意本规则所产生的、对公共负担不可入境性认定采取更广泛的自由裁量方式,是对1999年、2019年和2022年公共负担相关举措的背离,但其指出,国会已授权部长决定如何实施该条款。部长依其获授权限,确定DHS需要作出符合国会在制定INA第212(a)(4)条(即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))及PRWORA时所体现之意图的公共负担不可入境性认定。事实上,通过本次规则制定,DHS恢复了一项标准,即允许官员依照先例,考虑与某一外国人在任何时候可能成为公共负担的可能性相关的任何及所有因素。[64]
Response: DHS disagrees that this rule ignores or contradicts congressional intent. In fact, Congress made clear in PRWORA that aliens within the nation's borders should be self-sufficient and not dependent on public resources to meet their needs. As set forth in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), aliens who are likely at any time to become a public charge are inadmissible to the United States unless a statutory exception applies. While DHS agrees that the broader discretionary approach to public charge inadmissibility determinations resulting from this rule is a departure from the 1999, 2019, and 2022 public charge efforts, it notes Congress authorized the Secretary to determine how to implement this provision. The Secretary determined, as he is authorized to do, that DHS needs to make public charge inadmissibility determinations that reflect Congress's intent when it enacted section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), and PRWORA. Indeed, with this rulemaking, DHS returns to a standard permitting officers to consider any and all factors relevant to an individual alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge, consistent with precedent.[64]
此外,DHS同意国会已明确表示官员必须考虑某些因素,但是,我们不同意这些因素构成一个有限的、具有明确参数的结构化框架的说法。该法规列出了DHS官员“至少”必须考虑的五项因素,这一措辞显然并未排除对其他因素的考虑。INA第212(a)(4)(B)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)。国会设立了一个宽泛的、非穷尽性的、具有自由裁量权的框架,DHS在废止过于僵化的2022年最终规则后将遵循该框架。正如《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中详尽论述的那样,部长认定2022年最终规则过度限制,阻碍了DHS官员作出符合国会所确立的长期国家政策的公共负担不可入境性认定。90 FR 52168, 52189(2025年11月19日)。DHS同样不同意废止2022年最终规则将导致潜在考虑无穷因素的说法,因为DHS将把考虑范围限定于相关因素,即与某一外国人自给自足能力或潜在自给自足能力有关的因素,这与先例裁决是一致的。[65]
Additionally, DHS agrees Congress made clear that officers must consider certain factors; however, we disagree that those factors are a limited, structured framework with defined parameters. The statute lists the five factors DHS officers must consider “at a minimum,” language that clearly does not preclude the consideration of other factors. INA sec. 212(a)(4)(B), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B). Congress created the broad, non-exhaustive, and discretionary framework DHS will follow upon rescission of the unduly rigid 2022 Final Rule. As discussed thoroughly in the NPRM, the Secretary determined the 2022 Final Rule is overly restrictive and prevents DHS officers from making public charge inadmissibility determinations that align with the longstanding national policy set by Congress. 90 FR 52168, 52189 (Nov. 19, 2025). DHS also disagrees that rescission of the 2022 Final Rule will lead to potential consideration of infinite factors, as DHS will limit consideration to only relevant factors; i.e., factors bearing on an alien's ability or potential ability to be self-supporting, consistent with precedent decisions.[65]
3. 行政法相关问题
3. Administrative Law Concerns
a. 要求延长意见征询期
a. Request To Extend the Comment Period
评论:多位评论者要求延长拟议规则的意见征询期,指出30天的意见征询期与一个重要的联邦节假日重叠,并主张这不符合联邦法律,尤其是《行政程序法》(APA)的规定,还表示所提供的时间不足以就一项范围重大、表述不清且潜在影响广泛的规则作出回应。一位评论者评论说,这种看似仓促的做法,加之缺乏替代框架,表明此次规则制定是出于预先设定的政策偏好,而非对法定要求和实际执行情况的审慎考虑,另一位评论者则断言,压缩时间框架是为了削减负面意见。
Comment: Several commenters requested an extended comment period on the proposed rule, noting the 30-day comment period overlapping with a significant Federal holiday and arguing that that is not consistent with Federal law and the APA in particular, and stating the time provided was insufficient to respond to a rule of significant scope, lack of clarity, and potential impacts. A commenter remarked that the apparently rushed approach, combined with the lack of a replacement framework, suggests the rulemaking is driven by predetermined policy preferences not careful consideration of statutory requirements and practical implementation, while another asserted the compressed timeframe was an effort to curtail negative comments.
有评论者援引国土安全部(DHS)过去制定规则工作中采用的较长公众评议期,包括过去的公共负担规则,以此支持延长评议期,各种评论要求延长额外120天至150天(有些要求延长至总计180天),以便为所有利益相关方提供充分时间、讨论和考虑相关数据,并就拟议规则的潜在影响提出评议意见。一位评论者援引判例法支持30天评议期不充分的观点,指出“通知和评议要求的目的在于'(1)确保机构法规经过多元化公众评议的检验,(2)确保对受影响各方的公平性,以及(3)使受影响各方有机会在记录中形成证据以支持其对规则的异议,从而提高司法审查的质量。'”[66]
Commenters referenced longer public comment periods in DHS's past rulemaking efforts, including past public charge rules, as support for an extension and various comments requested between an additional 120 and 150 days (some for a total of 180 days) to enable sufficient time for all stakeholders, discussion and consideration of the data, and to provide comment on the potential impacts of the proposed rule. One commenter cited caselaw to support the insufficiency of a 30-day comment period, stating the purposes of “notice and comment requirements are `(1) to ensure that agency regulations are tested via exposure to diverse public comment, (2) to ensure fairness to affected parties, and (3) to give affected parties an opportunity to develop evidence in the record to support their objections to the rule and thereby enhance the quality of judicial review.' ” [66]
回应:国土安全部认为30天评议期为公众提供了充分的意见征询机会,因此拒绝延长评议期。国土安全部同意评论者关于通知与评议规则制定目的的看法,即《行政程序法》(APA)对公众评议期的持续时间未作规定,该法及相关判例法均未确立适用于所有情形的最短期限。参见《美国法典》第5编第553条。通常情况下,包括国土安全部在内的各机构会按照第12866号行政命令(E.O. 12866)的建议提供60天的评议期,尤其是在规则制定范围广泛、包含受监管公众此前未曾考虑过的新政策,或对受监管公众产生重大影响的情况下。国土安全部强调,本最终规则范围并不广泛而是狭窄的,因为其仅涉及单一的不可入境事由。此外,本规则并未包含受监管公众此前未曾考虑过的新政策,因为国土安全部是将公共负担不可入境事由的管理方式恢复为1999年临时实地指南出台前数十年间一直指导公共负担不可入境认定的做法。尽管30天评议期短于第12866号行政命令所建议的60天,但国土安全部认为,在本案中,30天的时间足以让公众审阅、考虑并就废止2022年最终规则的拟议规则发表评议意见。国土安全部(印刷页第45338页)指出,其在30天评议期内收到了5,882条公众评议意见,[67]其中包括来自律师、联邦、州和地方民选官员以及倡导组织的实质性高质量评议,这些评论提供了详细信息,在某些情况下还提出了重大问题,国土安全部在本最终规则中对此作出了回应。因此,延长评议期既无益处,也无必要。
Response: DHS believes the 30-day comment period provided an adequate opportunity for public input and declines to extend the comment period. DHS agrees with commenters regarding the purpose of notice-and-comment rulemaking in that the APA is silent regarding the duration of public comment periods, and neither it nor relevant caselaw establish a minimum duration applicable in all cases. 5 U.S.C. 553. Often, agencies, including DHS in the past, provide a 60-day comment period consistent with the recommendation in Executive Order (E.O.) 12866, particularly when the rulemaking is broad, includes new policies not previously considered by the regulated public or has significant impacts on the regulated public. DHS emphasizes this final rule is not broad but narrow in scope since it only covers a single ground of inadmissibility. Further, it does not include new policies not previously considered by the regulated public since DHS is returning the administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility to the approach that guided public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades before the 1999 Interim Field Guidance. While a 30-day comment period was shorter than the 60 days recommended in E.O. 12866, DHS believes in this instance 30 days was sufficient for the public to review, consider, and comment on the proposed rescission of the 2022 Final Rule. DHS ( printed page 45338) notes that it received 5,882 public comments during the 30-day comment period,[67] including substantive, high-quality comments from attorneys, Federal, State, and local elected officials, and advocacy organizations who provided detailed information and, in some instances, raised significant issues to which DHS is responding in this final rule. As such, an extension of the comment period would not have been helpful or necessary.
如先前通知的拟议规则制定中所述,国土安全部认为,确保公共福利不会造成有悖于《移民与国籍法》(INA)和《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)的移民激励,符合美国及其公民的最佳利益。国土安全部迅速采取行动,废除要求官员在作出公共负担不可入境认定时忽视大量公共福利领取情况的相关法规,从而使公共负担不可入境事由恢复到《移民与国籍法》、《非法移民改革和移民责任法》(IIRIRA)以及《个人责任与工作机会协调法》所体现的国会立法意图。
As stated in the NPRM, DHS believes it is in the best interest of the United States and its citizens to ensure public benefits do not create an incentive for immigration contrary to the INA and PRWORA. In acting expeditiously to remove regulations requiring officers to ignore the receipt of a large swath of public benefits when making public charge inadmissibility determinations, DHS is returning the public charge ground of inadmissibility to the congressional intent underlying the INA, IIRIRA, and PRWORA.
最后,国土安全部坚决不同意其缩短评议期是为了压制负面公众评议意见,或者未能充分考虑规则制定的实际影响而偏向于预先确定的政策偏好的说法。正如本序言所述,在评议期内,国土安全部收到了许多反对拟议规则的评论意见。除在先前通知的拟议规则制定中详细说明并论述废止2022年最终规则的预期影响外,国土安全部还对公众评议意见进行了认真考虑,并在本最终规则中作出回应。
Finally, DHS strongly disagrees it provided a shorter comment period to curtail negative public comments or failed to adequately consider practical impacts of the rulemaking in favor of predetermined policy preferences. As discussed in this preamble, during the comment period, DHS received a number of comments opposing the proposed rule. In addition to carefully explaining and addressing the anticipated impacts of the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule in the NPRM, DHS has carefully considered and here responds to public comments in this final rule.
不过,国土安全部同意评论者的观点,即每一项机构规则制定都反映了发起该规则制定的政府的政策目标,并反映了选出领导特定政府的公职人员的美国人民的意愿。同样,在本案中,本规则制定也反映了当前的政策目标。国土安全部发布了拟议规则,认真考虑了收到的公众评议意见,并在完全符合《行政程序法》的前提下提供了实质性回应。
DHS agrees with commenters, however, that every agency rulemaking reflects the policy objectives of the administration which initiated the rulemaking and reflects the will of the American people who elected the public officials heading a particular administration. So too, in this case, this rulemaking reflects current policy objectives. DHS published a proposed rule, carefully considered the public comments received, and provided substantive responses, in full compliance with the APA.
b. 未来指南与对《行政程序法》的遵守情况
b. Future Guidance and Compliance With the APA
评论:多名评论者要求国土安全部(DHS)承诺通过透明的通知与评论规则制定程序来制定未来的公共负担不可入境标准,而非仅仅依靠亚规范性政策工具。多名评论者指出,如果国土安全部决定制定替代规则,该规则以及为指导官员决定而制定的任何指南或工具都必须接受完整的公开通知和评论。多名评论者表示,就此类工具应包含何种内容征求开放式反馈和建议并不能替代通知与评论程序。
Comment: Several commenters requested DHS commit to developing future public charge inadmissibility standards through transparent notice-and-comment rulemaking, not solely through subregulatory policy tools. Several commenters stated, if DHS decides to develop an alternative rule, it must be open to full public notice and comment along with any guidance or tools created to direct officers' decisions. Multiple commenters said asking for open-ended feedback and recommendations on what to include in such tools is not a substitute for notice and comment.
回应:如《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)及其他评论回应中所述,国土安全部并未就公共负担不可入境决定发布法规。国土安全部正在废除那些在进行不可入境决定时不当束缚官员的法规条款。美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将发布非约束性的亚规范性指南,该指南将于本最终规则的生效日起施行。该指南将是一项一般性政策声明,不具有法律效力,因此不属于通知与评论规则制定程序的适用范围。美国公民及移民服务局计划将新指南纳入《美国公民及移民服务局政策手册》,该手册可在美国公民及移民服务局网站上查阅,对公众公开透明,并将取代反映2022年最终规则的现行指南。如果未来需要或有助于公共负担不可入境事由管理的法规,国土安全部将在发布任何此类法规时遵守《行政程序法》(APA)的要求。
Response: As indicated in the NPRM and other comment responses, DHS is not issuing regulations governing public charge inadmissibility determinations. DHS is removing regulatory provisions that unduly hampered officers when making inadmissibility determinations. USCIS will issue nonbinding subregulatory guidance that will go into effect on the effective date of this final rule. This guidance will be a general statement of policy that will not have the force and effect of law and will thus be exempt from notice and comment rulemaking. USCIS plans to include the new guidance in the USCIS Policy Manual, which is available on the USCIS website, is transparent to the public, and will replace the existing guidance reflecting the 2022 Final Rule. If regulations are needed or would be helpful to the administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility in the future, DHS will comply with the APA requirements in issuing any such regulations.
评论:多名评论者反对在未经通知与评论规则制定程序的情况下,以未明确定义的政策和解释性工具取代法规标准,认为这剥夺了公众对裁决标准进行有意义审查的机会,并可能违反《行政程序法》。评论者援引了Perez诉Mortgage Bankers Association案[68]和Mendoza诉Perez案[69],警告亚规范性指南不得创设新的实质性标准、改变法定要求,或以影响权利的方式扩大裁决者的自由裁量权。他们表示,公共负担不可入境决定需要明确、经过公开审议的法规,而非内部指南,并警告依赖未来的指南将导致各办公室之间不一致、武断的美国公民及移民服务局决定,使家庭不确定哪些项目可以安全使用,并对参与医疗、营养和住房支持产生寒蝉效应。评论者敦促国土安全部撤回该规则制定,或澄清其意图,在内部制定该规则,并在拟进行实质性修改时重新发布更详细的拟议规则或新的《拟议规则制定通知》,并指出绕过《行政程序法》将允许在没有公众参与的情况下持续改变政策,造成持续的不确定性。
Comment: Several commenters objected to eliminating regulatory standards in favor of undefined policy and interpretive tools without notice-and-comment rulemaking, arguing it denies the public a meaningful opportunity to review the adjudication standards and likely violates the APA. The commenters cited Perez v. Mortgage Bankers Association [68] and Mendoza v. Perez [69] to warn subregulatory guidance cannot create new substantive standards, alter statutory requirements, or expand adjudicator discretion in ways that affect rights. They stated that public charge inadmissibility determinations require clear, publicly vetted regulations, not internal guidance, and warned relying on future guidance would invite inconsistent, arbitrary USCIS decisions across offices, leave families uncertain which programs are safe to use, and chill participation in health, nutrition, and housing supports. Commenters urged DHS to withdraw the rulemaking or clarify its intentions, develop the rule internally, and reissue a more detailed proposed rule or a new NPRM if substantive changes are intended, noting that bypassing the APA would allow continual policy shifts without public input and create ongoing uncertainty.
回应:国土安全部不同意本规则将导致武断的结果,也不同意任何未来的指南将改变法定要求或与《行政程序法》及相关判例法相冲突。国土安全部不会撤回该《拟议规则制定通知》,并正在发布本最终规则以完成对2022年最终规则的废止。国土安全部也不认为需要对其意图作出任何澄清。该《拟议规则制定通知》已明确说明将废止2022年最终规则,并使官员摆脱对国会授权自由裁量权行使的武断和不当限制。国土安全部致力于遵守法律,包括《行政程序法》,并无意在未经通知与评论规则制定程序的情况下通过亚规范性指南发布法规或制定实质性规则。
Response: DHS disagrees that this rule will lead to arbitrary outcomes and that any future guidance will alter statutory requirements or conflict with the APA and related case law. DHS will not withdraw the NPRM, and is issuing this final rule to conclude the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule. DHS also disagrees that any clarification of its intentions is needed. The NPRM was explicit about rescinding the 2022 Final Rule and freeing officers from arbitrary and undue limitations on the exercise of congressionally-authorized discretion. DHS is committed to following the law, including the APA, and does not intend to issue regulations or promulgate substantive rules through subregulatory guidance without notice and comment rulemaking.
正如其他评论回应中所讨论的,美国公民及移民服务局在《美国公民及移民服务局政策手册》中发布的亚规范性指南将为根据本最终规则在调整身份申请背景下作出的公共负担不可入境决定提供指导,但不作强制性规定。该指南将说明官员如何能够考虑外国人领取任何经经济状况调查的公共福利的情况,并确保官员在外国人情况的整体考量中,充分考虑这一因素以及与判定外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性相关的任何其他因素或信息,这正是国会的本意。
As discussed in other comment responses, the subregulatory guidance USCIS publishes in the USCIS Policy Manual will guide, but not prescribe, public charge inadmissibility determinations made under this final rule in the context of adjustment of status applications. This guidance will explain how officers will be able to consider the receipt of any means-tested public benefits by the alien and will ensure officers fully consider this and any other factors or information relevant to determining an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge in the totality of the alien's circumstances, as Congress intended.
评论：评论者支持制定适当的解释性工具，但表示这些工具应补充而非取代联邦法规，要求在此类工具制定完成之前不要撤销相关法规，并要求任何时间表均应适当反映出在工具最终确定之前征求和纳入公众意见的期限。另一位评论者表示，国土安全部（DHS）没有在拟议规则制定公告（NPRM）中包含政策或解释性工具的细节，而是选择发布一份“含糊不清”的NPRM，并在之后发布相关工具，这很可能违反了5 U.S.C. 533条规定的《行政程序法》（APA），因为公众有权就具有影响力的事项，特别是涉及公共福利潜在使用的事项，获得通知和评议式规则制定的权利。评论者断言，国土安全部应撤回该NPRM，因为在未明确提出须经通知和评议程序的新公共负担规则的情况下，国土安全部不能从根本上扩大“公共负担”的定义。评论者指出，解释性工具必须经过完整的通知和评议程序（见印刷版第45339页），并援引Appalachian Power Co. v. EPA[70]案和General Electric Co. v. EPA[71]案，指出征求反馈意见不能替代通知和评议程序。他们声称，如果没有更明确的指导，将很难就某些公共福利对公共负担可能产生的影响向客户提供建议。
Comment: Commenters supported the creation of appropriate interpretive tools, but said these should supplement, not supplant, Federal regulations, requesting regulations not be removed until after such tools are developed and any timeline appropriately reflect a period for soliciting and incorporating public input on these tools before they are finalized. Another commenter said instead of including details of the policies or interpretative tools in the NPRM, DHS elected to issue a “vague” NPRM and issue the tools later, which likely violates the APA at 5 U.S.C. 533 because the public is entitled to notice and comment rulemaking on impactful matters, especially those implicating the potential use of public benefits. Commenters asserted DHS should withdraw the NPRM because it cannot radically expand the definition of “public charge” without explicitly proposing a new public charge rule subject to notice and comment. Commenters stated that interpretive tools must undergo the full notice-and- ( printed page 45339) comment process, citing Appalachian Power Co. v. EPA [70] and General Electric Co. v. EPA,[71] noting soliciting feedback is not a substitute for notice and comment. They claimed that without clearer guidance, it would be very difficult to advise clients on the potential public charge implications of certain public benefits.
其他评论者表示，2025年NPRM明确寻求恢复与2019年最终规则类似的政策，同时试图规避《行政程序法》关于通知和评议的要求，并指出，为证明新的实质性公共负担规则的正当性，国土安全部必须遵循《行政程序法》规定的完整程序，正如第一届特朗普政府在2018年至2019年所做的以及拜登政府在2022年所做的那样。评论者警告称，仅仅废除2022年最终规则并代之以“适当的政策和解释性工具”（即《行政程序法》所称的非“立法性规则”）将明显违反法律规定，除了追求迅速完成和规避公众评议之外没有其他目的。少数评论者要求国土安全部在公共负担认定的任何政策或工具方面使用完整的通知和评议程序，明确重申任何变更仅适用于未来（以承认信赖利益），并且不得处罚善意依赖先前规则的个人。
Other commenters said the 2025 NPRM explicitly seeks a return to policies similar to the 2019 Final Rule, while attempting an end-run around the APA's notice-and-comment requirements, noting to justify a new substantive public charge rule, DHS must go through the full APA-mandated process, as the first Trump Administration did in 2018-2019 and the Biden Administration did in 2022. The commenters warned simply rescinding the 2022 Final Rule and replacing it with “appropriate policy and interpretive tools” ( i.e., not a “legislative rule” under the APA) would be a clear violation of statute with no purpose other than haste and avoidance of public comment. A few commenters requested DHS use the full notice-and-comment process for any policy or tools in public charge determinations, clearly reaffirm any changes would apply only prospectively (in acknowledgement of the reliance interests) and not penalize individuals who relied in good faith on prior rules.
答复：如上文答复所述，国土安全部不同意这些评论者的观点，因为该NPRM并非含糊不清，相反，它清楚地说明了国土安全部正在考虑的变更及其背后的理由。国土安全部不会在未经通知和评议式规则制定程序的情况下发布实质性规则。此外，国土安全部并未试图规避《行政程序法》的通知和评议要求。正如NPRM及本最终规则其他部分所述，2019年最终规则与本最终规则之间存在一些实质性差异。例如，2019年最终规则限制了执法人员的自由裁量权。具体而言，2019年最终规则包含了严格的定义，例如“在任何时候可能成为公共负担”这一术语。该定义包含了一个新的依赖性门槛。2019年最终规则还规定了在综合考量全部情况时应考虑的常规因素和权重较大的因素，以及在某些人群获得特定公共福利时将其排除在考量范围之外的具体规定。国土安全部现在认为，这种有限的自由裁量权与国会意图不符。美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）将发布指导意见，供执法人员在依据《移民与国籍法》（INA）及既有判例作出个案公共负担不可入境性认定时参考。《行政程序法》的通知和评议要求适用于立法性规则，但不适用于解释性规则或一般政策声明。参见5 U.S.C. 553(b)(A)。最高法院长期以来一直承认这一区别。[72]只要解释性规则或一般政策声明不施加新的权利或义务，也不约束机构决策者，便属合法。[73]国土安全部不同意其计划发布的指导意见和解释性工具会违反Appalachian Power案或General Electric案的裁决，因为在那些案件中，相关指导意见使用了强制性语言，未给机构留下自由裁量的余地，施加了具体的监管义务，受监管方有合理理由相信不遵守将引发执法行动，并且他们除遵守之外别无实际选择。[74]
Response: As indicated in the responses above, DHS disagrees with these commenters because the NPRM was not vague; rather, it clearly explained the changes DHS was considering and the reasoning behind them. DHS will not issue substantive rules without notice and comment rulemaking. Further, DHS is not making an “end run” around the APA's notice and comment requirements. As explained in the NPRM and elsewhere in this final rule, there are some substantive differences between the 2019 Final Rule and this final rule. For example, the 2019 Final Rule limited officer discretion. Specifically, the 2019 final rule included strict definitions, such as the term “likely at any time to become a public charge.” This definition included a new dependence threshold. The 2019 Final Rule also included regular and heavily weighted factors to be considered in the totality of the circumstances, and specific exclusions from consideration of certain public benefits (when such benefits were received by certain populations). DHS now finds this limited discretion is not aligned with Congressional intent. USCIS will issue guidance for officers to consider when making individualized public charge inadmissibility determinations, consistent with the INA and established precedent. The APA's notice and comment requirements apply to legislative rules but not to interpretative rules or general statements of policy. See5 U.S.C. 553(b)(A). The Supreme Court has long recognized the distinction.[72] Interpretive rules or general statements of policy are lawful so long as they do not impose new rights or obligations or bind agency decisionmakers.[73] DHS disagrees that the guidance and interpretive tools it plans to issue would fail under Appalachian Power or General Electric because in those cases the guidance used mandatory language, left no room for agency discretion, imposed concrete regulatory obligations, the regulated parties reasonably believed that noncompliance would trigger enforcement, and they had no realistic alternative but compliance.[74]
美国国土安全部(DHS)已确定,实施公共负担不可准入性规定无需制定法规,且目前不会发布替代性法规。国土安全部认为,数十年来指导公共负担不可准入性认定的制定法与相关判例,已为判断外国人是否在任何时候可能成为公共负担提供了充分的指引。国土安全部还不认同可以或应当将废止2022年最终规则推迟至发布新的机构指南之后,因为若不废止现行法规,移民及归化局(USCIS)在向官员发布次级规章指南时,将仍受前届政府在该监管框架中所体现政策的约束。通过废除2022年最终规则,国土安全部正在现行制定法和判例框架内重新确立官员的自由裁量权。移民及归化局发布的任何指南都不构成具有约束力的规则,而只是在调整身份申请的背景下指导移民及归化局官员行使自由裁量权,而不对其加以限制或预先规定裁决结果。
DHS has determined regulations are unnecessary for the effective implementation of the public charge ground of inadmissibility and will not issue replacement regulations at this time. DHS believes the statute and applicable precedent decisions that guided the public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades provide sufficient guideposts for determining whether an alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. DHS also disagrees that it would be possible or appropriate to delay the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule pending the issuance of new agency guidance because absent a rescission of existing regulations, USCIS would be bound by the prior administration's policies reflected in that regulatory framework when issuing subregulatory guidance to officers. By removing the 2022 Final Rule, DHS is reestablishing officer discretion within the existing statutory and precedential framework. Any guidance that USCIS issues will not amount to a binding rule but rather guide USCIS officer discretion in the context of adjustment of status applications without limiting it or prescribing adjudicatory outcomes.
评论:一位评论者警告称,国土安全部不能在规避公众参与和司法审查的同时,合法地废除具有约束力的法规,并以未公开的次级规章指南取而代之以实现实质性政策变更,并指出2025年11月6日美国国务院(DOS)致各领事馆的电报扩大了签证裁决中适用的公共负担因素和证据范围。该评论者表示,据报道该电报指示官员除非申请人积极证明其将永远不会成为公共负担,否则应拒签;将非现金福利、慈善援助及其他合法支持视为不可准入性的潜在证据;并加深了财务审查力度(预示《外交事务手册》(FAM)将作相应更新),迫使申请人提交大量财务文件,并对低收入、信用记录薄弱、就业不稳定或住房不稳定的人员施加了不成比例的负担,该评论者认为这一结果明显违反《行政程序法》(APA)。
Comment: A commenter warned DHS cannot lawfully rescind binding regulations and substitute undisclosed subregulatory guidance to effect substantive policy changes while avoiding public participation and judicial review, noting that a November 6, 2025, Department of State (DOS) cable to consular posts broadened the public charge factors and evidence for visa adjudications. The commenter said the cable reportedly directs officers to deny visas unless applicants affirmatively show they will never become a public charge; treats non-cash benefits, charitable aid, and other lawful support as potential evidence of inadmissibility; and deepens financial scrutiny (previewing Foreign Affairs Manual (FAM) updates) forcing applicants to produce extensive financial documentation and imposing disproportionate burdens on low-income, credit-thin, intermittently employed, or unstably housed individuals, an outcome the commenter contended plainly violates the APA.
回应:关于国务院电报及《外交事务手册》的问题,国土安全部建议评论者向国务院查询。关于废除2022年最终规则后,外国人向移民及归化局申请调整身份时所适用的举证责任问题,国土安全部已对I-485表格提出修改,并依照1995年《文书削减法》(PRA)及其实施法规,即《美国法典》第44编第3501条及以下条款、《联邦法规汇编》第5编第1320部分,在本次规则制定的相应60天评议期内公开了相关文书负担估算,邀请公众对此发表评论。与所有其他裁决一样,若移民及归化局官员需要就I-485表格所附证据或信息获取更多证据或澄清,移民及归化局可发出补充证据请求(RFE)或拟拒绝通知(NOID)。
Response: DHS refers commenters to DOS on the issue of the DOS cable and the FAM. With respect to the evidentiary burden applicable to aliens seeking adjustment of status with USCIS after the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule, DHS has proposed changes to the Form I-485 and disclosed the relevant paperwork burden estimate on which the public was invited to comment in conjunction with this rulemaking during the applicable 60-day comment period consistent with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA) and implementing regulations. 44 U.S.C. 3501 et seq.,5 CFR part 1320. As with all other adjudications, should USCIS officers require more evidence or clarification of information or evidence included with the Form I-485, USCIS may issue Requests for Evidence (RFEs) or Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs).
c. 放弃通知与评论规则制定程序的正当理由
c. Good Cause To Forgo Notice and Comment Rulemaking
评论:一位评论者表示,若国土安全部援引《行政程序法》的正当理由例外以规避通知与评论程序或30天延迟生效期,则在不存在真正、紧迫的紧急情况下,对于此等规模的规则而言是不恰当的,因为法院对正当理由的解释非常狭窄,行政上的便利或政策上的紧迫性不足以构成正当理由。
Comment: One commenter stated if DHS invoked the APA's good-cause exception to bypass notice-and-comment or the 30-day delayed effective date, it is improper for a rule of this scope absent a genuine, immediate emergency, since courts construe good cause narrowly; administrative convenience or policy urgency does not suffice.
回应:国土安全部在发布本最终规则时,并未援引《行政程序法》关于通知与评论要求的正当理由例外,而是公布了一项附有30天评议期的拟议规则(见印刷版第45340页),并依照《国会审查法》的要求以及符合《行政程序法》关于至少30天的规定,以60天生效期发布本最终规则。参见《美国法典》第5编第553条及第801条至第808条。
Response: When issuing this final rule, DHS did not invoke the good cause exception to the APA's notice and comment requirements but rather published a proposed rule with a 30-day ( printed page 45340) comment period, and is publishing this final rule with a 60-day effective date, as required by the Congressional Review Act and in compliance with the APA which requires a minimum of 30 days. See5 U.S.C. 553 and 5 U.S.C. 801-808.
d. 规则属于武断和反复无常
d. Rule Is Arbitrary and Capricious
i. 缺乏合理依据
i. Lack of Reasoned Justification
评论:多位评论者主张,根据《美国法典》第5编第706(2)(A)条,该拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)应被撤销,因为《行政程序法》(APA)要求,废止或变更现行规则须有超出仅因新一届政府上任之外的合理说明。部分评论者主张,该规则属于武断和反复无常,原因在于美国国土安全部(DHS)对其立场变更缺乏充分理由,机构解释可能出现前后不一致的情况,以及未能考虑源自先前规则和指南所产生的依赖利益。评论者援引针对2019年最终规则的诉讼,补充指出该规则还将与《移民与国籍法》(INA)不一致,并偏离了“公共负担”这一术语已确立已久的含义。另一位评论者指出,根据行政法的基本原则,“合理的决策”要求行政机关依赖其专业知识和连贯一致的标准,而非不受指引的直觉。
Comment: Multiple commenters asserted the NPRM should be struck down under 5 U.S.C. 706(2)(A) because the APA requires a reasoned explanation for rescinding or changing an existing rule beyond just a new administration. Some commenters asserted the rule is arbitrary and capricious due to the lack of a sufficient justification for DHS's changed position, the likelihood of inconsistent agency interpretations, and the failure to consider reliance interests stemming from prior rules and guidance. Citing to the litigation on the 2019 Final Rule, the commenters added the rule would also be inconsistent with the INA and it departs from the well-settled meaning of public charge. Another commenter stated, under basic principles of administrative law, “reasoned decision making” requires agencies to rely on expertise and coherent standards, not unguided intuition.
回应:美国国土安全部不同意评论者关于该拟议规则制定通知或本最终规则属于武断和反复无常的主张。需要强调的是,美国国土安全部并未在本最终规则中对“公共负担”作出定义。此外,尽管评论者援引了相关判例法,但“公共负担”一词并不存在单一的、已确立已久的、明确将某些公共福利纳入考量而排除其他福利的含义。[75] 正如拟议规则制定通知中所讨论的,《移民与国籍法》并未对“公共负担”或“未来极有可能成为公共负担”作出定义。相反,国会提供了一套非穷尽性的最低考量因素框架(年龄、健康状况、家庭状况、资产、资源和经济状况,以及教育程度和技能),并将是否认定外国人根据该事由不可准入的裁量权留给行政机关。参见《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条和第(B)条,《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)(A)条和第(B)条;《联邦公报》第90卷第52168页,第52186页,第52187至52188页,第52175页(2025年11月19日)。
Response: DHS disagrees with commenters that the NPRM or this final rule is arbitrary and capricious. Importantly, DHS is not providing a definition for public charge in this final rule. Moreover, there is no single well-settled meaning of the term public charge that definitively includes the consideration of some public benefits but not others, notwithstanding the caselaw commenters cite.[75] As discussed in the NPRM, the INA does not define “public charge” or “likely at any time to become a public charge.” Instead, Congress provided a framework of non-exhaustive minimum factors for consideration (age, health, family status, assets, resources, and financial status, and education and skills and left it to the agency's discretion to determine whether an alien is inadmissible under the ground. See INA sec. 212(a)(4)(A) and (B), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A) and (B); 90 FR 52168, 52186, 52187-88, 52175 (Nov. 19, 2025).
行政和司法先例裁决一贯承认,公共负担不可准入认定本质上具有主观性和裁量性,必须根据个案情况逐案作出判断,并综合考虑外国人的全部情形。美国国土安全部指出,这些先例裁决的作出时间早于1999年《临时实地指南》以及2019年和2022年颁布的法规定义。正如《Harutunian案》所指出的,构成外国人有可能成为公共负担的各项要素各不相同,这些要素并非由成文法所定义,而是由行政机关在综合考虑所有与外国人自我维持能力或潜在能力相关的因素后作出行政裁定。14 I&N Dec. 583, 588(移民上诉委员会,1974年)。同样,正如《Martinez-Lopez案》所述,该成文法条文“要求的不仅仅是证明外国人可能需要公共援助的可能性。必须存在某些具体情形……”。10 I&N Dec. 409, 421-22(移民上诉委员会,1962年;司法部长,1964年)。最后,正如《A-案》所述,“传统的判断标准……是‘基于个案所呈现的外国人全部情形所作出的预测’”。19 I&N Dec. 867, 869(移民上诉委员会,1988年)(引文出处略)。
Administrative and judicial precedent decisions have consistently recognized the public charge inadmissibility determination is inherently subjective and discretionary and must be made on a case-by-case basis, considering the totality of the alien's circumstances. DHS notes these precedent decisions predate both the 1999 Interim Field Guidance and the regulatory definitions promulgated in 2019 and 2022. As indicated in Matter of Harutunian, the elements constituting likelihood of an alien becoming a public charge are varied; they are not defined by statute but rather are determined administratively upon consideration of all the factors bearing on the alien's ability or potential ability to be self-supporting. 14 I&N Dec. 583, 588 (BIA 1974). Similarly, as stated in Matter of Martinez-Lopez, the statute “requires more than a showing of a possibility that the alien will require public support. Some specific circumstance . . . must be present.” 10 I&N Dec. 409, 421-22 (BIA 1962; Att'y Gen. 1964). Finally, as stated in Matter of A-, the “traditional test . . . is `a prediction based on the totality of the alien's circumstances' as presented in the individual case.” 19 I&N Dec. 867, 869 (BIA 1988) (citation omitted).
正如国土安全部(DHS)在《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中所指出的,公共负担从未有过单一、统一或“已确立”的定义。90 FR 52168, 52174(2025年11月19日)。相反,其含义随时间演变,并一直受到不同行政解释的影响。例如,参议院司法委员会于1950年指出:“由于构成可能成为公共负担的要素是多种多样的,法律中不应试图对该术语进行定义,而应建立具体的资格要求,即……该判定应由领事官员或[移民归化局(INS)]自由裁量决定。”90 FR 52168, 52181(2025年11月19日)。若干巡回法院认定,该法规赋予行政部门“广泛且最终的自由裁量权”,且“公共负担”一词并无固定的历史含义。[76] 最后,正如《拟议规则制定通知》中所述,2019年最终规则生效前的既往机构指导和实践,包括1999年临时实地指导及此前的行政裁决,一贯强调灵活的、基于具体事实的方法,而非僵化或狭隘的定义。国会在制定《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)和《非法移民改革和移民责任法》(IIRIRA)时,并未将某一具体定义编入法典,而是强化了官员考虑所有相关证据的自由裁量权。90 FR 52168, 52182-83, 52188-89(2025年11月19日)。基于上述原因,废止2022年最终规则并恢复官员更广泛的自由裁量权,并非武断和反复无常之举;这也并不违背公共负担已确立的含义,因为根本不存在此种已确立的含义。
As DHS noted in the NPRM, there has never been a single, uniform, or “well settled” definition of public charge. 90 FR 52168, 52174 (Nov. 19, 2025). Instead, the meaning evolved over time and has been subject to varying administrative interpretations. For example, the Senate Judiciary Committee in 1950 noted: “[s]ince the elements constituting likelihood of becoming a public charge are varied, there should be no attempt to define the term in the law, but rather to establish the specific qualification that the determination . . . rests within the discretion of the consular officers or [INS].” 90 FR 52168, 52181 (Nov. 19, 2025). Certain circuit courts recognized the statute grants the executive “extensive and ultimate discretion” and the term “public charge” does not have a fixed historical meaning.[76] Finally, as stated in the NPRM, past agency guidance and practice in place before the 2019 Final Rule, including the 1999 Interim Field Guidance and prior administrative decisions, have always emphasized a flexible, fact-specific approach, not a rigid or narrow definition. Congress, in enacting PRWORA and IIRIRA, did not codify a specific definition but instead reinforced the officer's discretion to consider all relevant evidence. 90 FR 52168, 52182-83, 52188-89 (Nov. 19, 2025). For these reasons, rescinding the 2022 Final Rule and restoring broader officer discretion is not arbitrary and capricious; it is not contrary to a well-settled meaning of public charge, because no such settled meaning exists.
此外,国土安全部不同意本规则因缺乏正当理由或合理解释而属于武断和反复无常的说法。国土安全部同意,根据《联邦通信委员会诉福克斯电视台案》(FCC v. Fox Television Stations, Inc.),556 U.S. 502(2009年),机构法规的变更需要有合理的解释:机构必须承认该变更,提供充分的理由,并说明为何认为新立场更为妥当。国土安全部在《拟议规则制定通知》及本最终规则中均满足了这些要求。
In addition, DHS disagrees this rule is arbitrary and capricious because it lacks justification or a reasoned explanation. DHS agrees that, under FCC v. Fox Television Stations, Inc., 556 U.S. 502 (2009), a change in agency regulations requires a reasoned explanation: the agency must acknowledge the change, provide good reasons for it, and indicate why it believes the new position is better. DHS satisfied these requirements in the NPRM and in this final rule.
国土安全部明确承认,其提议废止2022年最终规则所确立的2022年公共负担不可入境事由相关法规,并始终如一地提供了充分理由支持该拟议废止。[77] 国土安全部就此变更提供了详尽、合理的解释,包括说明2022年最终规则并非实施该法规的最佳方式,与国会意图不符,过度限制,并妨碍国土安全部作出准确、精确和可靠判定的能力。90 FR 52168(2025年11月19日)。尽管废止2022年最终规则在不同程度上背离了过去27年中与公共负担不可入境事由相关的三次既往努力,但国土安全部并无义务保留部长在审查追溯至1946年的指导及面向公众的信息后认定并非实施国会所确立的广泛性、基于具体事实、综合考量各种情况且具有自由裁量性质的公共负担不可入境判定的最佳方式的任何既往法规和政策指导。参见90 FR 52168, 52181-82(2025年11月19日)。
DHS explicitly acknowledged it was proposing to rescind the 2022 public charge ground of inadmissibility regulations established by the 2022 Final Rule and consistently provided good reasons for the proposed rescission.[77] DHS provided detailed, reasoned explanations for the change, including explaining the 2022 Final Rule is not the best implementation of the statute, is inconsistent with congressional intent, is unduly restrictive, and hampers DHS's ability to make accurate, precise, and reliable determinations. 90 FR 52168 (Nov. 19, 2025). While rescinding the 2022 Final Rule is a departure—in varying degrees—from the three prior efforts over the last 27 years related to the public charge ground of inadmissibility, DHS is not required to retain any of the prior regulations and policy guidance the Secretary determined, upon a review of guidance and public-facing information dating back to 1946, are not the best way to implement the expansive, fact-specific, totality of the circumstances, and discretionary public charge inadmissibility determination Congress put into place. See90 FR 52168, 52181-82 (Nov. 19, 2025).
《拟议规则制定通知》进一步指出,2022年最终规则通过限制国土安全部在综合考量各种情况时可考虑的公共福利范围,并禁止官员考虑法规中列明的七项因素以外的其他因素,从而束缚了国土安全部官员作出符合国会在《个人责任与工作机会协调法》中所确立的关于福利与移民的明确国家政策的公共负担不可入境判定的能力。(printed page 45341) 90 FR 52168, 52169-52170(2025年11月19日)。国土安全部还解释称,2019年规则和2022年规则均规定了官员必须考虑的有限因素清单,而未赋予官员考虑任何个案中其他相关因素的权力,这与国会所意图的自由裁量性、个案具体化的框架不符。90 FR 52168, 52180-52181(2025年11月19日)。
The NPRM further stated the 2022 Final Rule straitjackets DHS officers' ability to make public charge inadmissibility determinations that are ( printed page 45341) consistent with Congress's express national policy on welfare and immigration enacted in the PRWORA by limiting what public benefits DHS can consider in the totality of the circumstances and by precluding officers from considering factors beyond the seven factors outlined in the regulations. 90 FR 52168, 52169-52170 (Nov. 19, 2025). DHS also explained that both the 2019 and 2022 rules provided a finite list of factors officers are required to consider without providing officers the authority to consider other factors relevant in any individual case, which is inconsistent with the discretionary and case-specific framework Congress intended. 90 FR 52168, 52180-52181 (Nov. 19, 2025).
DHS还解释了其为何认为在废止2022年最终规则后作出的公共负担不可允许性认定将更加符合国会意图。具体而言,DHS指出,官员将能够运用良好判断力和自由裁量权,根据每名外国人个人情况的整体情况,作出高度个性化、基于具体事实、逐案审查的公共负担不可允许性决定,而不受僵化的法规定义和标准的限制。90 FR 52168, 52194(2025年11月19日)。至关重要的是,DHS解释说,2022年最终规则的做法,包括主要依赖标准,可能导致美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)认定外国人符合调整身份资格,即使其过去领取经经济状况调查的公共福利可能已表明其缺乏自给自足能力且在任何时候都可能成为公共负担,这是由于官员无法考虑该外国人所依赖的所有福利以及与不可允许性认定有关的任何其他相关个案具体因素所致。90 FR 52168, 52180(2025年11月19日)。事实上,DHS提供了多项理由支持废止2022年最终规则。90 FR 52168, 52180-81, 52186(2025年11月19日)。
DHS also explained why it believes that public charge inadmissibility determinations after the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule will be more consistent with congressional intent. Specifically, DHS noted that officers will be able to use good judgment and discretion to make highly individualized, fact-specific, case-by-case public charge inadmissibility decisions based on the totality of each alien's individual circumstances, rather than being limited by rigid regulatory definitions and standards. 90 FR 52168, 52194 (Nov. 19, 2025). Crucially, DHS explained that the 2022 Final Rule's approach including the primary dependence standard may have resulted in USCIS finding aliens eligible for adjustment of status even when their past receipt of means-tested public benefits may have demonstrated they lacked self-sufficiency and were likely at any time to become a public charge, due to officers' inability to consider all benefits the alien depended on and any other relevant case-specific factor that has bearing on the inadmissibility determination. 90 FR 52168, 52180 (Nov. 19, 2025). In fact, DHS provided multiple reasons to support the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule. 90 FR 52168, 52180-81, 52186 (Nov. 19, 2025).
DHS还在《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中讨论了以往政策的根本原因,包括其局限性。具体而言,DHS指出,2019年最终规则和2022年最终规则均试图通过明确规定公共负担认定中应考虑的有限因素和福利清单来提供清晰性和可预测性,然而这样做却“严重且不当地限制了DHS在作出公共负担不可允许性认定时可以考虑的因素”,这与国会意图的广泛自由裁量标准不一致。90 FR 52168, 52180-81(2025年11月19日)。
DHS also discussed the underlying reasons for past policies, including their limitations in the NPRM. Specifically, DHS noted that both the 2019 Final Rule and 2022 Final Rule attempted to provide clarity and predictability by specifying a finite list of factors and benefits to be considered in public charge determinations, however in so doing these rules “severely and unduly limited the factors that DHS could consider in making a public charge inadmissibility determination,” which is inconsistent with the broad, discretionary standard Congress intended. 90 FR 52168, 52180-81 (Nov. 19, 2025).
DHS还在《拟议规则制定通知》的多个部分讨论了2019年最终规则,并认定该规则并非真正可行的替代方案,因为尽管该规则相较于《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条、8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)以及《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)背后的国会意图更为接近,但该规则同样规定了一套僵化而复杂的法规体系,不必要地限制了官员的自由裁量权。
DHS also discussed the 2019 Final Rule in various parts of the NPRM and determined that it was not a truly viable alternative, because, while closer to congressional intent behind section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), and PRWORA, that rule also prescribed a rigid and complex regulatory scheme that unnecessarily constrained officer discretion.
此外,在提议废止2022年最终规则时,DHS还对制定法历史、以往行政实践和判例法进行了全面审查,并说明新方法植根于该机构的专业知识和长期先例。[78] 最后,DHS承认存在信赖利益,并专门征求了关于2022年最终规则哪些方面可能产生了此类信赖利益,以及DHS应如何在实现其既定政策目标的同时最妥善地处理此类信赖利益的意见。90 FR 52168, 52193(2025年11月19日)。在本最终规则中,DHS正在回应提出具体信赖利益的公众意见,并在本最终规则中作出澄清,以进一步处理这些利益。
Furthermore, in proposing the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule, DHS also provided a thorough review of statutory history, prior administrative practice, and case law, and explained the new approach is grounded in the agency's expertise and longstanding precedent.[78] Finally, DHS acknowledged the existence of reliance interests and specifically requested comments on what aspects of the 2022 Final Rule might have engendered such reliance interests, and how DHS should best address such reliance interests given its stated policy objectives. 90 FR 52168, 52193 (Nov. 19, 2025). In this final rule, DHS is responding to public comments raising specific reliance interests and has made clarifications in this final rule to further address those interests.
基于上述所有理由,DHS已经说明了为何在国会广泛授权且“公共负担”一词并无既定含义的情况下,废止2022年最终规则是合理的。DHS已就该变更提供了详细、合理的说明,指出了以往规则中的缺陷,解释了为何新方法更为可取,并处理了信赖利益以及对连贯、以专业知识为导向的自由裁量决定的需求。
For all of these reasons, DHS has established why the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule is reasonable given the broad congressional delegation, and the fact that there is no settled meaning of public charge. DHS has provided a detailed, reasoned explanation for the change, identified the deficiencies in the prior rules, explained why the new approach is preferable, and addressed reliance interests and the need for coherent, expertise-driven discretionary determinations.
评论:部分评论者表示,将公共负担不可受理性框架扩大到如此广泛的范围,以至于可能涵盖有收入的在职美国公民,这缺乏历史依据或合理依据,将属于反复无常和武断的做法。评论者援引最高法院在美国联邦通信委员会诉福克斯电视台案(FCC v. Fox Television)中要求行政机构必须为不顾此前事实和依赖利益提供正当理由的规定,指出该提案没有提供任何证据表明2022年规则无法实施或与《移民与国籍法》(INA)不一致,也未指出任何执法问题或数据,并且未能考虑到对移民、家庭暴力受害者和非营利服务提供者造成的寒蝉效应。一位评论者表示,最高法院在美国机动车制造商协会诉州立农业互助汽车保险公司案(Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Ass'n of the United States, Inc. v. State Farm Mut. Auto. Ins. Co.), 463 U.S. 29 (1983)(以下简称“州立农业案”)中已经处理过在未颁布新法规的情况下废除机动车安全标准这一完全相同的问题,并认定此举属于反复无常和武断。多位评论者警告称,国土安全部(DHS)未就放弃长期存在的解释提供必要的正当理由,也未说明为何不能转而根据H.R.1法案对2022年最终规则中已成文的条款加以修改。
Comment: Some commenters stated expanding the public charge inadmissibility framework so broadly—to potentially encompass working U.S. citizens with income—lacks historical or rational support and would be arbitrary and capricious. Citing the Supreme Court's requirement in FCC v. Fox Television that agencies justify disregarding prior facts and reliance interests, commenters noted the proposal offers no evidence the 2022 Rule is unworkable or inconsistent with the INA, identifies no enforcement problems or data, and fails to account for the chilling effects on immigrants, domestic violence- survivors, and nonprofit service providers. One commenter stated the Supreme Court addressed the very issue of rescinding automobile safety standards without promulgating new regulations in the Motor Vehicle Manufacturers Ass'n of the United States, Inc. v. State Farm Mut. Auto. Ins. Co., 463 U.S. 29 (1983) (“ State Farm ”), finding it to be arbitrary and capricious. Several commenters warned DHS has not provided the necessary justification for abandoning longstanding interpretations or for why the codified provisions of the 2022 Final Rule could not instead be modified in response to H.R.1.
回应:国土安全部不同意废止2022年最终规则属于反复无常和武断,或缺乏合理依据或充分说明的观点。如上文所详述,国土安全部已就废除2022年规则提供了充分合理的依据,说明废除该规则可恢复官员的自由裁量权,并使公共负担不可受理性标准的执行更贴近国会意图。无论是州立农业案[79]还是美国联邦通信委员会诉福克斯电视台案[80],均未要求国土安全部必须证明2022年最终规则无法实施或与《移民与国籍法》不一致。最高法院在美国联邦通信委员会诉福克斯电视台案中裁定,行政机构无需证明其先前的政策或解释无法实施即可据此证明变更政策的正当性,并说明只要行政机构提供合理的变更解释、承认此种转变,并处理任何依赖利益,行政机构即可变更其政策。[81]最高法院特别驳回了对更高标准正当理由的要求,指出行政机构“无需证明……新政策的理由优于旧政策的理由”。[82]相反,行政机构只需解释新政策以及其认为该政策更为可取的原因。[83]这一原则使行政机构能够灵活地调整和修订政策,而不受此前做法是否可实施或可执行的约束。[84]尽管如此,国土安全部认为其已在《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中证明,2022年最终规则并非对该法规的最佳解释,也并非完全符合国会意图。
Response: DHS disagrees that the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule is arbitrary and capricious or lacks a reasonable basis or sufficient explanation. As detailed above, DHS provided an ample reasonable basis for removing the 2022 Final Rule, explained removing the rule restores officer discretion, and aligns the administration of the public charge ground of inadmissibility closer to the congressional intent. Neither State Farm [79] nor FCC v. Fox Television [80] requires DHS to establish the 2022 Final Rule is unworkable or that it is inconsistent with the INA. The Supreme Court in FCC v. Fox Television held an agency does not need to show its prior policy or interpretation is unworkable to justify a change, explaining an agency may change its policy as long as it provides a reasoned explanation for the change, acknowledges the shift, and addresses any reliance interests.[81] The Court specifically rejected the requirement for heightened justification, stating an agency “need not demonstrate. . .that the reasons for the new policy are better than the reasons for the old one.” [82] Instead, the agency must simply explain the new policy and why it believes it is preferable.[83] This principle allows agencies flexibility to adapt and revise policies without being constrained by the workability or enforceability of previous approaches.[84] All of this being said, DHS believes it established in the NPRM the 2022 Final Rule was not the best interpretation of the statute and not fully consistent with congressional intent.
同样,国土安全部无需证明2022年最终规则(印刷版第45342页)无法执行,尽管国土安全部已在《拟议规则制定通知》中明确指出,2022年最终规则所采取的做法(在1999年临时实地指南中也有所体现)不当地要求官员在作出公共负担不可受理性认定时忽略大量按经济状况核定的公共福利,并在整体框架中排除今后可能依赖此类福利的可能性。国土安全部坚决不同意其忽视了制定2022年最终规则所依据的依赖利益或事实这一说法。
Similarly, DHS is not required to establish the 2022 Final Rule was ( printed page 45342) unenforceable, although DHS clearly stated in the NPRM the approach taken in the 2022 Final Rule (as also reflected in the 1999 Interim Field Guidance) inappropriately required officers to ignore a large swath of means-tested public benefits in public charge inadmissibility determinations and exclude the possibility of future dependence on such benefits as part of the overall framework. DHS strongly disagrees that it ignored reliance interests or facts underlying the promulgation of the 2022 Final Rule.
正如先前拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)中所述,国土安全部(DHS)认真审视了2022年最终规则所依据的先前事实认定,尤其是涉及自给自足能力的部分,包括是否可将领取经济状况调查类公共福利的情况视为缺乏自给自足能力的表现,以及此项规则制定的附带影响,例如寒蝉效应。90 FR第52183页,第52208-52210页。为此,国土安全部就其改变方向提供了充分的法律和政策依据,鉴于其旨在推进公共负担不可入境事由及《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)所体现的法定目的,即通过减少不具备自给自足能力且可能依赖政府的外国人进入或留在美国的诱因,来实现相关利益。国会已设立多项法定工具以减少此类依赖。PRWORA及其他法律大幅限制了外国人领取公共福利的资格。公共负担不可入境事由及可驱逐出境事由是国会为推进有关外国人自给自足能力的国家政策目标而设立的其他工具。尽管外国人可能有资格领取公共福利,但国会就此类外国人领取公共福利的行为设定了相应后果。若其在入境后5年内成为公共负担,则可能被驱逐出境。《移民与国籍法》(INA)第237(a)(5)条,《美国法典》第8编第1227(a)(5)节。国会显然意图通过此类移民后果,抑制外国人领取公共福利的行为。
As articulated in the NPRM, DHS grappled with prior factual findings underlying the 2022 Final Rule particularly as it pertains to self-sufficiency and whether considering receipt of means-tested public benefits can be indicative of a lack of self-sufficiency, as well as collateral impacts of the rulemaking, such as chilling effects. 90 FR at 52183, 52208-10. To that end, DHS provided an adequate legal and policy justification for changing course given its interests to further the statutory purpose behind the public charge ground of inadmissibility and PRWORA by reducing the incentive for aliens who are not self-sufficient and are likely to become dependent on the government to enter or remain in the United States. Congress has established multiple statutory tools to reduce such dependence. PRWORA and other statutes significantly restricted the eligibility of aliens for public benefits. The public charge grounds of inadmissibility and deportability are other tools Congress created to advance these national policy objectives regarding aliens' self-sufficiency. Though an alien may be eligible to receive public benefits, Congress established consequences for such receipt by those aliens. If they become a public charge within 5 years after entry, they may be removed from the United States. INA sec. 237(a)(5), 8 U.S.C. 1227(a)(5). Congress clearly intended these immigration consequences to disincentivize the receipt of public benefits by aliens.
本规则通过使官员能够更准确地评估其认为外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性,从而推进了有关福利与移民的明确国家政策。
This rule advances the clear national policy concerning welfare and immigration by making it possible for officers to more accurately assess whether, in their opinion, an alien is likely at any time to become a public charge.
尽管该政策目标与前任政府的目标不同,但国土安全部已依法对相关事实进行了重新评估,并就其新政策提供了合理的说明。因此,国土安全部不认同该规则属于武断和反复无常的观点。[85]
While this policy objective differs from the prior administration's objectives, DHS has permissibly reevaluated the relevant facts and provided a reasoned explanation for its new policy. DHS therefore disagrees that the rule is arbitrary and capricious.[85]
此外,国土安全部认为本案的具体情况与State Farm案可作区分。国会赋予部长在管理公共负担不可入境事由方面广泛的自由裁量权,仅规定了若干在个案中须考虑的强制性因素,且从未指示部长就公共负担不可入境事由进行规则制定或制定具有约束力的标准。相比之下,国会在希望通过颁布《1966年国家交通与机动车安全法》(NTMVS Act,《美国法典》第15编第1381条及以下,1976年版及1980年补编第四辑)来提升机动车及交通安全时,明确指示交通部部长或其授权代表发布机动车安全标准,并要求该等标准须具有可行性、满足机动车安全需求,且须以客观方式表述。《美国法典》第15编第1392(a)节。[86]国会同时规定,部长在制定该等标准时,必须考虑相关可获得的机动车安全数据、拟议标准对特定类型机动车而言是否合理、可行且适当,以及“该等标准在多大程度上有助于实现”NTMVS法案宗旨。《美国法典》第15编第1392(f)(1)、(3)、(4)节。[87]参见State Farm案,463 U.S. 29 (1983年)。因此,当交通部部长在未要求使用安全气囊或安全带、亦未考虑其他替代方案的情况下,废止安全带规定时,法院认定此做法属于武断和反复无常,因为国家公路交通安全管理局(NHTSA)无视了法定要求以增进安全性,且未能考虑合理的替代方案。同上,第46页至第57页。
In addition, DHS finds the specific circumstances in State Farm to be distinguishable. Congress granted the Secretary broad discretion to administer the public charge ground of inadmissibility, provided only certain mandatory factors for consideration in individual cases, and at no point directed the Secretary to engage in rulemaking or establish binding standards to govern the public charge ground of inadmissibility. In contrast, Congress when wishing to improve motor vehicle and traffic safety by enacting the National Traffic and Motor Vehicle Safety Act of 1966, (NTMVS Act), 15 U.S.C. 1381 et seq. (1976 and Supp. IV 1980) directed the Secretary of Transportation or his delegate to issue motor vehicle safety standards and also mandated those standards be practicable, meet the need for motor vehicle safety, and be stated in objective terms. 15 U.S.C. 1392(a).[86] Congress also directed that in issuing these standards, the Secretary must consider relevant available motor vehicle safety data, whether the proposed standard is reasonable, practicable and appropriate for the particular type of motor vehicle, and the “extent to which such standards will contribute to carrying out the purposes” of the NTMVS Act. 15 U.S.C. 1392(f)(1), (3), (4).[87] See State Farm, 463 U.S. 29 (1983). Therefore, when the Secretary of Transportation rescinded the seatbelt regulation without requiring either the use of airbags or seat belts, or considering alternatives, the court determined this approach was arbitrary and capricious because National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) ignored the statutory requirement to enhance safety and failed to consider reasonable alternatives. Id. at 46-57.
关于废止2022年最终规则一案,虽然国土安全部(DHS)有法定权力自行决定发布有关实施公共负担不准入事由的法规或指南(或两者兼有),但法律并未要求国土安全部必须发布此类法规或指南。移民与国籍法(INA)第103(a)(3)条,《美国法典》第8编第1103(a)(3)条。此外,国土安全部在拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)和本最终规则中已明确表示,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将依照法律及适用判例实施该不准入事由,任何USCIS指南都将对官员的裁量权起指导作用,而非作出强制性规定。这一做法与移民归化局(INS)在该不准入事由存在的大部分时间内所采取的做法相一致。国土安全部直到2019年才首次选择发布具有约束力的法规。如拟议规则制定通知和本最终规则中所述,国土安全部已解释了为何保留2022年最终规则或恢复2019年最终规则均无法实现其目标,并说明了国土安全部为何认为本规则更优、更符合国会意图与立法目的,并能实现其政策目标。见联邦纪事第90卷第52180页。因此,废止2022年最终规则一事,与State Farm案中美国国家公路交通安全管理局(NHTSA)废止车辆及交通安全标准的情形有所不同。
In the case of this rescission of the 2022 Final Rule, while DHS has the statutory authority to issue regulations or guidance (or both) to administer the public charge ground of inadmissibility in its discretion, it is not required by statute to issue regulations or guidance. INA sec. 103(a)(3), 8 U.S.C. 1103(a)(3). Furthermore, in the NPRM and this final rule, DHS has made it clear that USCIS will administer the ground of inadmissibility consistent with the statute and applicable precedent, and any USCIS guidance will guide but not prescribe officer discretion. This approach is consistent with INS' approach for most of the time this ground of inadmissibility existed. DHS only opted to issue binding regulations for the first time in 2019. As discussed in the NPRM and this final rule, DHS explained why retaining the 2022 Final Rule or returning to the 2019 Final Rule would not accomplish its objectives, and explained why DHS believes this rule is better, is more aligned with congressional intent and purpose, and fulfills its policy objective. 90 FR at 52180. Therefore, the rescission of the 2022 Final Rule is distinguishable from the rescission of the vehicle and traffic safety standards by the NHTSA in State Farm.
关于有评论者称国土安全部未解释为何该法规不能根据《H.R. 1法案》进行修改,国土安全部不清楚评论者所指为何。尽管《H.R. 1法案》缩小了补充营养援助计划(SNAP)的资格范围,并在特定例外情形下对全额医疗补助(Medicaid)福利的联邦配套资金施加了限制,[88]但尚不清楚国土安全部为何以及应如何考虑按照《H.R. 1法案》修订公共负担相关法规。
With respect to comments stating DHS did not explain why the regulations could not be modified in response to H.R. 1, DHS is unclear what the commenters meant. While H.R. 1 narrowed eligibility for SNAP and imposed limits on federal matching payments for full Medicaid benefits, subject to certain exceptions,[88] it is unclear how or why DHS should have considered amending public charge regulations in line with H.R. 1.
二、未能界定未定义的术语
ii. Failing To Define Undefined Terms
评论意见:一位评论者称,国土安全部拒绝界定其将在个案中适用的模糊法定术语,违反了“行政程序的基本准则,即机构须同案同判”这一原则,并无限期推迟发布指南,致使国土安全部各官员在执法时缺乏客观标准可循,因此其行为属于恣意和反复无常。另一位评论者表示赞同,并称拟议规则制定通知完全未提供任何指南,属于恣意和反复无常,因为该通知含糊不清,使个人无法知晓如何遵守规定,同时指出以下术语在拟议规则制定通知全文中多次使用却未作出定义:经济状况审查型公共福利、公共福利、公共福利项目、福利,以及公共资源。
Comment: A commenter said DHS acted arbitrarily and capriciously by refusing to define vague statutory terms that it would be applying in individual cases, by transgressing the “fundamental norm of administrative procedure [that] requires an agency to treat like cases alike,” and by postponing guidance indefinitely and leaving individual DHS officers with no objective standard to follow. Another commenter agreed and said the NPRM's complete lack of guidance is arbitrary and capricious because it is vague, precludes individuals from knowing how to comply, while asserting the following terms are used multiple times throughout the NPRM without providing definitions: means-tested public benefit, public benefits, public benefit program, benefits, and public resources.
回应:国土安全部不认同本最终规则因未将作出公共负担不准入认定时所涉及的某些术语的定义予以成文化(第45343页)而属于恣意和反复无常。国土安全部认为无需对所述术语作出定义,并指出在2019年最终规则出台之前,各官员已成功适用1999年临时实地指南;而在1999年之前,官员同样是依据法律条文、判例决定及适用的机构指南,在没有具有约束力的法规定义的情况下,就个案作出合理的公共负担不准入认定。事实上,自1882年至2019年最终规则出台之前,从未就公共负担不准入认定制定过成文定义。如其他回应中所述,USCIS将发布次级法规指南,该指南将于本最终规则生效之日起生效,以协助官员适用公共负担不准入事由。
Response: DHS disagrees that this final rule is arbitrary and capricious because it does not codify definitions of certain terms implicated in making ( printed page 45343) public charge inadmissibility determinations. DHS does not believe it is necessary to define the terms referenced, noting prior to the 2019 Final Rule officers successfully applied the 1999 Interim Field Guidance; and prior to 1999, officers similarly applied the statute, precedent decisions, and applicable agency guidance to make reasonable case-by-case public charge inadmissibility decisions without binding regulatory definitions. In fact, there were no codified definitions governing the public charge inadmissibility determination from 1882 until the 2019 Final Rule. As noted in other responses, USCIS will issue subregulatory guidance that will go into effect on the effective date of this final rule to assist officers with applying the public charge ground of inadmissibility.
国土安全部认同其在拟议规则制定通知中曾交替使用某些术语,并认同术语使用应保持一致性为宜。在提及公共福利和/或资源时,国土安全部在所有情形下所指均为经济状况审查型公共福利;在提及公共福利项目时,国土安全部意指提供经济状况审查型公共福利的联邦、州、属地、部落及地方项目。国土安全部认为无需将“经济状况审查型公共福利”一词的定义予以成文化,因为该术语通常被理解为指个人或家庭的收入和/或资产低于特定门槛即可获得资格的政府项目或福利。[89]
DHS agrees it used certain terms interchangeably in the NPRM and agrees consistent use of terms is preferable. When referring to public benefits and/or resources, DHS in all cases meant means-tested public benefits and when referring to public benefit programs, DHS intended to refer to Federal, State, territorial, Tribal, and local programs that provide means-tested public benefits. DHS does not believe that codifying a definition of means-tested public benefits is necessary as that term is generally understood to refer to a government program or benefit where eligibility is based on an individual's or family's income and/or assets falling below a specific threshold.[89]
三、对所有经济状况审查型公共福利的考量
iii. Consideration of All Means-Tested Public Benefits
评论意见:有评论者表示,该拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)具有任意性和反复无常的性质,因为其未能恰当地解释为何参与那些旨在改善健康、教育和财务稳定状况的公共福利项目,或者本质上属于补充性而非维持生计所必需、又或者并不表明缺乏自给自足能力的公共福利项目的情况,与公共负担不可入境性认定具有相关性。一位评论者表示,国土安全部(DHS)忽视了在制定2022年规则时所依据的数据和证据,这些数据和证据表明领取补充性福利与就业率和自给自足能力的提高存在关联。另一位评论者指出,第七巡回上诉法院得出了类似结论,观察到许多受涵盖的福利属于补充性资源而非主要资源。该评论者写道,两家法院均认识到,利用福利补充个人生活与因缺乏自给自足能力而使用福利之间存在关键区别,并断言该NPRM未能如《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)所要求的那样作出此种区分,这使得DHS无法“证明存在正当理由”来支持该政策,并可能再次面临被裁定为任意和反复无常的风险。
Comment: Commenters said the NPRM is arbitrary and capricious because it fails to cogently explain why participation in public benefit programs that improve health, educational, and financial stability, or are otherwise supplemental not necessary for subsistence or not indicative of a lack of self-sufficiency, is relevant to the public charge inadmissibility determination. One commenter said DHS ignores the data and evidence relied on in promulgating the 2022 Rule showing receipt of supplemental benefits is associated with increased employment and self-sufficiency. The other commenter indicated that the Seventh Circuit reached a similar conclusion, observing many covered benefits are supplemental rather than primary resources. The commenter wrote that both courts recognized a crucial distinction between using benefits to supplement one's life and using them due to lack of self-sufficiency, and asserted the NPRM made no such distinction as PRWORA requires, leaving DHS unable to “show that there are good reasons” for the policy and risking another arbitrary and capricious ruling.
回应:DHS不认同其未能解释参与某些公共福利项目与公共负担不可入境性认定之间的相关性,也不认同其未能考虑2022年最终规则所依据的证据或政策考量这一说法。尽管DHS在NPRM中并未直接论及评论者所提及的、关于领取某些福利与就业及自给自足能力之间关系的2022年最终规则中的数据和证据,但DHS推行本次规则制定的根本理由使得此类讨论显得多余,因为DHS并未制定某种依赖性门槛,也未仅凭外国人领取一项或多项公共福利即判定其不可入境。同样,DHS也并未根据某项公共福利是仅仅补贴外国人的生活,还是满足外国人的基本需求,而对各类公共福利加以区分,DHS也不否认某些经经济状况调查的公共福利有助于外国人走向自给自足。相反,DHS开展本次规则制定的目的在于使公共负担不可入境性条款与国会的意图和立法目的保持一致,并确保所有不可入境性认定均由官员基于外国人情况的整体考量作出,且官员有权考虑所有相关信息和证据,包括外国人可能领取的全部福利范围及其领取福利的具体情况。在执行公共负担不可入境性条款时,DHS必须确保不允许那些在任何时候都有可能成为公共负担的外国人获准入境或调整身份为合法永久居民(LPR)。在NPRM中,DHS引用了相关判例和近期法院判决,为“领取经经济状况调查的公共福利与公共负担不可入境性认定具有相关性”这一前提提供了支持。参见《联邦公报》第90卷第52168页,第52186至52187页(2025年11月19日)。此外,DHS认为,官员在综合考量外国人的整体情况时,将会评估外国人领取任何特定经经济状况调查公共福利的相对重要性,并将提供培训和指导以支持准确的裁决。随着2022年最终规则的废止,官员将能够考虑以下因素:外国人是否仅在短期内领取经经济状况调查的公共福利、领取的援助金额是否较小、是否因领取某项特定公共福利而变得依赖该福利、领取经经济状况调查的公共福利是永久性的还是临时性的,以及外国人总体上是否具备实现并保持自给自足的良好前景。
Response: DHS disagrees it failed to explain how participation in certain public benefit programs is relevant to public charge inadmissibility determinations or failed to consider the evidence or policy considerations underlying the 2022 Final Rule. While DHS did not directly address the data and evidence from the 2022 Final Rule about the relationship between receipt of certain benefits and employment and self-sufficiency referenced by commenters in the NPRM, DHS's underlying rationale for this rulemaking makes such discussion superfluous because DHS is not promulgating a dependence threshold or making an alien inadmissible exclusively based on the receipt of one or more public benefits. Similarly, DHS is not drawing distinctions between public benefits based on whether they merely subsidize an alien's life or provide for the alien's basic needs, nor is DHS disputing the fact that some means-tested public benefits assist aliens on the path to self-sufficiency. Rather, DHS is engaging in this rulemaking to bring the public charge ground of inadmissibility in line with congressional intent and purpose and to ensure that all inadmissibility determinations are made by officers in the totality of the alien's circumstances and that officers are empowered to consider all relevant information and evidence, including the full universe of benefits aliens may have received and the circumstances surrounding such receipt. In administering the public charge ground of inadmissibility DHS must ensure that it does not permit aliens who are likely at any time to become a public charge to be admitted or adjust their status to that of an LPR. In the NPRM, DHS referenced precedent and recent court opinions providing support for the premise that receiving means-tested public benefits is relevant to public charge inadmissibility determinations. See90 FR 52168, 52186-87 (Nov. 19, 2025). Furthermore, DHS believes that officers will consider the relative importance of the alien's receipt of any particular means-tested public benefit in the totality of the circumstances and will provide training and guidance to support accurate adjudications. With the 2022 Final Rule removed, officers will be able to consider whether the alien: received means-tested public benefits for only a short period of time, received small dollar amounts of assistance, received any particular public benefit rendering the alien dependent on the benefit, received means-tested public benefits permanently or temporarily, and has good overall prospects for being and remaining self-sufficient.
DHS不同意《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)在公共负担不可入境性认定的背景下,在表明缺乏自给自足能力的经济状况调查公共福利与仅仅补充外国人生活方式的福利之间创设了区分这一观点。PRWORA阐明了公共福利及其资格在国家政策目标中的作用,根据公共福利类型及外国人的移民身份规定了资格规则,包括为此类资格规则设立例外情形。见《美国法典》第8编第1601条及以下条款。DHS同意第七巡回上诉法院在Cook County诉Wolf案中认定DHS未能解释其为何改变了长期以来将非现金福利排除在公共负担不可入境性认定之外的政策,但第七巡回上诉法院并未认定考虑此类福利事实上属于任意和反复无常的行为。[90]同样,第二巡回上诉法院在Make the Road New York诉Cuccinelli案中也着重关注DHS对考虑非现金公共福利所作的解释,而非认定此类考虑本身事实上不合理。[91]DHS认为这些案件与本规则有所区别。2019年最终规则的做法是,只要达到持续时间门槛(12个月或以上),接受任何所列公共福利均产生相同的后果。2019年最终规则不仅规定考虑非现金福利,还规定在综合考量情形时,对围绕接受任何一项(第45344页)公共福利(无论类型)的某些情形赋予重大权重,本最终规则并未如此规定。
DHS disagrees that PRWORA created a distinction in the context of public charge inadmissibility determinations between means-tested public benefits denoting a lack of self-sufficiency and benefits merely supplementing an alien's lifestyle. PRWORA outlined the national policy objectives for the role of public benefits and eligibility for the same, specifying eligibility rules based on public benefit types and an alien's immigration status, including establishing exceptions from such eligibility rules. 8 U.S.C. 1601, et seq. DHS agrees the Seventh Circuit in Cook County v. Wolf found it failed to explain why it changed its longstanding policy of excluding non-cash benefits from the public charge inadmissibility determination, but the Seventh Circuit did not hold the consideration of such benefits was de facto arbitrary and capricious.[90] Similarly, the Second Circuit in Make the Road New York v. Cuccinelli also focused on DHS's explanation for considering non-cash public benefits rather than finding such consideration was de facto unreasonable.[91] DHS believes these cases are distinguishable from this rule. The 2019 Final Rule approach treated the receipt of any included public benefits as having the same consequences as long as the durational threshold (12 months or more) was met. The 2019 Final Rule not only provided for the consideration of non-cash benefits but also prescribed heavy weight in the totality of the circumstances to certain circumstances surrounding the receipt of any one ( printed page 45344) public benefit (regardless of type); this Final Rule does not do that.
评论:一位评论者表示,拟议规则没有提供任何证据支持DHS“认为此前接受经济状况调查公共福利是判断未来依赖政府维持生计可能性的关键衡量标准”这一说法,并称DHS理由存在根本缺陷,因其未就此信念提供任何事实依据。该评论者推理称,这些福利计划的目标和资格标准与DHS的假设相悖,表明这些计划旨在为广泛的人群提供补充性支持,正如移民归化局(INS)在1999年所确认的那样。
Comment: A commenter said the proposed rule offers no evidence to support DHS's “belie[f] that any prior receipt of means-tested public benefits is a key gauge to determining the likelihood of future dependence on the government for subsistence” and the fundamental flaw of DHS's justification is it does not provide any factual basis for this belief. The commenter reasoned the goals and eligibility criteria of these benefits programs belie DHS's assumption and show these programs are designed to provide supplemental support to a broad swath of the population, as INS recognized in 1999.
回应:DHS认为该评论者误解了DHS关于废除2022年最终规则的提议,以及该提议在扩大所考虑公共福利范围方面对公共负担不可入境性认定的影响。该拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)并未声明考虑更广泛的公共福利将导致外国人事实上被认定为根据公共负担理由不可入境,也未声明废除2022年最终规则将提高接受经济状况调查公共福利在公共负担不可入境性认定中的重要性。相反,DHS援引了判例裁决,认定接受公共福利本身并非决定结果的因素,[92]并强调过去接受经济状况调查公共福利只是综合考量各种情形中的一项考量因素。[93]如其他评论回应中所述,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将发布低位阶规章指南,帮助其官员确定在综合考量各种情形时如何最妥善地考虑外国人目前及过去接受经济状况调查公共福利的情况。
Response: DHS believes the commenter misunderstood DHS's proposal to remove the 2022 Final Rule and the impact on public charge inadmissibility determinations in expanding the consideration of a broader universe of public benefits. The NPRM did not state that considering a broader universe of public benefits would result in aliens de facto being found inadmissible under the public charge ground or the removal of the 2022 Final Rule would elevate the importance of receipt of means-tested public benefits in public charge inadmissibility determinations. To the contrary, DHS cited to precedent decisions holding receipt of public benefits is not in itself outcome determinative [92] and highlighted that the past receipt of means-tested public benefits is one consideration in the totality of the circumstances.[93] As discussed in other comment responses, USCIS will issue subregulatory guidance to help its officers determine how to best consider the alien's current and past receipt of means-tested public benefits in the totality of the circumstances.
四、缺乏替代框架或指南
iv. Lack of Replacement Framework or Guidance
评论:一位评论者表示,通过提议废除与公共负担不可入境性相关的监管指南,DHS破坏了对法律及其含义的共同理解。该评论者指出,DHS拟议删除的裁决标准对于法律的公平、透明和一致适用是必要的,并警告称,所有利益相关方都必须了解公共负担规则何时适用、对谁适用、何时不适用、对谁不适用,但DHS却提议删除解释适用性、豁免和放弃规定的相关条例。
Comment: One commenter said by proposing to remove regulatory guidance related to public charge inadmissibility, DHS undermines a shared understanding of the law and its meaning. The commenter stated that the adjudicatory standards DHS proposes to erase are necessary to fair, transparent, and consistent application of law, and warned that all stakeholders must understand when and to whom the public charge rule does and does not apply, yet DHS proposes to remove the regulations explaining applicability, exemptions, and waivers.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)同意受监管公众应当理解公共负担不可入境性理由如何适用以及适用于何人。正如在《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)及对其他评论的回应中所解释的那样,国土安全部认为,数十年来指导公共负担不可入境性认定的法规及相关判例决定,为判断外国人在任何时候是否可能成为公共负担提供了充分的指引。然而,为确保透明度和裁决的一致性,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将发布亚法规指导意见,说明在本最终规则下,官员将如何考虑外国人领取任何经济状况审查类公共福利的情况,并确保官员在外国人整体情况中充分考虑这一因素以及与判断外国人在任何时候成为公共负担可能性相关的任何其他因素或信息,以符合国会的意图。
Response: DHS agrees the regulated public should understand how and to whom the public charge ground of inadmissibility applies. As explained in the NPRM and other responses to comments, DHS believes the statute and applicable precedent decisions that guided the public charge inadmissibility determinations for decades provide sufficient guideposts for determining whether an alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. However, to ensure transparency and consistent adjudications, USCIS will issue subregulatory guidance that will explain how officers, under this final rule, will be able to consider the alien's receipt of any means-tested public benefits and will ensure officers fully consider this and any other factors or information relevant to determining an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge in the totality of the alien's circumstances, as Congress intended.
关于从国土安全部法规中删除豁免和放弃清单属于武断和反复无常的担忧,正如《拟议规则制定通知》中所述,这些豁免是法定的,不会受到法规删除的影响。90 FR 52168, 52192 (2025年11月19日)。为向受监管公众提供关于豁免和放弃事项的便捷参考点,国土安全部将在USCIS网站、《USCIS政策手册》以及I-485表格上保留该清单。
With respect to concerns that the removal from DHS regulations of the list of exemptions and waivers is arbitrary and capricious, as stated in the NPRM, these exemptions are statutory and will not be impacted by the removal of the regulations. 90 FR 52168, 52192 (Nov. 19, 2025). In order to provide a convenient reference point for the regulated public as to the exemptions and waivers, DHS will retain the list on the USCIS website, in the USCIS Policy Manual, and on the Form I-485.
五、信赖利益
v. Reliance Interests
评论:一些评论者针对国土安全部关于2022年最终规则哪些方面产生了信赖利益的询问作出了回应。评论者指出了产生信赖利益的关键要素:
Comment: Some commenters responded to DHS's request regarding which aspects of the 2022 Final Rule engendered reliance interests. Commenters identified key elements that engendered reliance interests:
除用于维持收入的现金援助以及由政府出资的长期机构收容外,不考虑任何其他福利;
That no benefits would be considered other than cash assistance for income maintenance and long-term institutionalization at government expense;
不考虑家庭成员申请或领取福利的情况;
That applications for or receipt of benefits by family members would not be considered;
外国人在不受公共负担不可入境性理由约束的移民身份期间领取公共福利的情况不予考虑;以及
That receipt of public benefits while the alien was in an immigration status that is not subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility would not be considered; and
关于非现金福利申请的信息不会被共享或用于移民目的。
That information on applications for non-cash benefits would not be shared or used for immigration purposes.
回应:国土安全部感谢评论者提供的这些具体例子。虽然国土安全部将不加修改地采纳拟议的对2022年最终规则所颁布法规的撤销,但国土安全部已在本最终规则中根据公众评论提供了澄清,以应对其中一些潜在的信赖利益问题。这一做法符合国土安全部对国会国家政策目标的理解。国土安全部指出,鉴于自2019年以来的法规变化,以及随后针对2019年和2022年最终规则的诉讼,受监管公众目前的信赖利益不如1999年临时实地指南被2019年最终规则取代时受监管公众的信赖利益那般重大,因为受监管公众已通过反复的规则制定和诉讼,被告知各届政府在公共负担不可入境性理由方面政策目标和处理方式存在重大差异。[94]
Response: DHS thanks the commenters for these specific examples. While DHS is adopting the proposed rescission of the regulations promulgated by the 2022 Final Rule without change, DHS has provided clarifications in this final rule in response to public comments to address some of these potential reliance interests. This approach is consistent with DHS' understanding of Congress's national policy objectives. DHS notes that given the regulatory changes since 2019, and subsequent litigation challenging the 2019 and 2022 Final Rules, the current reliance interests of the regulated public are not as significant as the reliance interests of the regulated public at the time the 1999 Interim Field Guidance was superseded with the 2019 Final Rule because the regulated public was placed on notice by recurring rulemakings and litigation of the significant differences in policy objectives and approaches among administrations when it comes to the public charge ground of inadmissibility.[94]
关于2022年最终规则对公共现金援助以维持收入以及政府出资的长期机构照护以外福利的考量所限定的信赖利益,国土安全部(DHS)澄清,一旦本最终规则生效,对于在本规则生效日期当日或之后获得的福利,官员可考虑的基于经济状况调查的公共福利将不再受到限制。但是,除以医疗补助(Medicaid)资助的长期机构照护服务外,官员将不考虑在本最终规则生效日期之前所获得的非现金公共福利(包括记录中任何显示外国人在本最终规则生效日期之前申请、经核准或批准接受公共福利的信息)。然而,如果证据显示该外国人已获批准或核准接受福利的期限延伸至本最终规则生效日期之后(第45345页打印版),若该外国人未能提供证据证明其已退出此类福利,或已撤回该申请,或已通知有关机构其不再希望接受该福利,国土安全部将在发生于本最终规则生效日期当日或之后的情况综合考量中,考虑该申请、核准及领取此类福利的情形。关于本规则前瞻性适用的更详细讨论,请参见本最终规则序言第III.D.5节。
For reliance interests engendered by the 2022 Final Rule's limitations on the consideration of benefits outside of public cash assistance for income maintenance and long-term institutionalization at government's expense, DHS clarified that once this final rule goes into effect, there will be no limit on which means-tested public benefits officers can consider for benefits received on or after the effective date of the rule. However, with the exception of Medicaid-funded services for long-term institutionalization, officers will not consider non-cash public benefits received before the effective date of this final rule (including any information in the record that the alien applied for, was certified or approved to receive public benefits before the effective date of this final rule). However, where the evidence reflects that the alien has been approved or certified to receive benefits for a ( printed page 45345) period that extends beyond the effective date of this final rule, if the alien does not provide evidence of disenrollment from such benefits or that he or she withdrew such application or notified the relevant agencies he or she no longer wanted to receive the benefits, DHS would consider the application, certification, and receipt of such benefits in the totality of the circumstances that occurs on or after the effective date of the final rule. For a more detailed discussion of the prospective application of this rule, please see section III.D.5. of this final rule's preamble.
关于“领取”一词的定义,以及家庭成员申请或领取福利不应被视为公共负担不可入境性认定考量因素的说明,国土安全部既未提议,本最终规则也未指示官员考虑外国人家庭成员领取公共福利的信息,除非该家庭成员本人正在申请入境或调整身份且须适用公共负担不可入境事由。因此,国土安全部通常不会考虑外国人家庭成员申请、核准或批准接受、或领取公共福利的情况。正如在其他意见回应中所讨论的,国土安全部将外国人的收入作为强制性资产、资源和财务状况因素的一部分加以考量,若记录中有证据显示外国人在法律上负有抚养义务的家庭成员因外国人的收入低于规定门槛而领取基于经济状况调查的公共福利,国土安全部将在综合考量情况中,将此事实作为外国人资产、资源和财务状况的一部分予以考虑。鉴于外国人必须将从基于经济状况调查的公共福利中获得的任何收入从其在I-485表格中提供的家庭收入信息中排除,若将家庭中其他人领取的基于经济状况调查的公共福利金额计入家庭收入,可能导致依据《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(6)(C)(i)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(6)(C)(i),作出不可入境认定。
For the definition of receipt and the statement that applications for, or receipt of benefits by family members should not be considered in a public charge inadmissibility determination, DHS did not propose nor does this final rule direct officers to consider information about an alien's family member's receipt of public benefits, unless that family member is applying for admission or adjustment of status and is subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility. As such, DHS will generally not consider the application for, certification or approval to receive, or receipt of public benefits by the alien's family members. As discussed in other comment responses, DHS considers the alien's income as part of the mandatory assets, resources, and financial status factor, and if there is evidence in the record the alien's family members whom the alien is legally obligated to support receive means-tested public benefits based on the alien's income falling below the designated threshold, DHS would consider that fact as part of the alien's assets, resources, and financial status in the totality of the circumstances. Given the alien must exclude any income received from means-tested public benefits from household income information provided on the Form I-485, the inclusion of amounts received from means-tested public benefits by others in the household as household income may lead to an inadmissibility finding under section 212(a)(6)(C)(i) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(6)(C)(i).
针对对于在不适用公共负担不可入境事由的身份期间领取基于经济状况调查的公共福利的担忧意见,国土安全部认为,通过澄清说明在2022年最终规则下此前未被考量的基于经济状况调查的公共福利,若在本最终规则生效日期之前获得,也将不被考量,这些信赖利益至少已得到部分解决。国土安全部指出,许多在免除公共负担不可入境事由类别下领取基于经济状况调查的公共福利的外国人,也能够以同样免除公共负担不可入境事由的类别(例如T类和U类非移民以及《针对妇女暴力法》受益人)调整身份为合法永久居民(LPR)。对于以不同类别调整身份的外国人,或无法以免除类别调整身份的外国人,国土安全部指出,在没有2022年最终规则过度僵化框架的情况下,官员可以考量领取公共福利的具体情形。官员可对此类福利的领取给予有限的权重,审查支持该外国人获得此类福利资格的任何公共政策考量,以及官员在综合考量情况中通常考虑的其他因素,例如(但不限于)领取的持续时间或金额、导致领取的情形是暂时性还是永久性、外国人的年龄、健康状况、家庭状况、工作前景等。
For comments expressing concern regarding the consideration of means-tested public benefits while in a status not subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility, DHS believes these reliance interests are at least partially addressed by clarifying means-tested public benefits not previously considered under the 2022 Final Rule will also not be considered if received before the effective date of this final rule. DHS notes many aliens who received means-tested public benefits while in categories exempt from the public charge ground of inadmissibility are also able to adjust their status to that of LPR in a category similarly exempt from the public charge ground of inadmissibility ( e.g., T and U nonimmigrants and VAWA beneficiaries). For aliens who adjust under a different category, or aliens who cannot adjust under an exempt category, DHS notes, without the unduly rigid framework of the 2022 Final Rule, officers can consider the specific circumstances in which public benefits were received. Officers may give limited weight to the receipt of such benefits, examining any public policy considerations underlying the alien's eligibility for them, along with other factors officers normally consider in the totality of the circumstances; such as (but not limited to) duration or amount of receipt, whether circumstances leading to receipt were temporary or permanent, alien's age, health, family status, work prospects, etc.
最后,国土安全部(DHS)指出,在2019年最终规则出台之前,根据1999年临时现场指南,对于在豁免类别期间获得的经济状况调查类公共福利的考量并无限制。如果外国人在豁免公共负担认定的身份期间领取了公共现金救助或由政府出资的长期机构照护,其后又寻求调整身份为受公共负担认定约束类别下的合法永久居民(LPR),则此类领取情况可在整体情况考量中予以考虑。因此,国土安全部目前采取的做法与该部以往做法一致,国土安全部在移民类别间采取一致做法的利益,超过2022年最终规则所遗留的任何依赖利益。
Finally, DHS notes that prior to the 2019 Final Rule, under the 1999 Interim Field Guidance, there was no limitation on the consideration of means-tested public benefits received while in an exempt category. If an alien received public cash assistance or long-term institutionalization at government's expense while in a status exempt from public charge and subsequently sought to adjust status to an LPR in a category subject to public charge, such receipt could be considered in the totality of the circumstances. Therefore, the approach DHS is taking now is consistent with past agency practice, and DHS's interest in taking a consistent approach across immigration categories outweighs any remaining reliance interests from the 2022 Final Rule.
关于所识别出的最后一项依赖要素,即非现金福利申请中所含信息不会被共享或用于移民执法目的,国土安全部指出,2022年最终规则将非现金福利的申请、获批或获得资格认证或领取排除在考量范围之外,但并未就此背景下福利提供机构与国土安全部之间的信息共享问题作出规定。国土安全部未曾提议,本最终规则也未涉及任何机构间的信息共享问题。因此,此部分意见超出本规则的范围。
The last element of reliance identified—that information included on non-cash benefits applications would not be shared or used for immigration purposes—DHS notes that the 2022 Final Rule excluded from consideration the applications, approval or certification to receive, or receipt of non-cash benefits, but it did not address information sharing between benefit providing agencies and DHS in this context. DHS did not propose nor does this final rule address any information sharing between agencies. Therefore, this portion of the comment is out of scope.
意见:有评论者表示,该拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)忽视了依赖利益,指出各家庭、倡导团体及服务提供者在申请医疗、营养和住房项目时,依赖2022年最终规则所提供的明确性。评论者指出,联邦层面方向不明确会削弱联邦制及各州的依赖利益,扰乱广泛的州及地方网络体系,并可能因阻碍民众使用诸如医疗补助计划(Medicaid)、补充营养援助计划(SNAP)及幼儿支持等项目,而使公共卫生和财政状况恶化。这些评论者指出,各机构若未能充分考虑依赖利益,将引发有关溯及力、武断决策及对申请人不平等对待等严重问题。另一位评论者表示赞同,并指出国土安全部不仅必须识别依赖利益或就此征求公众意见,还必须在推翻先前政策时切实考虑并权衡依赖利益,并解释为何不希望出现不同的政策结果。评论者指出,在宣布全面废止现行框架之后才就依赖利益征求意见,并不构成最高法院所要求的具备“依赖利益意识”的“合理解释”。评论者援引“国土安全部诉加利福尼亚大学董事会案”(Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the University of California),该案中最高法院强调,机构在变更政策时必须考虑所培育的“依赖利益”,并认定未能如此可能使该行为依据《行政程序法》(APA)构成武断且反复无常之行为。
Comment: Commenters said the NPRM disregarded reliance interests, noting families, advocacy groups, and service providers relied on the 2022 Final Rule's clarity when enrolling in health, nutrition, and housing programs. Commenters stated that unclear Federal direction undermines federalism and State reliance interests, disrupts extensive State and local networks, and risks worsening public health and fiscal outcomes by deterring use of programs like Medicaid, SNAP, and early childhood supports. These commenters stated that agencies failing to account for reliance interests raises serious concerns about retroactivity, arbitrary decision-making, and unequal treatment of applicants. Another commenter agreed and said that DHS must not only identify reliance interests or invite public input on them but it must meaningfully consider and weigh the reliance interests when reversing prior policy and explain why they do not want a different policy outcome. Commenters stated that merely soliciting comments about reliance after announcing wholesale rescission of the operative framework is not the “reasoned explanation” with “awareness” of reliance interests required by the Supreme Court. Commenters cited Department of Homeland Security v. Regents of the University of California, where the Supreme Court emphasized agencies must consider the “reliance interests” fostered in changing policy, and found that failure to do so can render an action arbitrary and capricious under the APA.
回应:国土安全部不认同该拟议规则制定通知忽视了任何依赖利益,也不认同该通知或本最终规则体现了联邦方向不明确的问题。在拟议规则制定通知中,国土安全部具体阐述了此前的规则制定情况,并就特定依赖利益征求了反馈意见。国土安全部已依照最高法院先例,对所收到的意见及相关辅助材料,包括来自外国人、移民服务提供者、州及地方政府等方面的叙述性说明,进行了考量。[95]
