回应：关于亚利桑那州地方警察过去在交通拦截执法中进行种族定性以实施移民执法而滥用裁量权的担忧，其与本次规则制定或公共负担不可入境认定之间的相关性并不明确。国土安全部官员是在外国人主动申请入境或调整身份时作出公共负担不可入境认定的。该不可入境理由适用于所有申请以移民身份入境及申请调整身份的外国人，无论其种族或原籍国为何，国土安全部在该理由适用时无权予以忽视。此外，国土安全部在适用任何不可入境理由时，并不基于种族针对特定人群。
Response: Regarding concerns relating to past abuses of discretion by local police in Arizona who engaged in racial profiling in traffic stops for immigration enforcement, the relevance to this rulemaking or public charge inadmissibility determinations is unclear. DHS officers make public charge inadmissibility determinations when an alien affirmatively applies for admission or adjustment of status. This inadmissibility ground applies to all aliens applying for admission as immigrants and applying for adjustment of status, regardless of their race or country of origin, and DHS does not have authority to ignore the ground when applicable. Moreover, DHS does not target certain populations on the basis of race when applying any ground of inadmissibility.
国土安全部指出，许多居住在美国并已领取经济状况调查类公共福利的古巴人和海地人，在申请某些移民福利时将被豁免公共负担不可入境理由的适用，从而将任何因考虑领取经济状况调查类公共福利而产生的影响降到最低。例如，根据《古巴调整法》、1998年《海地难民移民公平法》第902条以及1986年《移民改革与控制法》（IRCA）第202条申请调整身份的合格外国人，均可豁免适用公共负担不可入境理由。[143]
DHS notes many Cubans and Haitians present in the United States who have received means-tested public benefits would be exempt from the public charge ground of inadmissibility when applying for certain immigration benefits, minimizing any impact from the consideration of any receipt of means-tested public benefits. For example, eligible aliens applying for adjustment of status under the Cuban Adjustment Act, under section 902 of the Haitian Refugee Immigration Fairness Act of 1998, and under section 202 of the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA) are exempt from the public charge ground of inadmissibility.[143]
评论:一位评论者指出,该提案将把决定变成基于未明确定义的“情况整体”的主观判断,而另一位评论者写道,拟议依赖过去的先例和“情况整体”方法可能引入一定程度的主观性,从而导致裁定结果不一致,并进一步指出,这些原则的明确性和一致适用对确保公平性和可预测性至关重要。另一位评论者写道,拟议规则依赖“情况整体”标准,却未说明移民官员将如何权衡家庭成员福利使用情况,也未说明有何保障措施以防止将家庭成员福利使用视为推定未来依赖性的依据。
Comment: A commenter stated the proposal would turn decisions into subjective judgments based on an undefined “totality of the circumstances” while another wrote that the proposed reliance on past precedent and the “totality of the circumstances” approach could introduce a degree of subjectivity leading to inconsistent determinations, further stating that clarity and consistent application of these principles is crucial to ensure fairness and predictability. Another wrote the proposed rule relies on a “totality of the circumstances” test without identifying how immigration officers will weigh household benefit use and guardrails to prevent treating household benefit use as presumptively indicative of future dependence.
回应:公共负担不可入境性认定必然带有主观性,因为该认定具有前瞻性,且基于官员的判断。正如本序言其他部分所讨论的,国土安全部(DHS)致力于确保官员拥有及时、高效审理移民福利申请所需的资源。美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将在过渡期间向官员提供指导和培训,正如其在此类情况下通常所做的那样,从而缓解评论者的担忧。此外,为确保一致性和质量控制,USCIS将监督审理过程,并应用其常规质量控制流程。USCIS将根据需要持续评估和改进审理流程、程序及培训,以确保一致性。
Response: Public charge inadmissibility determinations are necessarily subjective because they are prospective and based on the opinion of the officer. As discussed elsewhere in this preamble, DHS is committed to ensuring officers have the necessary resources to timely and efficiently adjudicate applications for immigration benefits. USCIS will provide guidance and training to officers in the transition, as it generally does in such situations, ameliorating commenters' concerns. Furthermore, to ensure consistency and quality control, USCIS will monitor adjudications and apply its general quality control processes. USCIS will continually assess and improve the adjudication processes, procedures, and training as needed to ensure consistency.
尽管评论者可能对情况整体方法提出异议,但这一方法作为公共负担不可入境性认定的正确框架,已获得数十年的认可。国土安全部建议评论者查阅拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)中有关该框架在公共负担认定历史中的相关部分。见90 FR 52168,52174-52175页(2025年11月19日)。关于外国人家庭成员领取福利的问题,公共负担不可入境性认定的重点在于与申请签证、入境或身份调整的外国人本人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性相关的事实和情况,而非其家庭成员成为公共负担的可能性。正如其他评论回应中所解释的,外国人家庭成员领取经济状况审查公共福利,仅在以下情形下才与公共负担不可入境性认定相关:该福利是外国人本人的经济支持来源,或者领取经济状况审查公共福利的家庭成员是该外国人依法负有扶养义务的人。国土安全部将把这一事实作为外国人资产、资源和财务状况的一部分,纳入情况整体的考量中。[144]
While commenters may object to the totality of the circumstances, this approach to public charge inadmissibility has been recognized as the proper framework for many decades. DHS suggests that commenters review those portions of the NPRM relating to the history of this framework in public charge determinations. 90 FR 52168, 52174-52175 (Nov. 19, 2025). Regarding receipt of benefits by members of the alien's household, the public charge inadmissibility determination focuses on the facts and circumstances bearing on the likelihood at any time that the alien applying for a visa, admission, or adjustment of status will become a public charge, not the likelihood of his or her family members becoming a public charge. As explained in other comment responses, the receipt of means-tested public benefits by members of the alien's household would only be relevant to the public charge inadmissibility determination to the extent either those benefits are the alien's source of financial support or the household member who is receiving the means-tested public benefits is someone the alien is legally obligated to support. DHS would consider that fact as part of the alien's assets, resources, and financial status in the totality of the circumstances.[144]
评论:一位评论者对拟议规则赋予移民官员的自由裁量权表示关切,写道根据2022年最终规则,官员仅考虑外国人是否可能主要依赖现金救助或长期机构照护,这一方法此前已由移民归化局(INS)在1999年临时实地指南中确立,以简化公共负担不可入境性认定。另一位评论者指出,INS最初制定1999年临时实地指南,是因为社会普遍担忧福利使用情况如何影响公共负担认定存在混乱,以及由此产生的相关公共卫生后果。
Comment: A commenter expressed concern with the discretion provided to immigration officers under the proposed rule, writing that under the 2022 Final Rule officers only considered whether an alien is likely to become primarily dependent on cash-assistance or long-term institutionalization, an approach previously enshrined by INS in the 1999 Interim Field Guidance to simplify the public charge inadmissibility determination. Another commenter stated INS initially developed the 1999 Interim Field Guidance due to widespread concern over confusion surrounding how use of benefits impacted public charge determinations as well as the associated public health consequences.
回应:国土安全部不同意这些评论的前提。要求官员对所有其他类型经济状况审查公共福利的过去、当前或可能的未来领取情况视而不见,或许“简单”,但这既不符合《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4),也不符合国会在8 U.S.C. 1601(2)中关于公共福利与移民问题的国家政策声明。(印刷页第45356页)虽然某些类别的外国人可能有资格领取某些公共福利,但国会在INA第212(a)(4)条和第237(a)(5)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)和1227(a)(5)中,为选择领取这些福利的外国人设定了移民后果。国会明确列举了某些外国人领取公共福利的情形,在这些情形下,该福利领取不应被视为公共负担不可入境性认定的一部分。参见INA第212(s)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(s)。
Response: DHS disagrees with the premise of these comments. Requiring officers be willfully blind to the past, current, or likely future receipt of all other types of means-tested public benefits may be “simple” but inconsistent with both section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), and Congress's statement of national policy concerning public benefits and immigration in 8 U.S.C. 1601(2). While certain categories of aliens may be ( printed page 45356) eligible for some public benefits, Congress established immigration consequences for aliens choosing to receive those benefits in sections 212(a)(4) and 237(a)(5) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4) and 1227(a)(5). Congress explicitly enumerated the instances where certain aliens receiving public benefits do not have that receipt considered as part of the public charge inadmissibility determination. See INA sec. 212(s), 8 U.S.C. 1182(s).
评论意见:另一位评论者表示,虽然他们赞赏赋予官员更大的自由裁量权来评估不可予以入境性,但他们担心取消现有框架可能导致法律适用的一致性降低,并可能导致更为严苛的适用,从而无意中为本应符合资格的个人设置新的障碍。该评论者敦促国土安全部(DHS)考虑拟议变更的长期影响,并在未来的政策和解释性工具中优先考虑清晰性、公平性以及对个人具体情况的细致理解。
Comment: Another commenter said while they appreciated allowing officers greater discretion in evaluating inadmissibility, they were concerned that removing the existing framework could lead to a less consistent and potentially more restrictive application of the law, inadvertently creating new barriers for deserving individuals. The commenter urged DHS to consider the long-term implications of the proposed change and prioritize clarity, fairness, and a nuanced understanding of individual circumstances in future policies and interpretive tools.
回应:国土安全部同意,公共负担不可予以入境性认定必须体现对外国人个人具体情况的细致理解至关重要,即在综合考虑所有相关情况的基础上,审查所有相关信息和证据。忠实执行公共负担不可予以入境性条款,要求允许官员考虑所有此类相关信息和证据。这可能会增加调整身份申请人的信息收集负担,并可能导致更多外国人依照法规被正确认定为不可予以入境。然而,是国会制定了规范谁有资格、谁没有资格获得合法永久居民(LPR)身份这一重要利益的法规,而国土安全部与其他执行该条款的机构的职责,是识别那些不符合标准的外国人。此外,国土安全部指出,移民局(USCIS)将针对本最终规则项下移民局的调整身份裁决发布相关政策和解释性工具,以指导官员依法并基于对所有相关证据和信息的考虑作出公共负担不可予以入境性认定。
Response: DHS agrees it is critical public charge inadmissibility determinations reflect a nuanced understanding of an alien's individual circumstances i.e., a consideration of all relevant information and evidence in the totality of the circumstances. Faithful implementation of the public charge ground of inadmissibility requires allowing officers to consider all such relevant information and evidence. This may increase the information collection burden for adjustment applicants and may result in more aliens properly being found inadmissible in accordance with the statute. However, it is Congress who established the statutes governing who is, and is not, eligible to receive the important benefit of status as an LPR, and DHS's responsibility, with other agencies that administer this ground, to identify those aliens who fail to meet the criteria. Additionally, DHS notes that USCIS will issue policy and interpretive tools applicable to USCIS' adjustment of status adjudications under this final rule, which will guide officers in making public charge inadmissibility determinations consistent with the law and based on a consideration of all relevant evidence and information.
评论意见:一位评论者表示,虽然他们支持防止外国人获取经济状况审查类公共福利,但拟议规则允许基于对未来领取经济状况审查类公共福利的“单纯推测”作出公共负担不可予以入境性认定,这一做法过于宽泛。一位评论者写道,移民官员不太可能对移民未来的经济和社会发展轨迹作出合理评估,理由是研究表明,移民起初的收入通常低于平均水平,但会逐步提高收入阶层,最终比本土出生的美国公民需要更少的公共援助。
Comment: A commenter stated while they supported preventing aliens from accessing means-tested public benefits, the proposed rule was excessive in allowing a public charge inadmissibility determination based on “mere conjectures” about future receipt of means-tested public benefits. A commenter wrote it is unlikely immigration officers are able to make reasonable assessments of the future economic and social trajectory of immigrants, reasoning that research suggests immigrants at first typically have lower than average income, but climb the income ladder and eventually need less public assistance than native-born U.S. citizens.
回应:公共负担不可予以入境性是一项由官员意见作出的前瞻性认定。与此相对,且存在有限的例外情形[145],外国人因过去发生的事情或在裁决时为真实情况而根据其他条款被认定为不可予以入境。这些不可予以入境条款之间的根本差异,即有些是前瞻性的而有些不是,有些基于信念或意见而有些不是,是由国会确立的。就公共负担而言,自1891年国会将“可能成为公共负担者不得进入美国”这一条款编入法典以来,情况一直如此。尽管评论者可能反对基于国土安全部官员意见作出前瞻性认定的不可予以入境条款,但这是对法规本身的异议,而非对本最终规则的异议。国土安全部致力于确保官员做好充分准备,依照本最终规则一致地执行公共负担不可予以入境条款,具体措施包括移民局发布次级监管指南并对其官员进行培训等。
Response: The public charge ground of inadmissibility is a prospective determination made in the opinion of the officer. In contrast and with limited exceptions,[145] aliens are inadmissible under other grounds because of something that occurred in the past or is true at the time of adjudication. These fundamental differences between inadmissibility grounds, that some are prospective while others are not, and that some are based on belief or opinion while others are not, were established by Congress. For public charge, this has been the case since 1891, when Congress codified the provision that persons likely to become a public charge were excludable from the United States. While commenters may object to an inadmissibility ground based on a prospective determination made in the opinion of DHS officers, this is an objection to the statute, not this final rule. DHS is committed to ensuring that officers are well prepared to consistently implement the public charge ground of inadmissibility under this final rule by, among other things, USCIS issuing subregulatory guidance and providing training to its officers.
评论意见:一位评论者写道,国土安全部在社交媒体上发布的招聘移民官员职位的内容,以及部长发布的其他帖子内容表明,国土安全部正在鼓励员工以自由裁量权为幌子,超越《移民与国籍法》(INA)的界限,寻找拒绝移民服务申请人的借口。
Comment: A commenter wrote the content in DHS social media posts advertising job openings for immigration officers, as well as other posts by the Secretary, suggest that DHS is encouraging employees to go beyond the bounds of the INA in looking for pretexts under the guise of discretion to deny applicants for immigration services.
回应:国土安全部不同意任何暗示其鼓励或指示员工超越法定语言行事的说法。国土安全部致力于忠实执行我国移民法律,即便是那些长期被历届政府忽视、并被各类外国人系统性违反的法律,也不例外。本最终规则旨在恢复在法规全部范围内的充分适用。
Response: DHS disagrees with any suggestion that it is encouraging or instructing employees to go beyond statutory language. DHS is committed to the faithful implementation of our immigration laws, even those long ignored by previous administrations and systematically violated by categories of aliens. This final rule seeks to restore the use of the full bounds of the statute.
2. 缺乏替代性语言或框架
2. Lack of Replacement Language or Framework
评论:多名评论者表示担忧,在没有提供任何替代性语言或指导的情况下废止2022年最终规则,会造成不确定性、恐惧,并使人们回避申请或领取福利。多位评论者表示,担忧在没有完整和明确替代方案的情况下回撤2022年最终规则,将使移民社区、法律服务提供者、州和地方机构以及社区组织陷入长期不确定的状态,使其无法可靠地就公共负担不可准入性问题为外国人提供建议。一位评论者写道,缺乏明确标准将给许多相同的群体造成不确定性,特别是国会议员将无法为选民提供服务并提供可操作的信息。另一位评论者表示,影响移民社区的未来指导必须公开发布,以便家庭和倡导者了解相关规则,并且在缺乏明确法规的情况下,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)应被限制为仅适用制定法、相关判例法和长期确立的做法,而不应作出自由裁量判断。一位评论者指出,允许美国国土安全部(DHS)在没有公众意见参与的情况下作出实质性政策决定,将损害透明度、公共问责制和监管一致性。该评论者指出,对移民社区和公共卫生具有如此重大影响的政策,应接受充分的公众审查,而不应仅凭内部行政裁量决定。
Comment: Multiple commenters expressed concerns that rescinding the 2022 Final Rule without offering any replacement language or guidance creates uncertainty, fear, and avoidance of applying for or receiving benefits. Several commenters expressed concern that rolling back the 2022 Final Rule without a full and clear replacement would plunge immigrant communities, legal service providers, State and local agencies, and community organizations into a state of prolonged uncertainty, preventing them from reliably advising aliens on public charge inadmissibility. A commenter wrote that the lack of clear standards will create uncertainty for many of the same groups, and specifically Members of Congress would be unable to provide constituent services and provide actionable information. Another commenter said future guidance affecting immigrant communities must be publicly released so families and advocates understand the rules and in the absence of clear regulations, USCIS should be limited to applying the statute, relevant case law, and long-established practices, not making discretionary judgments. One commenter stated allowing DHS to make substantive policy decisions without public input would undermine transparency, public accountability, and regulatory consistency. The commenter noted policies with such significant implications for immigrant communities and public health should be subject to full public scrutiny and not internal administrative discretion.
另一位评论者写道,废止2022年最终规则而不以明确框架取而代之,并非一种中立行为,相反,这将导致任意、不一致和歧视性的决策,并损害移民制度的公平性。
Another commenter wrote that rescinding the 2022 Final Rule without replacing it with a clear framework is not a neutral act; rather, it invites arbitrary, inconsistent, and discriminatory decision-making and undermines the fairness of the immigration system.
答复:美国国土安全部不认同废止2022年最终规则而不以法规取代会造成不确定性、不一致性或歧视的观点。事实上,我们认为情况恰恰相反。2022年最终规则所实施的法规,通过严重且不当地限制美国国土安全部官员在作出公共负担不可准入性认定时可以考虑的因素和相关证据,损害了此类认定的准确性,从而与第14218号行政命令及《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)所载的国家政策,以及《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)条广泛法定文本的精神不相符。美国国土安全部同意官员应适用制定法、相关判例法及任何次级法规指导,但是,根据该法规(见原文第45357页),公共负担不可准入性认定必然依赖于官员的自由裁量。因此,美国国土安全部完全取消了2022年最终规则所确立的公共负担不可准入性框架(保证金条款除外),以更好地符合《个人责任与工作机会协调法》关于外国人应自给自足的指令,并遵守《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)(A)条的规定,该条指示美国国土安全部对任何时候可能成为公共负担的外国人拒绝准许入境及调整身份。事实上,美国国土安全部认为,2022年最终规则未能忠实执行《个人责任与工作机会协调法》及《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)(A)条,因为它们通过限制美国国土安全部在综合考量各种情况时可以考虑的公共福利种类,以及阻止官员考虑法规中列明的七项因素之外的其他因素,束缚了美国国土安全部官员的手脚。
Response: DHS disagrees that rescinding the 2022 Final Rule without regulatory replacement creates uncertainty, inconsistency, or discrimination. In fact, we believe the opposite is true. The regulations implemented by the 2022 Final Rule were inconsistent with the national policy contained in E.O. 14218 and PRWORA and the spirit of the broad statutory text in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), by severely and unduly limiting the factors and relevant evidence DHS officers could consider in making public charge inadmissibility determinations, undermining the accuracy of such determinations. DHS agrees that officers should apply the statute, relevant case law, and any subregulatory guidance, however, public charge inadmissibility determinations necessarily rely on an officer's discretion according to the ( printed page 45357) statute. Thus, DHS completely removed the public charge inadmissibility framework established by the 2022 Final Rule (with exception of the bond provisions) to better align with PRWORA's directive that aliens are self-sufficient and to comply with section 212(a)(4)(A) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A), which directs DHS to deny admission and adjustment of status to aliens likely at any time to become a public charge. Indeed, DHS believes the 2022 Final Rule did not faithfully implement PRWORA and section 212(a)(4)(A) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A), insofar as they straitjacket DHS officers by limiting what public benefits DHS can consider in the totality of the circumstances and by precluding officers from considering factors beyond the seven factors outlined in the regulations.
美国国土安全部指出,虽然其已在短期内取消了公共负担不可准入性法规,但在本最终规则生效日期之前或当日,美国公民及移民服务局将发布适当的政策和解释性工具,以指导公共负担不可准入性认定工作,同时使官员有权根据国会的本意,考虑《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(B)条、《美国法典》第8编第1182(a)(4)(B)条所规定的强制性法定因素,以及与外国人申请相关的所有个案具体因素和情况。[146]
DHS notes that while it has removed the public charge inadmissibility regulations in the short-term, in advance of or on the effective date of this final rule USCIS will publish appropriate policy and interpretive tools to guide public charge inadmissibility determinations while empowering officers to consider the mandatory statutory factors in section 212(a)(4)(B) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B) and all individualized case-specific factors and circumstances relevant to an alien's application, as Congress intended.[146]
3. 移民制度影响、运行负担和审理延误
3. Immigration System Impacts, Operational Burdens, and Processing Delays
评论:有评论者表示,对拟议规则表示担忧,认为该规则是对合法移民制度的攻击,这种攻击将破坏、动摇并摧毁该制度。另一位评论者写道,该拟议规则将对严重依赖家庭移民团聚家庭的第一代移民家庭产生负面影响,因为大多数人道主义途径均被豁免,且根据该规则,I-864表格的权重被降低。该评论者表示担忧,在新方法下,公共负担不可入境性认定将侧重于外国人的过去和当前财务状况,而忽视了表明即使是家庭移民在调整身份或获准入境后在美国也能实现经济繁荣的研究。其他评论者表示,废除2022年最终规则会破坏人道主义项目。
Comment: Commenters expressed concerns the proposed rule is an attack on the lawful immigration system, and that such an attack would undermine, destabilize, and destroy it. Another wrote that the proposed rule would negatively impact first-generation immigrant families who rely heavily on family-based immigration to reunite families because most humanitarian pathways are exempt and because of the diminished weight given to a Form I-864 under this rule. The commenter expressed their concern that public charge inadmissibility determinations under the new approach would focus on an alien's past and current financial status, discounting studies showing that even family-based immigrants thrive economically in the United States after adjustment of status or admission. Other commenters stated that removal of the 2022 Final Rule undermines humanitarian programs.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)不同意此观点。简而言之,废除2022年最终规则使国土安全部官员能够按照法规、《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)所表达的国会意图以及判例决定来作出公共负担不可入境性认定,并不妨碍受公共负担不可入境理由约束的外国人申请或获得其证明符合资格的任何移民福利。《移民与国籍法》(INA)第291条,8 U.S.C. 1361。本规则不会改变经济状况调查福利或家庭移民的资格。获批家庭移民申请的受益人外国人仍可申请入境和调整身份,如其证明符合资格,国土安全部可予以批准。国土安全部不认为国会有意让国土安全部在执行《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条、8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)时,不考虑外国人为帮助自身实现自给自足而领取食品、医疗和住房福利的情况。国土安全部认为,撤销2022年最终规则最终将通过确保在任何时候很可能成为公共负担的外国人被拒绝入境或拒绝调整身份,从而加强合法移民制度。
Response: DHS disagrees. Simply put, removal of the 2022 Final Rule empowers DHS officers to make public charge inadmissibility determinations consistent with the statute, congressional intent expressed in PRWORA, and precedent decisions, and does not prevent aliens who are subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility from applying for or obtaining any immigration benefit for which they demonstrate eligibility. INA sec. 291, 8 U.S.C. 1361. This rule does not alter eligibility for means-tested benefits or family-based immigration. Aliens who are beneficiaries of approved family-based immigrant petitions will still be able to apply for admission and for adjustment of status, which DHS may grant if they have demonstrated eligibility. DHS does not believe Congress intended for DHS to administer section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), in a manner that fails to account for aliens' receipt of food, medical, and housing benefits to help aliens become self-sufficient. DHS believes that rescission of the 2022 Final Rule will ultimately strengthen the legal immigration system by ensuring that aliens who are likely at any time to become a public charge are refused admission or denied adjustment of status.
至于人道主义项目,[147]国会已将申请许多此类人道主义福利的外国人豁免于公共负担不可入境理由之外。[148]因此,国土安全部驳斥以下观点,即修改国土安全部官员作出公共负担不可入境性认定的方式会影响,更不用说破坏,那些公共负担理由根本不适用的人道主义项目。
As for humanitarian programs,[147] Congress exempted aliens applying for many of these humanitarian benefits from the public charge ground of inadmissibility.[148] Therefore, DHS rejects the idea that modifying how DHS officers make public charge inadmissibility determinations will impact, much less undermine, humanitarian programs to which the public charge ground does not even apply.
评论:一位评论者表示,取消2022年公共负担不可入境法规将迫使美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)陷入更深的积压,损害移民和美国公民双方的利益,而其他评论者则对拟议规则带来的运营负担增加、处理延误和处理时间延长以及积压表示担忧。一位评论者表示,该规则是对时间、资源和公共资金的浪费,而其他评论者则表示,缺乏明确指导以及逐案作出的公共负担不可入境性决定将增加USCIS、裁决工作和法律挑战的行政负担,降低效率。
Comment: One commenter stated removing the 2022 public charge inadmissibility regulations would force USCIS into deeper backlogs hurting immigrants and U.S. citizens alike, while other commenters voiced concern with increased operational burdens, processing delays and longer processing times, and backlogs resulting from the proposed rule. A commenter said this rule is a waste of time, resources, and public money, while others stated the lack of clear guidance and case-by-base public charge inadmissibility decisions would increase administrative burdens on USCIS, adjudications, and legal challenges, reducing efficiency.
其他评论者表示,拟议规则赋予移民官员更大的自由裁量权将导致裁决时间更长、可靠性更低。另一位评论者警告称,拟议规则下不断扩大的证据要求可能导致处理时间延长、案件积压增加和运营成本上升。该评论者表示,这些负担反过来可能对依赖可预测且高效的移民处理流程的家庭、雇主和社区机构产生负面影响。
Other commenters stated that the increased discretion afforded to immigration officers under the proposed rule would result in longer and less reliable adjudications. Another commenter warned that the expanded evidentiary requirements under the proposed rule could lead to longer processing times, increased case backlogs, and higher operational costs. The commenter said, in turn, these burdens could negatively impact families, employers, and community institutions that depend on predictable and efficient immigration processing.
一位评论者要求国土安全部实施一个避免产生新负担的新框架。一些评论者表示,该规则将给USCIS带来大量新的工作负荷,而USCIS在裁决申请方面已经存在积压;规则中的成本分析仅涉及对公众的成本,未涉及USCIS实施该规则的行政成本;而且官员将被要求仔细核查公共福利项目的细节(印刷页45358),这超出了其职责范围,并需要分析更为庞大的记录,从而增加了时间和资源负担。
A commenter requested that DHS implement a new framework that avoids creating new burdens. Some commenters stated that the rule would impose a substantial new workload on USCIS, which is already backlogged in adjudicating applications, the cost analysis in the rule addresses only the costs to the public, not the administrative costs to USCIS of implementing the rule, and that officers would be required to parse through details of public benefits programs, ( printed page 45358) which is outside of their job description, and analyze more voluminous records, which increases time and resource burdens.
回应：国土安全部不同意以下观点，即取消监管框架并依赖制定法和具有约束力的判例，比2022年最终规则的框架更具负担。鉴于2022年最终规则已被废止并移除，国土安全部已恢复了广泛的公共负担不可入境性认定制度，在该制度下，官员将考虑制定法规定的各项因素、外国人领取任何经济状况审查类公共福利的情况，以及官员自行裁量认定的与评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担之可能性相关的任何其他因素。与废止前的情形相同，国土安全部将根据外国人在I-485表格、I-693表格上所提供的信息、国土安全部系统中的信息，以及在裁决过程中提交或获取的任何其他佐证信息，作出公共负担不可入境性认定。国土安全部承认已对I-485表格进行了修订，要求提供官员在综合考量各种情形时将予以考虑的额外信息，但认为本最终规则下的公共负担不可入境性认定不会导致信息收集负担的显著增加。
Response: DHS disagrees that removing the regulatory framework and relying on the statute and binding precedent, is more burdensome than the 2022 Final Rule's framework. Now that the 2022 Final Rule has been rescinded and removed, DHS has restored a broad public charge inadmissibility determination in which officers consider the statutorily mandated factors, the alien's receipt of any means-tested public benefits, and any other factor(s) an officer determines, in his or her discretion, is relevant to assessing an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge. As was the case prior to the rescission, DHS will make public charge inadmissibility determinations based on information collected on the alien's Form I-485, Form I-693, information from DHS's systems, and any other supporting information submitted or obtained during adjudication. DHS acknowledges that it has revised Form I-485 to require additional information that officers will consider in the totality of the circumstances but believes that public charge inadmissibility determinations under this final rule will not result in a significant increase in the information collection burden.
就本规则最初可能导致积压而言，国土安全部认为，与取消2022年最终规则相关的任何资源负担都是合理的。通过取消那些束缚了美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）官员按照国会本意适用公共负担制定法之能力的僵化规定，国土安全部官员将确保在美国境内的外国人真正做到自给自足，[149]不依赖公共资源，[150]并确保在任何时候很可能成为公共负担的外国人，既不被准许入境，也不被允许调整身份，正如国会所意图的那样。尽管本规则的实施最初可能会增加美国公民及移民服务局的处理时间，但这正是国会在《个人责任与工作机会协调法》（PRWORA）和《非法移民改革和移民责任法》（IIRIRA）中所确立的法律得以有力执行所必须承担的负担。国土安全部致力于确保官员拥有必要的资源，以便及时高效地裁决移民福利申请。美国公民及移民服务局将在过渡期间向官员提供指导和培训，正如其在此类情况下通常所做的那样，从而缓解评论者的担忧。此外，为确保一致性和质量控制，美国公民及移民服务局将对裁决工作进行监督，并实施其通用的质量控制流程。美国公民及移民服务局将持续评估并改进裁决流程、程序和培训。
To the extent this rule could initially cause backlogs, DHS believes any resource burdens associated with removal of the 2022 Final Rule are justified. In removing the rigid regulations that straitjacketed USCIS officers' ability to apply the public charge statute as Congress intended, DHS officers will ensure aliens in the United States are truly self-sufficient,[149] not dependent on public resources,[150] and that aliens who are likely at any time to become a public charge are neither admitted nor permitted to adjust their status, as Congress intended. While implementation of the rule may initially increase USCIS processing times, such is the burden of robust enforcement of the laws that Congress set in PRWORA and IIRIRA. DHS is committed to ensuring officers have the necessary resources to timely and efficiently adjudicate applications for immigration benefits. USCIS will provide guidance and training to officers in the transition, as it generally does in such situations, ameliorating commenters' concerns. Furthermore, to ensure consistency and quality control, USCIS will monitor adjudications and apply its general quality control processes. USCIS will continually assess and improve the adjudication processes, procedures, and training.
评论：一位评论者指出，本规则将降低可预测性，从而导致更多的证据补充请求、上诉和法律挑战。该评论者表示，本规则将导致更多的自由裁量性拒绝，从而产生更多的后续申请和延误，使处理时间增加数月甚至数年，并造成延误。一位评论者表示，本规则将大幅增加官员的文书工作负担，并导致裁决不一致，可能引发更多诉讼，造成处理延误，并在移民处理方面造成更大的积压。一位评论者表示，取消2022年最终规则所带来的运营负担，可能对依赖可预测且高效移民处理程序的家庭、雇主和社区机构造成负面影响。
Comment: One commenter noted that this rule would be less predictable and therefore lead to more requests for evidence, appeals, and legal challenges. This commenter stated that this rule would lead to more discretionary denials, which results in more follow-up filings and delays, which adds months or years to processing times and to delays. A commenter stated that the rule would significantly increase the paperwork burden on officers and would lead to inconsistent adjudication that could increase litigation, and cause delays in processing, creating larger backlogs in immigration processing. One commenter said the operational burden associated with the removal of the 2022 Final Rule could negatively impact families, employers, and community institutions that depend on predictable and efficient immigration processing.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)不同意以下观点,即废除2022年最终规则将导致公共负担不可入境性认定方式变得不可预测,从而导致发出更多证据请求或增加官员的“文书负担”。如在拟议规则制定通知(NPRM)中所述,在审理调整身份申请时,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将依据现行判例,综合考虑法定最低限度因素、外国人领取经济状况调查型公共福利的情况,以及与评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性相关的所有其他信息的整体情况。90 FR 52168, 52188(2025年11月19日)。《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)(B)条和第212(s)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)和1182(s)。例如,USCIS将继续使用I-693表(移民体检及疫苗接种记录报告)和I-485表(登记永久居留或调整身份申请)中的信息,以及在面谈期间获得的任何信息,来评估外国人的年龄、健康状况、家庭状况、资产、资源和财务状况、教育和技能,以及领取任何经济状况调查型公共福利的情况。与USCIS审理的任何移民福利一样,官员可以要求提供与法定强制性因素相关的额外证据,或官员认定与评估外国人在任何时候是否可能成为公共负担相关的任何其他因素的额外证据。90 FR 52168, 52188(2025年11月19日)。另见8 CFR 103.2(b)(8)。
Response: DHS disagrees that removal of the 2022 Final Rule results in an unpredictable approach to public charge inadmissibility determinations that will lead to the issuance of more requests for evidence or increased “paperwork burden” on officers. As noted in the NPRM, in adjudicating adjustment of status applications, USCIS will consider the statutory minimum factors, the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits, and all other information relevant to assessing the alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge in the totality of the circumstances, consistent with governing precedent. 90 FR 52168, 52188 (Nov. 19, 2025). INA secs. 212(a)(4)(B) and 212(s), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B) and 1182(s). For example, USCIS will continue to use information from the alien's Form I-693, Report of Immigration Medical Examination and Vaccination Record, and Form I-485, Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status, as well as any information obtained during an interview to assess the alien's age, health, family status, assets, resources, and financial status, education and skills, receipt of any means-tested public benefits. And as is true in with any immigration benefit USCIS adjudicates, officers may request additional evidence relating to the statutorily mandated factors or any other factor the officer determines is relevant to assessing whether the alien is likely at any time to become a public charge. 90 FR 52168, 52188 (Nov. 19, 2025). See also8 CFR 103.2(b)(8).
此外,国土安全部认为,与公共负担不可入境性认定相关的法规和现行判例裁决为官员提供了充分的指导。这些权威依据以及相关的信息收集同样为申请调整身份的外国人提供了充分的通知,使其了解USCIS在进行公共负担不可入境性认定时将考虑哪些信息。申请调整身份的外国人可能需要熟悉这些权威依据以及信息收集要求和说明,以了解他们需要提交哪些证据来证明自己在任何时候都不太可能成为公共负担。USCIS还将发布次级规章指南,该指南将在本最终规则生效之日起生效。
Furthermore, DHS believes that the statute and the governing precedent decisions pertaining to public charge inadmissibility determinations provide officers with sufficient guidance. These authorities as well as the relevant information collections similarly provide adequate notice to the aliens applying for adjustment of status about what information USCIS will consider when conducting public charge inadmissibility determinations. Aliens applying for adjustment of status may need to become familiar with these authorities and the information collections and instructions to understand what evidence they need to submit to demonstrate that they are not likely at any time to become a public charge. USCIS will also issue subregulatory guidance, which will go into effect on the effective date of this final rule.
申请调整身份的外国人应当预期需要完整填写其I-485表,并提供任何所需的证明材料,以及提供其持有的与自给自足能力和成为公共负担可能性相关的任何证据。只要外国人提供了这些信息,国土安全部不同意评论者所称回归忠实的公共负担不可入境性认定将导致更多证据请求或后续申请的说法。
Aliens applying for adjustment of status should expect to fully complete their Form I-485 and provide any required supporting evidence, as well as provide any evidence in their possession that pertains to their self-sufficiency and likelihood of becoming a public charge. So long as aliens provide this information, DHS disagrees with the commenter's characterization that the return to a faithful public charge inadmissibility determination will result in more RFEs or subsequent filings.
关于评论者所称该规则制定将导致更多上诉或法律挑战的说法,国土安全部指出,入境申请或调整身份申请被拒绝的情况通常不能提出上诉。[151] 在外国人的调整身份申请被拒绝后,如该外国人符合可递解条件,USCIS可以签发出庭通知书(NTA),将该外国人置于递解程序中。[152] 在递解程序中,该外国人可以对递解的依据提出异议,并且如果被认定为可递解,可以向移民法官提交调整身份申请。见《移民与国籍法》第240(c)(3)条和第(4)条,8 U.S.C. 1229a(c)(3)和(4)。关于诉讼问题,本最终规则的制定经过审慎考量,旨在忠实诠释《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条、8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)、《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)以及国会意图。(第45359页)国土安全部还考虑了相关法规、判例裁决、数十年来的机构实践以及立法材料,以确保本最终规则符合国会的目标。国土安全部认识到,某些个人和团体可能反对忠实执行我国移民法律的任何举措,并可能在法庭上提出异议。然而,我们预期本规则所确立的合理标准将有助于支持与国会所建立的法定框架相一致的有效实施和执法。
With respect to the commenter's claim the rulemaking will result in more appeals or legal challenges, DHS notes a denial of an application for admission or adjustment of status generally cannot be appealed.[151] Upon denial of an alien's application for adjustment of status, if removable, USCIS can issue a Notice to Appear (NTA) and place the alien in removal proceedings.[152] In removal proceedings, the alien can challenge the basis for removal and, if found removable, file the application for adjustment with the Immigration Judge. See INA secs. 240(c)(3) and (4), 8 U.S.C. 1229a(c)(3) and (4). With respect to litigation, this final rule was carefully developed to reflect a faithful interpretation of section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), PRWORA, and congressional intent. DHS also considered statutes, precedent ( printed page 45359) decisions, decades-long agency practices, and legislative materials to ensure the final rule is consistent with congressional objectives. DHS recognizes certain individuals and groups may object to any faithful implementation of our country's immigration laws and may raise their objections in court. However, we expect the rule's reasonable standards will support effective implementation and enforcement, consistent with the statutory framework established by Congress.
正如评论者所言,本最终规则可能因导致移民处理效率低下而对家庭、雇主和社区机构产生负面影响,尽管该规则的实施最初可能会增加美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)的处理时间,但这正是强有力执行国会在《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)和《非法移民改革和移民责任法》(IIRIRA)中确立的法律所应承担的负担。国土安全部(DHS)致力于确保官员拥有必要的资源,以及时高效地裁决移民福利申请。美国公民及移民服务局将在过渡期间为官员提供指导和培训,正如其在此类情况下通常所做的那样,从而缓解评论者的担忧。
As to the commenter's suggestion that this final rule could negatively impact families, employers, and community institutions because it would result in inefficiency in immigration processing, while implementation of the rule may initially increase USCIS processing times, such is the burden of robust enforcement of the laws that Congress established in PRWORA and IIRIRA. DHS is committed to ensuring officers have the necessary resources to timely and efficiently adjudicate applications for immigration benefits. USCIS will provide guidance and training to officers in the transition, as it generally does in such situations, ameliorating commenters' concerns.
评论:一位评论者指出,众多联邦文件经常引用相关法规,更新这些文件将浪费资源。
Comment: A commenter stated numerous Federal documents frequently cite the regulations in question and updating those documents would waste resources.
回应:国土安全部承认联邦机构有众多文件和资源引用或提及现已废止的2022年最终规则所颁布的法规。国土安全部进一步承认,联邦机构将需要投入资源来更新机构指南和信息资源,以应对任何法规变化。国土安全部预计本最终规则不会导致特别大量的资源支出,并将确保采用高效策略更新其文件和资源,以反映2022年最终规则的废止。如果国土安全部,特别是美国公民及移民服务局,无法收回与实施本最终规则相关的全部成本,该机构将在后续的费用规则中提议调整相关表格费用。美国公民及移民服务局根据裁决的相对负担和资源使用情况,为裁决分配成本,从而确定其费用。此外,国土安全部将与其他联邦机构合作,确保其了解废止情况,并在需要时协助其更新相关材料。
Response: DHS recognizes Federal agencies have numerous documents and resources citing to or referencing regulations promulgated in the now-rescinded 2022 Final Rule. DHS further recognizes Federal agencies will need to expend resources to update agency guidance and informational resources for any regulatory change. DHS does not anticipate a substantial expenditure of resources unique to this final rule and will ensure it employs efficient strategies to update its documents and resources to reflect rescission of the 2022 Final Rule. Should DHS, particularly USCIS, be unable to recover the full costs associated with implementing this final rule, the agency will propose to adjust the associated form fees in a subsequent fee rule. USCIS establishes its fees by assigning costs to an adjudication based on its relative adjudication burden and the use of resources. Additionally, DHS will work with other Federal agencies to ensure awareness of the rescission and assist them as needed with updating their materials.
评论:一位评论者写道,该规则删除了将非移民排除在公共负担不可入境事由之外的语言,从而影响了国际学生和学者。该评论者认为,让这些人员接受公共负担认定将浪费国土安全部的资源,因为国际学生必须提供证据证明其有足够资金在整个学习期间维持自身生活。另一位评论者要求将F类和J类签证排除在拟议规则之外,因为国际学生和学者已经必须提供经济自给自足的证明。另一位评论者表示,广泛的官员自由裁量权可能对国际学生造成负面影响,包括对奖学金、津贴或助教金等合法资金来源的审查、对受抚养人的负面影响,以及对学生未来福利(如选择性实习训练(OPT)、H-1B或身份调整)产生的不确定性。
Comment: A commenter wrote that the rule removes language excluding nonimmigrants from the public charge ground of inadmissibility, impacting international students and scholars. The commenter reasoned that subjecting these individuals to a public charge determination would be a waste of DHS's resources as international students must provide evidence of sufficient funds to support themselves throughout their course of study. Another commenter requested that F and J categories of visas be excluded from the proposed rule since international students and scholars already have to provide proof of financial self-sufficiency. Another commenter said broad officer discretion could lead to negative consequences for international students, including scrutiny of legitimate funding sources like scholarships, stipends, or assistantships, negative impacts on dependents, and uncertainty affecting future benefits for the student such as Optional Practical Training (OPT), H-1B, or adjustment of status.
回应:国土安全部认为第一位评论者误解了2022年最终规则的适用范围,该规则并未将包括国际学生和学者在内的非移民排除在公共负担不可入境事由之外。根据该法规的明文规定,公共负担不可入境事由适用于申请签证(移民签证和非移民签证)、入境或身份调整的申请人,除非法规中有明确豁免。将寻求以F类和J类身份入境的人员一概排除在外,将违反该法规。[153]因此,本规则制定所确立的公共负担不可入境认定必然适用于在入境口岸寻求入境的非移民,除非该外国人获得豁免,不受此不可入境事由约束。然而,本最终规则并不规范大学,也不规范经济援助奖励的资格或金额,或实习或其他工作经历机会的可获得性。学生在学习期间自我维持生活的要求,由国务院领事官员在签发非移民签证之前进行评估,尽管存在可能性,但除非有额外信息或情况发生变化,海关及边境保护局(CBP)官员此后在入境口岸根据《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)条,认定该外国人不可入境的情况并不常见。
Response: DHS believes the first commenter misunderstood the scope of the 2022 Final Rule which did not exclude nonimmigrants, including international students and scholars, from the public charge ground of inadmissibility. Under the plain language of the statute, the public charge ground of inadmissibility applies to applicants for visas (immigrant and nonimmigrant), admission, or adjustment of status unless expressly exempt in statute. Categorically excluding individuals seeking admission under the F and J categories would be contrary to the statute.[153] Therefore, public charge inadmissibility determinations established by this rulemaking necessarily apply to nonimmigrants seeking admission at a port of entry, unless the alien is exempt from this ground of inadmissibility. However, this final rule does not regulate universities nor the eligibility for, or amount of, financial aid awards or the availability of internships or other work experience. The requirement for students to support themselves during studies is evaluated by consular officers at Department of State prior to issuing the nonimmigrant visa and, while possible, it is unlikely a CBP officer would later find the alien inadmissible at a port of entry under section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), barring additional information or changed circumstances.
4. 与长期移民政策或美国价值观的不一致
4. Misalignment With Longstanding Immigration Policies or U.S. Values
评论:有评论者表示担忧,认为这项规则制定违背了我们的价值观(包括公平与机会),违背了建国原则,其目的是惩罚贫穷的移民并阻止他们进入美国。另一位评论者警告称,拟议的变更将使移民制度转向一种优先根据财富评估移民的模式,而不是其他传统的成功融入标志,如潜力、品格和贡献。一位评论者表示,该规则对低收入人群、残疾人、照护者和边缘化群体造成了不成比例的负担,且没有正当的政府理由,基于财富的排除机制历来受到宪法上的质疑。一位评论者表示,拟议规则导致的移民决定中的不确定性和个人自由裁量权有悖于民主价值观。
Comment: Commenters expressed concerns: the rulemaking is against our values (including fairness and opportunity), founding principles, and is intended to punish poor immigrants and deter them from entering the United States. Another warned that proposed changes would shift the immigration system toward a model that prioritizes evaluating immigrants on wealth, over other traditional markers of successful assimilation, such as potential, character, and contributions. A commenter said the rule disproportionately burdens low-income individuals, people with disabilities, caregivers, and marginalized communities without a legitimate governmental justification, and wealth-based exclusion mechanisms have consistently been viewed with constitutional skepticism. A commenter stated that the uncertainty and individual discretion in immigration decisions resulting from the proposed rule would run contrary to democratic values.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)强烈不同意本规则旨在惩罚任何人,包括边缘化群体,或与美国价值观不一致的说法。事实上,国土安全部指出,本规则符合自最早的移民法以来的成文法律语言和长期国家政策,即在美国境内的外国人应自给自足,不依赖公共资源来满足其需求。参见8 U.S.C. 1601(2)(A)和(5)。国会最早于1882年《移民法》中根据外国人成为公共负担的可能性设立移民限制,该法授权排除“任何无法在不成为公共负担的情况下照顾自己的人”。[154]国会于1996年颁布《个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)时进一步阐述了这一点,规定外国人总体上不应依赖公共资源,公共福利的可获得性不应构成移民美国的激励因素。参见Public Law 104-193, sec. 400, 110 Stat. 2105, 2260(编入8 U.S.C. 1601)。此外,国土安全部认为本最终规则并不违背民主价值观。国土安全部在本规则制定中对公共负担不可入境事由的解释和适用,恰当地参考了该条款一个多世纪以来的历史、《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)条现行成文法律语言(8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))、相关判例法,以及国会就移民和福利问题明确表达的国家政策声明。
Response: DHS strongly disagrees this rule is intended to punish anyone, including marginalized communities, or is inconsistent with American values. DHS, in fact, notes this rule is consistent with statutory language and longstanding national policy since the earliest immigration laws that aliens within the United States are self-sufficient and not dependent on public resources to meet their needs. See8 U.S.C. 1601(2)(A) and (5). Congress first created immigration restrictions based on an alien's likelihood of becoming a public charge in the Immigration Act of 1882, which authorized exclusion of “any person unable to take care of himself or herself without becoming a public charge.” [154] Congress expanded on this point in 1996 when enacting PRWORA by stating aliens generally should not depend on public resources and the availability of public benefits should not constitute an incentive for immigration to the United States. SeePublic Law 104-193, sec. 400, 110 Stat. 2105, 2260 (codified at 8 U.S.C. 1601). Further, DHS does not believe this final rule is contrary to democratic values. DHS's interpretation and application of the public charge inadmissibility ground in this rulemaking is properly guided by the more than a century-old history of this provision, the current statutory language at section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), relevant case law, and Congress's express statements of national policy with respect to immigration and welfare.
如前所述,就公共负担不可入境事由的认定对低收入外国人产生不成比例影响的程度而言,国土安全部指出,是国会,而非国土安全部,要求在公共负担不可入境事由认定中考虑外国人的资产、资源和财务状况。参见《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(B)(i)(IV)条,8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(i)(IV)。因此,在遵循成文法律明确语言的情况下,国土安全部将继续考虑外国人的资产、资源和财务状况、其他法定因素、外国人领取计入经济状况调查的公共福利的情况,以及在官员自由裁量范围内与评估外国人在综合考量所有情况下是否可能在任何时候成为公共负担相关的任何其他具体案情因素。
As noted previously, to the extent that public charge inadmissibility determinations disproportionately affect ( printed page 45360) aliens with lower incomes, DHS notes it is Congress, not DHS, that mandated consideration of an alien's assets, resources, and financial status in public charge inadmissibility determinations. See INA sec. 212(a)(4)(B)(i)(IV), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(B)(i)(IV). Therefore, in following the express language of the statute, DHS will continue to consider an alien's assets, resources, and financial status, the other statutorily-mandated factors, the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits, as well as any other case-specific factor that is relevant, in the officer's discretion, to assessing whether an alien is likely at any time to become a public charge in the totality of the circumstances.
官员不会仅因外国人收入低而认定其因可能在任何时候成为公共负担而不可入境。[155]事实上,仅因外国人收入较低就拒绝其入境或调整身份,将与成文法律语言以及国土安全部将继续遵循的长期具有约束力的判例不符。[156]相反,正如《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中所反映的,[157]官员将在综合考量所有情况下,考虑所有相关因素,包括法定因素、外国人领取计入经济状况调查的公共福利的情况以及任何其他相关因素,作出公共负担不可入境事由的认定。[158]
An officer would not conclude that an alien is inadmissible as likely at any time to become a public charge solely because that alien is low income.[155] Indeed, to deny an alien admission or adjustment of status solely because the alien has lower income would be inconsistent with statutory language and longstanding binding precedent that DHS will continue to follow.[156] Instead, as reflected in the NPRM,[157] officers would make public charge inadmissibility determinations considering all relevant factors, including the statutorily mandated factors, the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits, and any other relevant factor, in the totality of the circumstances.[158]
评论:另一位评论者表示,本规则违背了《移民与国籍法》第201(b)条(8 U.S.C. 1151)所规定的家庭团聚目标。另一位评论者表示,国土安全部应保留2022年最终规则,因为与国土安全部在《拟议规则制定通知》中提出的框架不同,2022年最终规则能够保护家庭团聚。
Comment: Another commenter said this rule is contrary to family unity goals of section 201(b) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1151. Another commenter stated that DHS should retain the 2022 Final Rule because unlike the framework DHS proposed in the NPRM, the 2022 Final Rule protects family unity.
答复:国土安全部(DHS)强烈不同意本规则旨在损害机会、公平或家庭团聚的说法。国土安全部承认,《移民与国籍法》(INA)为某些外国人提供了临时或永久来到并留在美国的机会,以促进家庭团聚等理想。[159]然而,国土安全部必须强调,本规则并未且不能改变法定所规定的获得直系亲属、家庭担保、就业类、多元化签证或非移民签证,或人道主义救济的程序和要求;外国人仍将能够申请其符合资格的任何福利,国土安全部将继续向已证明符合资格的外国人授予移民福利。[160]重要的是,《移民与国籍法》排除了某些外国人获得这些家庭团聚和人道主义福利的资格。例如,除非适用例外情形或存在豁免,寻求以家庭类移民身份获得入境许可和身份调整的外国人,如果曾犯有某些刑事罪行,被诊断患有具有公共卫生意义的传染病,以及(此处尤为重要)在任何时候有可能成为公共负担者,则属于不可入境且不具资格。[161]这些不可入境事由是国会权力的有效行使,尽管这些不可入境事由可能会使外国人无法获得国会所提供的这些家庭类福利。
Response: DHS strongly disagrees that this rule seeks to undermine opportunity, fairness, or family unity. DHS acknowledges that the INA provides certain aliens with the opportunity to come to and remain in the United States temporarily and permanently in furtherance of such ideals as family unity.[159] However, DHS must emphasize that this rule does not and cannot alter the process and requirements for obtaining immediate relative, family-sponsored, employment-based, diversity, or nonimmigrant visas, or humanitarian relief as provided for in the statute; aliens will still be able to apply for any benefit for which they are eligible and DHS will continue to grant immigration benefits to aliens who have demonstrated eligibility for such benefits.[160] Importantly, the INA precludes certain aliens from obtaining those family unity and humanitarian benefits. For example, unless an exception applies or a waiver is available, aliens seeking admission and adjustment of status as family-based immigrants are inadmissible and ineligible if they have committed certain criminal offenses, have been diagnosed with a communicable disease of public health significance, and, as important here, are likely at any time to become a public charge.[161] These grounds of inadmissibility are valid exercises of congressional authority, notwithstanding that such grounds of inadmissibility may prevent aliens from obtaining these family-based benefits that Congress has made available.
由于国会在一个多世纪以来一直认定,有可能成为公共负担者的外国人应被排除在某些移民福利(包括旨在促进家庭团聚的福利)之外,国土安全部在决定准许哪些外国人入境或将其身份调整为合法永久居民时,必须执行这一不可入境事由。通过本规则,国土安全部正在依照国会的意图行使其法定权力,以管理公共负担不可入境事由。就评论者对本规则影响外国人获得《移民与国籍法》所规定移民福利能力的担忧而言,国土安全部还指出,公共负担不可入境事由并不适用于所有寻求签证、入境许可或身份调整的外国人。国会明确将某些群体排除在外,例如难民和在入境及身份调整时的庇护获得者。见《移民与国籍法》第207(c)(3)条和第209(c)条,《美国法典》第8编第1157(c)(3)条和第1159(c)条。
Because Congress has for over a century determined that aliens who are likely to become a public charge should be precluded from obtaining certain immigration benefits, including those intending to promote family unity, DHS is required to enforce this basis for inadmissibility when determining which aliens to admit or adjust their status to that of a lawful permanent resident. Through this rule, DHS is exercising its statutory authority to administer the public charge ground of inadmissibility in the manner that Congress intended. To the extent that commenters are concerned about this rule's impact on aliens' ability to obtain immigration benefits provided under the INA, DHS also notes that the public charge inadmissibility ground does not apply to all aliens who are seeking a visa, admission, or adjustment of status. Congress specifically exempted certain groups, e.g., refugees and asylees at the time of admission and adjustment of status. INA secs. 207(c)(3) and 209(c), 8 U.S.C. 1157(c)(3) and 1159(c).
评论:评论者表示,在公共负担不可入境事由的认定中,将短期、合法的福利使用视为负面因素,违背了美国移民法的精神。另有评论者表示担忧,认为该拟议规则是对长期以来移民政策的背弃,严重损害了那些依赖社会保障服务以便在一生中为国家作出贡献的外国人。另有两位评论者写道,本规则将推翻数十年来明确规定哪些公共福利可在不引发负面移民后果的情况下使用的稳健且已确立的公共政策。
Comment: Commenters stated it is contrary to the spirit of U.S. immigration law to treat short-term, lawful benefit use as a negative factor in a public charge inadmissibility determination. Others expressed concern that the proposed rule is an abandonment of longstanding immigration policy and severely harms aliens who rely on social safety services to contribute to the country over the course of their lives. Two others wrote that this rule would unravel decades of sound and settled public policy clearly outlining which public benefits may be used without causing negative immigration consequences.
答复:国土安全部不同意在公共负担不可入境事由认定中考虑外国人领取经济状况审查型公共福利的做法违背长期移民政策精神的说法。外国人领取公共福利一直是公共负担不可入境事由认定中所考虑的因素,这一做法可追溯至最早的移民法。[162]此外,国土安全部是在综合考虑各种情况的基础上权衡各项因素的,其中外国人领取任何经济状况审查型公共福利的情况会被纳入考虑,但并非具有决定性作用。[163]
Response: DHS disagrees that considering an alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits in a public charge inadmissibility determination is contrary to the spirit of longstanding immigration policy. An alien's receipt of public benefits has been a consideration in public charge inadmissibility determinations dating back to the earliest immigration laws.[162] Further, DHS considers the factors in the totality of the circumstances, where receipt of any means-tested public benefits by an alien is considered but not outcome determinative.[163]
国土安全部不会仅仅因为某外国人领取了经济状况审查型公共福利,就认定该外国人根据公共负担条款属于不可入境。见《联邦公报》第90卷第52168页,第52188页(2025年11月19日)。相反,正如拟议规则(NPRM)中所述,并遵循以往的先例,国土安全部官员将审视外国人领取福利的具体情况,例如福利的性质、该福利单独或与其他福利相结合是否属于满足外国人基本需求的类型、领取的时间远近、持续时间和数额、领取的原因,以及(印刷页第45361页)该原因是否已经持续或可能持续等。见《联邦公报》第90卷第52168页,第52188页(2025年11月19日)。
DHS would not conclude an alien is inadmissible under the public charge ground simply because that alien received a means-tested public benefit. 90 FR 52168, 52188 (Nov. 19, 2025). Instead, as noted in the NPRM and following past precedent, DHS officers would look at the circumstances surrounding the alien's receipt, e.g., nature of the benefit, whether it is the type of benefit that alone or in combination with other benefits meets the alien's basic needs, the recency, duration, and amount of receipt, the reason for the receipt, and whether the ( printed page 45361) reason has or is likely to persist, etc. 90 FR 52168, 52188 (Nov. 19, 2025).
评论:有评论者表示担忧,认为拟议规则背离了美国长期以来欢迎移民并承认移民贡献的历史承诺,因为对“公共负担”的狭隘且惩罚性的解释未能反映该国对移民作为经济与社会长期贡献者的历史性理解。一位评论者表示担忧,认为拟议的变更将从根本上重塑合法移民体系,并重新定义谁“有资格”成为美国公民,以及这个国家应呈现出怎样的面貌。
Comment: Commenters expressed concern that the proposed rule is a departure from the United States' historic commitment to welcoming immigrants and recognition of immigrant contributions, in that a narrow and punitive interpretation of “public charge” fails to reflect the nation's historical understanding of immigrants as long-term contributors to the economy and society. A commenter expressed concern that the proposed changes would radically reshape the legal immigration system and redefine who is “worthy” of being a U.S. citizen, along with what the country looks like.
回应:美国国土安全部(DHS)不同意此观点。国土安全部承认,移民过去已经且现在仍在为美国经济和劳动力做出至关重要的贡献。总体而言,移民对美国经济及政府预算均产生净正面影响,填补了美国劳动力市场中的关键缺口。然而,国会已经确定了哪些外国人应被准许进入美国或获准调整身份,以及哪些外国人属于不可准入,因而没有资格获得准入或调整身份。忠实执行使外国人不可准入美国的法定条款,对于确保移民继续作为推动我国经济及整个国家积极发展的力量至关重要。
Response: DHS disagrees. DHS acknowledges immigrants have made and continue to make critical contributions to the U.S. economy and workforce. Immigrants, taken as a whole, are a net positive for the U.S. economy as well as government budgets, filling critical gaps in the U.S. labor market. However, Congress determined which aliens should be admitted into the United States or granted adjustment of status and which aliens are inadmissible and, therefore, ineligible for admission and adjustment of status. The faithful application of the statutory provisions rendering aliens inadmissible to the United States is critical to ensuring that immigration continues to serve as a positive force for our economy and country as a whole.
极有可能在任何时候成为公共负担的外国人属于国会确定的不应被准许入境或准予调整身份的外国人类别之一。此外,我国在移民与福利方面长期以来的国家政策是,身处美国境内的外国人不应依赖公共资源来满足其需求,而应依靠自身能力以及其家庭、担保人和私人组织的资源。公共负担不可准入理由是国会设立的一项重要工具,旨在尽量减少缺乏自给自足能力、极有可能依赖政府满足其需求的外国人在美国境内的存在。是国会,而非国土安全部,确立了用以判定谁“有资格”被准许进入美国或调整身份的资格标准。通过忠实执行公共负担不可准入理由,国土安全部有助于确保被准许进入美国或获准调整身份的外国人是能够为经济和劳动力做出贡献的外国人。
Aliens likely at any time to become a public charge are among those categories of aliens whom Congress determined should not be admitted or permitted to adjust their status. Furthermore, it is our longstanding national policy on immigration and welfare that aliens within the United States should not depend on public resources to meet their needs but rather rely on their own capabilities and the resources of their families, their sponsors, and private organizations. The public charge ground of inadmissibility is an important tool established by Congress to minimize the presence in the United States of aliens who lack self-sufficiency and are likely to rely on the government to meet their needs. It is Congress, not DHS, who has established the eligibility criteria determining who is “worthy” to be admitted to the United States or to adjust their status. By faithfully implementing the public charge ground of inadmissibility, DHS helps ensure aliens admitted to the United States or granted adjustment of status are the aliens who would contribute to the economy and workforce.
F. 对申请人、申请人(请愿人)、受益人及支持系统的负面影响
F. Negative Impacts on Applicants, Petitioners, Beneficiaries, and Support Systems
1. 对福利使用的寒蝉效应
1. Chilling Effects on Benefit Usage
a. 关于寒蝉效应的一般性担忧
a. General Concerns About Chilling Effects
评论:众多评论者表示担忧,认为拟议规则在哪些援助形式可能被考虑、以及代表家庭成员领取公共福利是否会对申请人产生不利影响等方面存在被认为含糊不清之处,这将导致“寒蝉效应”,使移民即便依法有资格获得基本的医疗、营养和住房服务,也会因此而却步。许多评论者援引研究和学术成果,断言这种寒蝉效应将加剧饥饿、粮食不安全、无家可归和贫困问题,在移民中造成不确定感或恐惧,导致他们放弃本可通过其所缴纳税款资助的福利或项目,并使家庭为避免危及本人或家庭成员的移民身份而不敢使用基本服务。另一位评论者引用了《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中的内容,即“取消某些定义可能导致公众对拟议规则产生困惑或误解,从而可能导致本不受公共负担不可准入理由约束的人员减少对公共福利项目的参与。”
Comment: Numerous commenters expressed concern that the proposed rule's perceived ambiguity around which forms of assistance may be considered and whether receiving public benefits on behalf of family members could negatively affect an applicant would lead to a “chilling effect” that would discourage immigrants from accessing essential health, nutrition, and housing services, despite being legally eligible to receive them. Citing studies and research, many commenters asserted that the chilling effect will increase hunger, food insecurity, homelessness and poverty, create uncertainty or fear among immigrants, leading them to forego benefits or programs they help fund through taxes, and discourage families from accessing essential services to avoid risking their immigration status or the status of family members. Another commenter quoted the NPRM, that the “elimination of certain definitions may lead to public confusion or misunderstanding of the proposed rule, which could result in decreased participation in public benefit programs by individuals who are not subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility.”
回应:关于该规则可能产生的“寒蝉效应”,国土安全部指出,《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中所确立的我国关于福利与移民的国家政策,足以构成推行本最终规则的充分依据。参见《美国公法》第104-193号,第400条,110 Stat. 2105,2260页(编入《美国法典》第8编第1601条)。
Response: With respect to the rule's potential “chilling effects”, DHS points to our national policy on welfare and immigration as set forth in PRWORA as a sufficient basis to move forward with this final rule. SeePublic Law 104-193, sec. 400, 110 Stat. 2105, 2260 (codified at 8 U.S.C. 1601).
DHS承认该最终规则确实可能对领取经济状况调查类公共福利产生间接影响。此外,可能选择退出或放弃未来加入公共福利项目的个人,既可能包括外国人,也可能包括身份混合家庭中的美国公民成员。然而,正如美国国家利益声明(NPRM)中所述,DHS认为2022年最终规则所实施的规定,与行政命令14218号所载的国家政策、《个人责任与工作机会协调法案》(PRWORA)以及《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(4)条(即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4))广泛法定文本的文字和精神均不一致,因为该规则严重且不当地限制了DHS在作出公共负担不可入境裁定时可考虑的因素。2022年最终规则充其量阻碍了,最坏情况下则完全阻止了DHS官员考虑与依据该法规、PRWORA的精神以及以往先例裁决作出准确有效的公共负担不可入境裁定所必需的相关证据。
DHS acknowledges the final rule may indeed produce indirect effects on the receipt of means-tested public benefits. Moreover, individuals who might choose to disenroll from or forgo future enrollment in a public benefits program may include aliens as well as U.S. citizen members of mixed-status households. However, as stated in the NPRM, DHS believes the regulations implemented by the 2022 Final Rule are inconsistent with the national policy contained in E.O. 14218, PRWORA, and both the language and spirit of the broad statutory text in section 212(a)(4) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4), because it severely and unduly limited the factors DHS could consider in making a public charge inadmissibility determination. The 2022 Final Rule, at best, discouraged and, at worst, prevented DHS officers from considering relevant evidence essential to making an accurate and valid public charge inadmissibility determination consistent with the statute, the spirit of PRWORA, and past precedent decisions.
尽管个人可能会因考虑未来移民后果而重新考虑其领取公共福利的情况,但本规则并未禁止外国人获取其有资格领取的任何公共福利。就受公共负担不可入境事由约束的外国人而言,若其决定代表其美国公民子女放弃经济状况调查类公共福利,或若外国人的家庭成员决定退出其有资格领取的经济状况调查类公共福利,鉴于DHS已在本规则中说明,并将在未来指南中进一步说明,除在有限情形下,此类领取不会被纳入考量,因此做出此类选择将是不合理的。无论如何,DHS不会为避免受本规则约束的外国人可能退出或选择不加入公共福利项目的可能性而限制本规则制定的效力,因为确认个人自立本就是本规则的最终目标。DHS同样不会为避免不受公共负担不可入境事由约束的个人可能选择不领取经济状况调查类公共福利的可能性而限制本规则的效力,因为DHS认为本规则带来的益处超过了这一风险。
Although individuals may reconsider their receipt of public benefits in light of future immigration consequences, this rule does not prohibit an alien from obtaining any public benefit for which he or she is eligible. To the extent that aliens subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility decide to forego means-tested public benefits on behalf of their U.S. citizen children or to the extent that aliens' family members disenroll from means-tested public family members for which they are eligible, such choices would be unreasonable where DHS has communicated in this rule, and will communicate in future guidance, that such receipt will not be considered except in limited circumstances. Regardless, DHS declines to limit the effect of the rulemaking to avoid the possibility that aliens subject to this rule may disenroll or choose not to enroll in public benefit programs as confirming self-sufficiency is the rule's ultimate aim. DHS also declines to limit the effect of the rule to avoid the possibility that individuals who are not subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility will choose not to receive means-tested public benefits, as DHS believes that this risk is outweighed by the benefits of the rule.
然而,DHS指出,美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)将在《USCIS政策手册》中发布的次级法规指南,适用于USCIS对调整身份申请的裁决,将为受监管公众提供充分信息,以了解在判定外国人公共负担不可入境性时,哪些福利将被纳入考量,哪些不会。分享此类信息旨在帮助不受公共负担不可入境事由约束的个人理解该规定不适用于他们,从而使其能够做出知情决定。此外,DHS鼓励协助外国人的非营利组织也提供相关信息,并传播USCIS将发布的指南,以帮助外国人及其家庭了解在本最终规则下公共负担不可入境裁定将如何作出。
However, DHS notes that the subregulatory guidance that USCIS will issue in the USCIS Policy Manual, which will apply to USCIS adjudications of adjustment of status applications, will provide the regulated public with sufficient information to understand whose benefits will and will not be considered in an alien's public charge inadmissibility determination. Sharing this information is intended to help individuals who are not subject to the public charge ground of inadmissibility understand that it does not apply to them, allowing them to make informed decisions. Additionally, DHS encourages nonprofit organizations that assist aliens to also provide information and disseminate the guidance that USCIS will issue to help aliens and their families understand how public charge inadmissibility determinations will be made under this final rule.
评论意见:另一位评论者认为,近期的政策调整取消了多个就业许可文件(EAD)类别的自动延期,缩短了有效期,导致处理时间延长(见第45362页),并造成失业期,迫使许多外国人尽管已做好准备、愿意且能够合法工作,仍不得不依赖公共福利来满足其家庭的基本需求。然而,该评论者表示,移民可能会因担心风险而不敢根据拟议规则申请这些福利,从而为保护其移民身份而冒食品不安全、住房不稳定及其他严重伤害的风险。
Comment: Another commenter reasoned that recent policy shifts eliminated automatic extensions for numerous Employment Authorization Document (EAD) categories, shortened validity periods, led to longer ( printed page 45362) processing times, and resulted in periods of unemployment, forcing many aliens to depend on public benefits to meet their families' basic needs, despite being ready, willing, and able to legally work. Yet, the commenter said, immigrants may be discouraged from applying for these benefits under the proposed rule, risking food insecurity, housing instability, and other serious harms to protect their immigration status.
答复:国土安全部承认,由于难以获得就业授权文件(EAD)而出现就业空档的外国人,在此期间可能经历经济困难,需要依靠本人以外的资源来满足其需求。然而,根据《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)的精神,外国人不应依赖公共资源来满足其需求,而应在此期间依靠其家庭、担保人和私人组织。参见8 U.S.C. 1601。国土安全部将在综合考量各种情况时,将外国人领取经济状况调查类公共福利的情况纳入考虑。国土安全部强调,根据适用的判例以及《拟议规则制定通知》(NPRM)中所讨论的内容,外国人领取经济状况调查类公共福利这一事实本身并不具有决定性作用。[164] 国土安全部还将考虑所领取福利的类型、外国人领取这些福利的具体情况、领取的持续时间和金额,以及法定因素和官员根据自由裁量权认定的与评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性相关的任何其他因素,包括此前的就业经历。
Response: DHS acknowledges that aliens with gaps in employment due to difficulties obtaining EADs may experience periods of financial need during which aliens need to rely on resources other than their own to meet their needs. However, consistent with PRWORA, aliens should not depend on public resources to meet their needs, but rather rely on their families, their sponsors, and private organizations during those times. See8 U.S.C. 1601. DHS will consider the alien's receipt of means-tested public benefits in the totality of the circumstances. DHS emphasizes under applicable precedent and as discussed in the NPRM, the fact that an alien received means-tested public benefits is not by itself outcome determinative.[164] DHS will also consider the type of benefit received, the circumstances under which the alien received those benefits, the duration and amount of receipt, as well as the statutory factors and any other factor the officer determines, in his or her discretion, is relevant to assessing the alien's likelihood of at any time becoming a public charge, including prior employment history.
b. 对公共健康和医疗服务可及性的影响
b. Impact on Public Health and Healthcare Access
评论:许多评论者表示担忧,认为该规则适得其反、残酷无情,与公共卫生管理理念不符,并对公共卫生产生不利影响,要求该规则明确将健康和营养项目排除在公共负担不可入境性认定之外,以保护公共卫生和食品安全,因为医疗保健是一项基本和根本性需求,并指出有必要恢复先前法规中存在的明确性,以防止广泛的恐惧、伤害和困惑。多名评论者担心该规则会削弱公众对公共医疗保健系统的信任。一位评论者指出,诸如医疗补助(Medicaid)之类的项目并非依赖性的标志,而是促进公共卫生、儿童发展、劳动力参与和社区福祉的重要支持。评论者列举了取消他们认为提供了明确性并将医疗补助的领取排除在公共负担不可入境性认定考量之外的法规所带来的负面后果,包括由于疫苗接种率降低而导致传染病患病率升高、可预防疾病传播增加,定期体检或寻求必要护理的比率降低,长期健康状况恶化,放弃挽救生命的服务或必要的处方药,肥胖症和营养不良患病率上升,心理健康治疗的使用减少或障碍增加,以及因回避急诊治疗而导致死亡人数增加。许多评论者表示,该规则还将加剧粮食不安全、住房不稳定和贫困问题,并将这些问题与糖尿病、肥胖症、高血压、慢性肾病和抑郁症等长期健康状况联系起来,这些状况将影响美国整体公共卫生。另有评论者指出,一些外国人缴纳税款,应当被允许获得税收资助的医疗保健服务。
Comment: Many commenters expressed concern that the rule is counterproductive, cruel, not aligned with public health stewardship, and adversely impacts public health, requested the rule explicitly exclude health and nutrition programs from the public charge inadmissibility determination to protect public health and food security as healthcare is a basic and fundamental need, and pointed out the need for clarity that existed in the previous regulations to prevent widespread fear, harm, and confusion. Several commenters were concerned about the rule undermining the trust in public healthcare systems. A commenter noted that programs like Medicaid are not signs of dependency but are rather essential supports promoting public health, child development, workforce participation, and community well-being. Commenters listed negative consequences for removing the regulations that they claimed provided clarity and excluded consideration of the receipt of Medicaid from a public charge inadmissibility determination, including a higher prevalence of communicable diseases due to lower vaccination rates and increased spread of preventable illness, lower rates of seeking regular health checks or necessary care, poorer long-term health outcomes, declination of lifesaving services or necessary prescriptions, an increase in the prevalence of obesity and malnutrition, decreased use of or increased barriers to mental health treatment, and increased deaths due to avoidance of emergency treatment. Many commenters stated the rule would also exacerbate food insecurity, housing instability, and poverty, linking those to long-term health conditions like diabetes, obesity, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and depression that would impact overall U.S. public health. Others noted some aliens pay taxes and should be allowed to access tax-funded healthcare.
评论者表示,合法居留的家庭已经因政策的不确定性而失去或回避医疗保险,并引用凯撒家庭基金会(KFF)/《纽约时报》2025年移民调查[165],指出目前有多少合法居留的移民没有保险,或表示由于移民方面的担忧而推迟必要的医疗护理。一些评论者表示,该规则将伤害艾滋病病毒感染者,并破坏“终结美国艾滋病病毒流行”联邦倡议,因为它会阻止艾滋病病毒感染者和易感人群获得医疗保险以及旨在使个人能够持续接受治疗、维持病毒抑制和实现自给自足的重要公共项目。他们表示,这些项目对于终结艾滋病病毒流行、改善艾滋病病毒感染者的生活质量至关重要,而该规则最终将导致治疗中断、传播率上升、可预防的死亡以及医疗保健成本增加。
Commenters stated that lawfully present families are already losing or avoiding health coverage because of policy uncertainty and cited the Kaiser Family Foundation (KFF)/New York Times 2025 Survey of Immigrants [165] to point to the number of lawfully present immigrants who are now uninsured, or who have said they are delaying needed care because of immigration concerns. Some commenters stated the rule would harm people living with HIV and undermines the Ending the HIV Epidemic in the U.S. federal initiative by deterring people living with and vulnerable to HIV from accessing health insurance and vital public programs designed to allow individuals to stay in care, sustain viral suppression, and be self-sufficient. They stated that these programs are important to end the HIV epidemic, improve quality of life for people living with HIV, and that the rule would ultimately lead to treatment interruptions, increased transmission rates, preventable deaths, and increased healthcare costs.
回应：国土安全部（DHS）不同意该规则与美国价值观不符或具有适得其反或残酷性质的说法。正如第14218号行政命令所体现的那样,特朗普政府正在采取措施,“维护法治,防止浪费来之不易的纳税人资源,并保护有需要的美国公民的福利,包括残疾人士和退伍军人”。见90 FR 10581, 10581（2025年2月25日）。通过本规则，国土安全部确保外国人能够自给自足，并且在其有可能在任何时候成为公共负担的情况下，不会获准入境或调整身份。8 U.S.C. 1601。
Response: DHS disagrees the rule is not aligned with American values or is counterproductive or cruel. As reflected in E.O. 14218, the Trump Administration is taking steps to “uphold the rule of law, defend against the waste of hard-earned taxpayer resources, and protect benefits for American citizens in need, including individuals with disabilities and veterans.” See90 FR 10581, 10581 (Feb. 25, 2025). Through this rule, DHS ensures aliens are self-sufficient and not admitted or granted adjustment if they are likely at any time to become a public charge. 8 U.S.C. 1601.
国土安全部还不同意该规则将破坏公众对公共医疗系统的信任这一说法。本规则绝不限制儿童或成人获得医疗治疗或疫苗接种，本规则也无意阻止个人为预防传染病而获得必要的医疗保健服务。
DHS also disagrees that the rule will undermine the trust in public healthcare systems. This rule in no way restricts access to medical treatment or vaccines for children or adults, and this rule is not intended to discourage individuals from obtaining necessary healthcare to prevent communicable diseases.
此外，本规则制定并不妨碍外国人获得其根据《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》（PRWORA）有资格享有的任何经济状况审查类公共福利。尽管国土安全部承认，最终规则生效后，可能导致个人退出或选择放弃登记其有资格享有的公共福利，但本规则并不改变任何公共福利的资格要求。本规则仅澄清移民官员将如何确定寻求入境或调整身份的外国人是否属于不可入境情形，这是国会授权国土安全部作出的一项单独裁定。
Additionally, this rulemaking does not prevent aliens from obtaining any means-tested public benefits for which they are eligible under PRWORA. Although DHS acknowledges that the final rule, once effective, may lead individuals to disenroll or choose to forgo enrollment from public benefits for which they are eligible, the rule does not change eligibility requirements for any public benefits. The rule only clarifies how officers will determine whether an alien seeking admission or adjustment of status is inadmissible, which is a separate determination Congress has authorized DHS to make.
评论意见：一些评论者表示，该规则破坏了“让美国再次健康”倡议的目标，一位评论者补充说，该规则与美国卫生与公众服务部（HHS）为增加可负担保险覆盖范围、改善健康成果所做的工作相矛盾。一位评论者表示，该规则扭转了在不同人群中取得的健康公平进展。同样，一位评论者担心该规则会导致人口密集的城市地区传染病传播风险增加，另一位评论者则提出了该规则可能对农村地区医疗保健造成不利影响的风险。
Comment: Some commenters stated the rule undermines the goals of the Make America Healthy Again initiative, and one commenter added it contradicts the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services' (HHS) work to increase access to affordable coverage and attain better health outcomes. One commenter stated the rule reverses progress made on health equity among different populations. Similarly, one commenter was concerned about the rule resulting in increased risk of communicable disease spread in dense urban areas and another raised the risk of detrimental effects on healthcare in rural areas.
回应：国土安全部不同意该规则破坏“让美国再次健康”倡议目标的说法。第14212号行政命令设立了“让美国再次健康”委员会，以积极应对（印刷页45363）美国公民面临的重大健康挑战。本规则不涉及对公共福利资格或获取途径的监管。国土安全部重申，本规则不会阻止有资格获得公共福利的个人领取这些福利，因此不会破坏“让美国再次健康”倡议所确立的公共卫生目标，本规则也不与卫生与公众服务部为推行此类政策所做的工作相矛盾。
Response: DHS disagrees the rule undermines the goals of Make America Healthy Again initiative. E.O. 14212 establishes the Make America Healthy Again Commission to aggressively ( printed page 45363) combat the critical health challenges facing our citizens in the United States. This rule does not regulate eligibility for, or access to, public benefits. DHS reiterates that this rule does not prevent individuals who are eligible for public benefits from receiving these benefits and therefore does not undermine the public health goals set forth in the Make America Healthy Again initiative, nor does this rule contradict the work of HHS to enact such policy.
本规则符合PRWORA所规定的政府利益和国会意图，即：（1）最大限度地减少外国人因公共福利的可获得性而移民美国的诱因；以及（2）促进外国人在美国境内实现自给自足。见8 U.S.C. 1601。国土安全部承认，受本规则影响的外国人可能会拒绝登记其根据PRWORA可能有资格享有的经济状况审查类公共福利，或者选择退出此类福利，以避免本最终规则所带来的不利后果。然而，国土安全部有权将外国人过去、当前及可能在未来领取经济状况审查类公共福利的情况纳入考量，即便这最终可能导致外国人因此而不敢领取这些福利。[166] 此外，国土安全部不同意该规则会导致适用本规则的外国人中传染病风险增加的说法。申请调整身份的外国人须接受移民体检，并证明其未根据《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(1)条（8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(1)）而不可入境。因此，国土安全部认为，无论是否退出经济状况审查类公共福利，这些外国人仍会采取预防传染病的措施和/或寻求适当治疗，以保持其在美国的可入境资格。基于上述原因，国土安全部拒绝为避免受本规则影响的个人可能退出或选择不登记公共福利的可能性而限制本规则制定的效力，因为自给自足正是本规则的目标。
This rule is consistent with the Government's interest and congressional intent, as set forth in PRWORA, to: (1) minimize the incentive of aliens to immigrate to the United States due to the availability of public benefits; and (2) promote the self-sufficiency of aliens within the United States. See8 U.S.C. 1601. DHS acknowledges that aliens subject to this rule may decline to enroll in, or may choose to disenroll from, means-tested public benefits for which they may be eligible under PRWORA, in order to avoid negative consequences as a result of this final rule. However, DHS has authority to take past, current, and likely future receipt of means-tested public benefits into account, even where it may ultimately result in discouraging aliens from receiving those benefits.[166] Additionally, DHS disagrees that this rule will cause an increased risk of communicable disease among aliens to whom this rule applies. Aliens applying for adjustment of status are required to obtain an immigration medical examination and establish that they are not inadmissible under section 212(a)(1) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(1). Therefore, DHS believes that these aliens would still take preventive measures against and/or seek proper treatment of communicable diseases, regardless of means-tested public benefit disenrollment, in order to remain admissible to the United States. For these reasons, DHS declines to limit the effect of the rulemaking to avoid the possibility that individuals subject to this rule may disenroll or choose not to enroll because self-sufficiency is the rule's goal.
c. 对儿童和身份混合家庭的影响
c. Impacts on Children and Mixed-Status Families
一、退出登记及因担心登记而对儿童产生的影响
i. Disenrollment and Fear of Enrolling Impacts on Children
评论意见:许多评论者对移民儿童退保所产生的影响表示担忧,称退出医疗补助计划(Medicaid)将增加儿童挨饿、住房不安全、健康状况不佳的比率,并减少其获得常规体检、视力和口腔护理以及慢性病治疗的机会,而另一些评论者则表示退保将损害儿童的教育成就、长期发展、整体福祉和发育,以及疫苗接种率。一位评论者表示,医疗补助覆盖与儿童较低的哮喘发病率相关。其他人指出,医疗补助对于为儿童提供行为健康服务至关重要。一些人表示,寒蝉效应将增加儿童时期的压力和创伤,同时带来新的行为挑战和社会缺陷,其中一位评论者表示,因担心寻求援助而产生的物质困难将加剧父母的压力,损害亲子关系,进而影响儿童发育。许多评论者引用研究并表示担忧,称健康保险覆盖和护理回避将损害移民儿童,一些人表示退保和护理回避将减少儿童初级和预防性护理就诊的频率。评论者指出,公共医疗保险覆盖与儿童的教育成就呈正相关关系,拥有医疗保险覆盖的儿童在紧急情况下的存活率更高。评论者表示担忧,该规则将导致移民人群回避能源援助计划,并描述了这些计划对家庭健康结果和儿童发育的重要性。评论者引用研究,讨论了儿童项目如何改善早期认知发展、社交技能、行为规划、健康、语言技能、数学和英语成绩、终身教育成就以及成年后的就业结果和收入。评论者表示,儿童时期的医疗补助参保可减少住院治疗以及成年后慢性健康问题、违法犯罪行为以及注意力障碍和发育迟缓诊断的发生。他们还引用研究发现,参加医疗补助与成年后患高血压、行走困难和早逝几率降低之间存在关联。
Comment: Many commenters expressed concerns about disenrollment effects on immigrant children, saying that disenrollment from Medicaid would increase children's rates of hunger, housing insecurity, poor health outcomes, and reduce access to routine check-ups, vision and oral care, and treatment for chronic conditions, while others said disenrollment would harm children's educational attainment, long-term success, overall well-being and development, and vaccination rates. One commenter said that Medicaid coverage is associated with lower rates of asthma among children. Others remarked that Medicaid is critical for providing behavioral health services to children. Some said the chilling effects would increase childhood stressors and trauma, while introducing new behavioral challenges and social deficits, with one commenter stating that fear of seeking assistance and consequent material hardship would raise stress for parents, harming parent-child relationships and, in turn, child development. Many commenters cited studies and expressed concern that health coverage and care avoidance would harm immigrant children, with some stating that disenrollment and care avoidance would decrease the frequency of children's primary and preventive care visits. Commenters remarked that public health insurance coverage has a positive relationship with children's educational attainment and children with health coverage have higher survival rates during emergencies. Commenters expressed concerns that the rule would lead to avoidance of energy assistance programs among immigrant populations and described the importance of those programs for family health outcomes and child development. Commenters cited studies discussing how childhood programs improved early cognitive development, social skills, behavior programs, health, language skills, math and English-language achievements, lifetime educational attainment, and employment outcomes and income in adulthood. Commenters stated that childhood Medicaid enrollment reduces hospitalizations and development of chronic adult health issues, delinquency and crime, and diagnoses of attention disorders and developmental delays. They also cited studies that found an association between Medicaid enrollment and lowered chances of developing high blood pressure, having difficulty walking, and experiencing early mortality as adults.
回应:国土安全部(DHS)认识到,许多公共福利计划旨在改善儿童和父母未来的经济和健康状况,而父母可能会决定让子女退出这些计划,以避免产生不利的移民后果。然而,本规则旨在确保公共负担不可入境裁定与国会在《移民与国籍法》(INA)、《1996年非法移民改革和移民责任法》(IIRIRA)以及《1996年个人责任与工作机会协调法》(PRWORA)中所体现的意图保持一致。本规则恢复了在评估外国人在任何时候成为公共负担的可能性时,综合评估所有相关事实和情况的更广泛自由裁量权,并符合长期以来的政策,即外国人应自立自强,政府福利不应成为移民的激励因素。参见8 U.S.C. 1601。本规则并不阻止任何个人,包括儿童在内,如符合健康或营养计划的资格,申请或领取相关福利,而是在废止过度限制性的2022年最终规则之后,忠实执行该法规。国土安全部正在落实上述PRWORA中的国会指令。国土安全部认为,2022年最终规则未能忠实执行PRWORA以及《移民与国籍法》第212(a)(4)(A)条,即8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A),因为该规则通过限制在综合考量所有情况时可考虑的公共福利种类,并阻止官员考虑法规中列出的七项因素之外的其他因素,从而束缚了官员的裁量权。
Response: DHS recognizes that many of the public benefit programs aim to better future economic and health outcomes for children and parents may decide to disenroll their children from these programs to avoid negative immigration consequences. However, this rule is aimed at ensuring that public charge inadmissibility determinations are consistent with Congress's intent in the INA, IIRIRA, and PRWORA. This rule restores broader discretion to evaluate all relevant facts and circumstances in assessing an alien's likelihood at any time of becoming a public charge and aligns with long-standing policy that aliens should be self-reliant and government benefits should not incentivize immigration. See8 U.S.C. 1601. This rule does not prevent any individual, including a child, who is eligible for health or nutrition programs from applying for or receiving benefits, but rather faithfully implements the statute after rescission of the overly-restrictive 2022 Final Rule. DHS is implementing the above-referenced congressional directive in PRWORA. DHS believes that the 2022 Final Rule did not faithfully implement PRWORA and section 212(a)(4)(A) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(4)(A), insofar as it straitjacketed officers by limiting which public benefits considered in the totality of the circumstances and by precluding officers from considering factors beyond the seven factors outlined in the regulations.
国土安全部(DHS)还指出,公共负担不可入境事由并不适用于所有申请签证、入境或身份调整的申请人。国会特别将某些群体从该不可入境事由中豁免出来,例如依据《移民与国籍法》第207(c)(3)条和第209(c)条(8 U.S.C. 1157(c)(3)和1159(c)),难民和避难者在入境及身份调整时获得豁免。就这些评论人士关注公共负担不可入境事由对儿童的适用而言,国土安全部指出,除非儿童是依据国会明确豁免公共负担不可入境事由的类别申请入境或身份调整,否则国会并未将儿童排除在公共负担不可入境事由之外。此外,国会特别要求国土安全部在公共负担不可入境事由的认定中考虑申请人的年龄。另外,正如其他评论回应中所讨论的,国土安全部指出,其仅会在记录中有证据表明外国人在法律上有义务抚养的家庭成员因该外国人的收入低于某一门槛而申请、被批准或核准领取、或正在领取按经济状况核发的公共福利的情况下,才会考虑该家庭成员领取按经济状况核发的公共福利的情形。[167](印刷页45364)在此类情况下,国土安全部会将导致其家庭成员需要申请或领取此类福利的该外国人的财务状况,作为在综合考量情况下评估该外国人资产、资源和财务状况的一部分予以考虑。[168]
DHS also notes that the public charge inadmissibility ground does not apply to all applicants who are seeking a visa, admission, or adjustment of status. Congress specifically exempted certain groups from this ground of inadmissibility, e.g., refugees and asylees at the time of admission and adjustment of status, pursuant to sections 207(c)(3) and 209(c) of the INA, 8 U.S.C. 1157(c)(3) and 1159(c). To the extent that these commenters are concerned with the application of the public charge inadmissibility ground to children, DHS notes that Congress did not exclude children from the public charge ground of inadmissibility unless the child is applying for admission or adjustment of status under a category Congress expressly exempted from public charge inadmissibility. Moreover, Congress specifically required that DHS consider an applicant's age in the public charge inadmissibility determination. Additionally, as discussed in other comment responses, DHS notes it will only consider receipt of means-tested public benefits by family members to the extent there is evidence in the record an alien's family member whom the alien is legally obligated to support applied for, was approved or certified to receive, or has received or is currently receiving means-tested public benefits due to the alien's income falling below ( printed page 45364) a certain threshold.[167] In such cases, DHS would consider the alien's financial status that led to his or her family member needing to apply for or receive those benefits as part of DHS' consideration of the alien's assets, resources, and financial status in the totality of the circumstances.[168]
评论:少数评论人士对无家可归和住房不稳定对儿童的影响表示担忧,并指出住房稳定性是学业成就的重要预测因素,一位评论人士认为住房不稳定会妨碍儿童上学、完成家庭作业以及与教育工作者和同伴建立联系的能力。一些评论人士补充说,获得住房援助的家庭的儿童更有可能保持健康体重、改善心理健康状况、在数学和语言艺术方面取得教育进步,并在成年后获得更高的收入和教育成就,同时成年后被监禁的可能性也较低。一些人引用了一项研究,该研究发现在照护人报告获得取暖或能源援助的家庭中,儿童体重更健康,急性住院率更低。
Comment: A few commenters expressed concerns regarding how homelessness and housing instability impacts children and remarked housing stability is a significant predictor of academic achievement, with one commenter reasoning that housing instability interferes with children's ability to attend school, complete homework, and build connections with educators and peers.
